title: Lead, Capability Experience Designer (UX)
description:
Job Description

Every day at FIS, innovators, problem-solvers and change-makers work together to create technology that advances the world of finance. We embrace new ideas, challenge what's possible and empower our teams to make a lasting impact. If you're ready to help shape the future of fintech, Unlock your next chapter with FIS.

About the role:
As a Lead, Capability Experience Designer, you will design human-centered experiences that help colleagues build capabilities, adopt new behaviors and perform effectively in their roles. You will translate complex business and capability needs into intuitive, accessible and scalable experiences that fit naturally within colleague workflows.

Working across learning, workforce design, performance, digital adoption and change initiatives, you will research colleague needs, map journeys, prototype solutions and use experience signals to continuously improve. You will also use AI to enhance how you work and design AI-enabled experiences that help colleagues adopt new ways of working.

What you will be doing:

  • Design human-centered capability experiences that help colleagues build skills, adopt new behaviors and improve performance.
  • Translate business and capability needs into clear experience journeys, workflows, prototypes and scalable enablement solutions.
  • Conduct user research and identify colleague needs, behaviors, pain points and barriers to adoption.
  • Prototype and test experience concepts, using colleague feedback, adoption data and performance signals to guide iteration.
  • Design prompts, tools, routines and workflow interventions that support behavior and habit formation.
  • Create connected experiences across enterprise platforms, learning technologies, digital adoption tools and moments that matter.
  • Use AI tools to accelerate research, synthesis, ideation, prototyping and solution development.
  • Design AI-enabled experiences and human-plus-AI workflows that balance automation with appropriate human judgment.
  • Partner across learning, workforce design, performance, digital adoption, change and technology to deliver cohesive experiences.
  • Ensure experiences are accessible, inclusive, intuitive and consistent with enterprise standards.

Required qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in human-centered design, user experience design, learning sciences, psychology, business, technology, information systems or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience applying human-centered design, user experience, service design or learning experience design principles to practical solutions.
  • Ability to translate business or capability needs into experience journeys, workflows, prototypes and scalable enablement solutions.
  • Experience conducting user research, testing concepts and using qualitative and quantitative signals to improve designs.
  • Working knowledge of journey mapping, prototyping, behavioral design, usability, accessibility and inclusive design.
  • Experience using AI tools to support research, analysis, ideation, content development or prototyping, with the ability to evaluate outputs and apply human judgment.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft 365 tools, including Teams, SharePoint and Copilot, as well as learning or digital adoption platforms and other design tools/systems.
  • Ability to interpret experience, adoption or performance data using Excel, Power BI or comparable tools.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain design decisions, influence stakeholders and constructively challenge assumptions.
  • Ability to learn new technologies, manage multiple priorities and iterate quickly in an evolving environment.
  • A portfolio or work examples demonstrating research, experience design, prototyping, testing and iteration.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience supporting workforce enablement, organizational transformation, performance improvement or change initiatives.
  • Experience designing capability experiences across multiple enterprise systems, channels or colleague touchpoints.
  • Familiarity with Workday Learning, Arist, Whatfix, Reejig or comparable learning and digital adoption platforms.
  • Experience designing AI-enabled learning, enablement or performance-support experiences.
  • Familiarity with agentic or automated workflows and appropriate human review points.

A career at FIS is more than just a job. It’s the chance to shape the future of fintech. At FIS, we offer you:

  • A voice in the future of fintech
  • Always-on learning and development
  • Collaborative work environment
  • Opportunities to give back
  • Competitive salary and benefits

title: CNC Specialist (2nd shift)
description:
Job Title: CNC Specialist

Division: Precision Pulley and Idler

Location: Corning, Iowa - On-site

Shift: 2nd

Salary Grade: 2

FLSA: Non-Exempt

Physical Grade: 2

Job Status: Full-Time

Travel Required: N/A

Reports To: Production Supervisor

Revision Date: September 9, 2024

PURPOSE OF POSITION

Produce defined quantity of parts and components according to company and customer specifications.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

The following duties are normal for this position. These are not to be construed as exclusive or all inclusive. Other duties may be required and assigned.

More specifically, the person will:

  • Machine components to the proper dimensions and tolerances.
  • Determine the sequence of operations and set up requirements. Select proper fixtures, tooling, accessories, and materials to be completed.
  • Write programs for standard and special run parts.
  • Ensure all parts and components are accurate according to specifications.
  • Use and understand various paperwork, including but not limited to schedules, prints, & tech standards.
  • Perform general housekeeping and maintenance on equipment.
  • Perform extra assignments in other areas and related task assignments within the work area.
  • Regular, consistent attendance.

QUALIFICATIONS

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Strong commitment to quality and working safely.
  • Ability to read various measuring devices (e.g., measuring tape, caliper, micrometer, etc.).
  • Ability to work independently or as a team with minimal supervision.
  • Demonstrate ability to study and understand blueprints, sketches, drawings, manuals, specifications, or sample parts to determine dimensions and tolerances of finished product.
  • Calculate and set controls to produce quality parts in the most efficient manner.
  • Verify conformance of finished product using various measuring tools.
  • Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. Ability to compute rate and percent.
  • Ability to deal with situations involving a few concrete variables in standardized situations.

EDUCATION – EXPERIENCE – COMPUTER SKILLS

  • High school diploma or a general education degree (GED);
  • or one to three months related experience and/or training;
  • or equivalent combination of education and experience.

TRAINING – CERTIFICATIONS – LICENSES

  • Forklift license
  • Continually participate in additional training related to the job.

COMPETENCIES

To perform this position successfully, individual should demonstrate the following work competencies:

  • Safety and Security - Observes safety and security procedures; uses equipment properly.
  • Problem Solving - Identifies and resolves issues in a timely manner.
  • Communication Skills – Speaks clearly, listens and receives clarification, respond to questions.
  • Dependability - Follows instructions, responds to management direction, and takes responsibility.
  • Quality Assurance - Demonstrates accuracy and thoroughness.
  • Ethics/Professionalism - Treats people with respect; works ethically and with integrity.
  • Organizational Support - Follows policies and procedures.
  • Judgment - Exhibits sound and accurate judgment.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this position, the employee:

  • Must be able to frequently stoop/bend.
  • Must be able to regularly use hands and arms.
  • Must be able to regularly stand and walk.
  • Must be able to regularly lift and/or move up to 50 pounds of equipment.
  • Must be able to occasionally lift and/or move more than 50 pounds of equipment with assist available.
  • Specific vision abilities required by this job include close, distance, color, and peripheral vision.
  • Specific hearing abilities required for this job include the ability to hear equipment alarms and the ability to hear instructions from others.

ENVIRONMENTAL ADAPTABILITY

  • The noise level in the work environment is usually LOUD.
  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally exposed to wet or humid conditions (non-weather), outdoor weather conditions and extreme heat (non-weather).
  • The employee is frequently exposed to fumes or airborne particles and vibration.
  • Steel-toe safety shoes, safety glasses, and hearing protection required where posted. Additional PPE may be required when working in other areas.

OTHER DUTIES

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee owner for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Precision, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, the employer will provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities and encourage prospective and current employee owners to discuss potential accommodations with Precision, Inc.

title: Scrum Master/Project Manager
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Scrum Master/Project Manager based in Brazil.

This is a senior Agile leadership role focused on strengthening delivery discipline and consistency across a broad engineering organization. You will establish and continuously improve Agile standards across 12 teams while coaching a cohort of Scrum Masters and directly supporting two teams. The role combines hands-on Scrum Master responsibilities with ownership of delivery, quality, and engineering performance metrics. You will turn Jira and GitHub activity into reliable insights that help technical and business leaders understand delivery health. Acting as a key bridge between Product Management, Product Owners, and Engineering, you will connect roadmap priorities with practical sprint execution. This is an opportunity to shape Agile ways of working at scale while remaining closely connected to day-to-day software delivery.

Accountabilities:

  • Establish and maintain consistent Agile ceremonies, operating standards, definitions of ready and done, estimation practices, cadences, and escalation processes across 12 teams.
  • Coach and provide performance support to 6–7 Scrum Masters while facilitating a Scrum Master community of practice.
  • Resolve cross-team delivery impediments and coordinate dependencies across the engineering portfolio.
  • Serve as Scrum Master for two assigned teams, managing ceremonies, backlog hygiene, delivery flow, and impediment removal.
  • Own and continuously evolve an Agile Development Metrics & Quality Accountability Framework using Jira and GitHub as primary systems of record.
  • Implement and monitor delivery metrics including velocity, sprint predictability, cycle time, lead time, throughput, WIP, scope creep, and carryover rates.
  • Develop code review quality metrics from GitHub pull request activity, including review cycles, rework, time in review, change-requested rates, and senior reviewer participation.
  • Own Jira defect taxonomy and reporting across development, testing, code review, release, and production phases, including defect escape and containment metrics.
  • Maintain traceability between escaped defects, originating stories or tasks, merged pull requests, and responsible authors or reviewers.
  • Lead recurring release and quarterly team accountability reporting, reviewing trends and improvement areas with relevant teams and leadership.
  • Administer eazyBI or an equivalent BI layer connected to Jira and GitHub to deliver recurring dashboards and reports without relying on a separate data pipeline.
  • Ensure metrics remain actionable, balanced between speed and quality, trend-focused, diagnostic rather than target-driven, and passively generated from existing workflows.
  • Act as the primary Agile conduit between Product Managers, Product Owners, and Engineering, translating roadmap priorities into coordinated execution.
  • Apply scaled Agile approaches such as SAFe, Scrum@Scale, or equivalent frameworks to support cross-team dependencies, release planning, and backlog alignment.
  • Facilitate program-level ceremonies including PI planning, Scrum of Scrums, and cross-team dependency reviews.
  • Provide Product Management and Product Ownership with clear delivery and quality insights to support prioritization and roadmap decisions.

    • Requirements:

    • Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent professional experience.
    • 5+ years of experience as a Scrum Master or Agile Project Manager within a professional software development environment.
    • Demonstrated experience coaching or leading other Scrum Masters and supporting Agile practices across multiple concurrent teams.
    • Strong experience facilitating Agile ceremonies, delivery processes, cross-team coordination, and dependency management.
    • Working knowledge of scaled Agile methodologies such as SAFe, Scrum@Scale, or LeSS.
    • Experience working closely with Product Management, Product Owners, and Engineering teams as a bridge between product strategy and technical delivery.
    • Hands-on proficiency administering Jira, including custom fields, workflows, sprint configuration, and board management.
    • Working knowledge of GitHub pull request workflows, branch protection, and Jira–GitHub integration, including smart commits and related references.
    • Demonstrated ability to design, implement, and continuously improve delivery and quality measurement frameworks.
    • Ability to translate technical delivery and engineering data into clear reporting and actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders.
    • Familiarity with AI-assisted engineering tools and modern software development workflows.

      • Benefits:

      • Fully remote position.
      • Full-time opportunity with broad responsibility across a 12-team engineering organization.
      • Opportunity to coach and support a team of Scrum Masters while influencing Agile practices at scale.
      • High-impact role connecting Product Management, Product Ownership, and Engineering.
      • Exposure to advanced delivery, quality, BI, Jira, and GitHub-based engineering metrics.
      • Opportunity to shape and evolve organization-wide Agile standards and accountability practices.
      • Direct involvement in scaled Agile planning, cross-team coordination, and software delivery improvement.

description:

  • Proven ability to lead complex technical programs across multiple fields and organizations.

  • Strong technical leadership, communication, and influencing skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • PhD/MS in Materials Science, Electrical Engineering, Physics, Chemistry, or related field.

  • 15+ years of semiconductor process development, pathfinding, or advanced R&D experience.

Join a team where curiosity is currency, collaboration is culture, and your work directly builds the memory that powers AI, mobile, automotive, and data center innovation worldwide. If crafting the future of NAND technology excites you, this is where you belong!

description:
Who we are

Lesaffre is a key global player in the fermentation of microorganisms (yeasts and bacteria) for baking, taste, healthcare and industrial biotechnology. This story began more than 170 years ago in northern France, and, thanks to our pioneer spirit and our innovative approach, we are constantly developing.

Lesaffre's global presence includes 11,000 employees from 96 nationalities and a 3-billion euro turnover. We work with customers, partners and researchers to develop essential nutrients and bio actives that strengthen human health, optimize animal well-being and improve plant nutrition.

This role is within our Biospringer team. Biospringer offers our customers a range of yeast extracts and fermentation-based products designed to improve the taste and organoleptic properties of food. Our natural ingredients make food tastier and healthier.

Our Core Values: Passion, respect, trust, entrepreneurship, and humility

What we offer

  • The opportunity to represent a passionate organization focused on innovation and sustainability
  • A competitive 401K plan, affordable benefits starting on day 1 of employment, and 12 paid holidays
  • The ability to utilize your experience and knowledge to make a real impact
  • Opportunities for continuous growth within your role and across business units

What you bring to the table

The Lead Dryer Operator ensures that product is processed and packaged correctly and in a timely manner. This requires a wide range of knowledge and skills, many of which can be learned on the job. The Lead Dryer Operator reports directly to the Production Supervisor. The Lead Dryer Operator may also receive direction from Superintendent or other management personnel as required. This position is a 12-hour, rotating shift from 6 PM to 6 AM.

What you’ll do as a Lead Dryer Operator

The drying and packaging of food products requires flexibility on the part of all personnel as operations change depending upon the needs of the customer. This will require a Lead Dryer Operator to train and work in other departments on a periodic basis to ensure customer requirements are met in a timely manner.

Job Responsibilities

  • Understand and follow safety, GMP, food safety, and other rules or policies.
  • Perform safe sanitation on equipment, infrastructure, grounds, and other assigned areas.
  • Responsible for reading and understanding material safety data sheets for chemicals used for cleaning or ingredients.
  • Follow and direct all procedures on precautions of wearing PPE when working around chemicals or ingredients.
  • Monitor quality assurance controls during the production on Dryers & Packaging, for example: metal checks, weight checks, and code date verifications are performed on a routine basis and records are maintain, accurate written, and electronic information is documented to ensure the customer receives a quality product.
  • Follow and direct the established processes for CIP procedures.
  • Record and maintain accurate written and electronic information for CIPs, or any other documents required by the company to regulate downtime, parameters, procedures and equipment through basic analysis, simple calculations, and computer controls.
  • Verification and finalize of batch paperwork.
  • Inspect Dryer & Pack line infrastructure, monitor equipment, and notify operators, Supervisor, and management when maintenance is required.
  • Call maintenance and access MAPCON to write Work Order as needed.
  • Assist in troubleshooting of Drying & Packaging equipment with maintenance and help if needed on Process problems.
  • Assign work to team members depending upon the production schedule and according to changes of operational needs.
  • Communicate and direct other employees respectfully, and in an effective manner.
  • Learn and Train on all equipment in Drying and Packaging lines safely and efficiently to cover Call ins and Vacation.
  • Dedicated to one shift to focus on Drying and Packing side.
  • First called to cover on the opposite shift (Day Lead covers for day shift and Night Lead for night shift).

Use above “Job Responsibilities” when covering for a Lead Process Operator:

  • Cover SAP duties for the Process side.
  • Monitor quality assurance controls during the production of Process. For example: autolysis, separation, filtration, concentration, product analysis, weight checks, and code date verifications are performed on a routine basis to ensure the customer receives a quality product. Ensure records are maintain, accurate written, and electronic information is documented.
  • Inspect Process infrastructure, monitor Process equipment.

Required qualifications:

  • High school diploma or 3 years minimum of experience in similar position.

  • Ability to follow instructions, learn and ask questions.

  • Mechanical aptitude and trouble-shooting skills.
  • Good people skills.
  • Ability to manage time and look ahead.
  • Ability to work as part of a team and independently.
  • Ability to be forklift certified required.
  • Read and comprehend simple instructions, short correspondence, and memos. Write simple correspondence. Effectively present information in one-on-one and small group situations to customers, clients, and other employees of the organization.
  • Add and subtract two-digit numbers and to multiply and divide with 10’s and 100’s. Perform simple mathematical analysis using the units of money, weight, volume, and distance.
  • Apply common sense understanding to carry out simple one- or two-step instructions. Solve standardized problems with few or no variables. Use learned experience to solve more detailed and complex problems.
  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand; walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; and reach with hands and arms; occasionally required to climb or balance and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee is occasionally required to sit and talk or hear. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 60 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, and ability to adjust focus.
  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to dry and dusty and/or humid conditions; moving mechanical parts; high, precarious places; fumes or airborne particles; toxic or caustic chemicals; extreme cold or extreme heat. The noise level in the work environment is usually loud.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Knowledge of manufacturing and packaging processes preferred.

Food Quality, Safety, and Legality Commitment

Bio Springer North America Corporation (BSNAC) and its employees will ensure that all products meet quality, food safety and legality requirements in compliance with all applicable laws and regulations and that food safety will never be compromised. BSNAC will utilize BRC Standards as our way of operation every day. I understand that as an employee of BSNAC, this is part of my day to day responsibilities, in addition to the job description of my position.

title: Utility
description:

PURPOSE OF POSITION

The Utility will operate and/or perform a variety of tasks and job duties on a regular basis. While performing these tasks, the Utility will be expected to produce defined quantities of parts and components according to company and customer specifications.

  • Handle multiple projects and exercise disciplined time management.
  • Ability to interact with Management Team in a professional manner to continually enhance the company’s performance.

EDUCATION – EXPERIENCE – COMPUTER SKILLS

  • High school diploma or a general education degree (GED); or
  • One to three months related experience and/or training; or

TRAINING – CERTIFICATIONS – LICENSES

  • PPI welding certification preferred but not required.

COMPETENCIES

  • Safety and Security - Observes safety and security procedures; Uses equipment properly.
  • Problem Solving - Identifies and resolves issues in a timely manner.
  • Communication Skills – Speaks clearly, listens and receives clarification, respond to questions.
  • Dependability - Follows instructions, responds to management direction, and takes responsibility.
  • Quality Assurance - Demonstrates accuracy and thoroughness.
  • Ethics/Professionalism - Treats people with respect; Works ethically and with integrity.
  • Organizational Support - Follows policies and procedures.
  • Judgment - Exhibits sound and accurate judgment.


PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with to disabilities perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this position, the employee:

  • Must be able to frequently stoop/bend.
  • Must be able to regularly use hands and arms.
  • Must be able to regularly stand and walk.
  • Must be able to frequently lift and/or move up to 50 pounds.
  • Must be occasionally lift and/or move up to 100 pounds with assist available.
  • Specific vision abilities required by this job include close, distance, and peripheral vision.


ENVIRONMENTAL ADAPTABILITY

  • The noise level in the work environment is usually LOUD.
  • Occasionally exposed to toxic chemicals and extreme heat (non-weather).
  • Frequently exposed to work near moving mechanical parts.
  • Regularly exposed to fumes and airborne particles.
  • Steel-toe safety shoes, safety glasses, hearing protection, and protective gloves. Additional PPE may be required depending on the work area.

Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Precision, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, The Employer will provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities and encourages prospective employees and incumbents to discuss potential accommodations with Precision, Inc.

title: Data Analyst
location: Freedom Central HQ, West Columbia, SC, US
description:
JOB PURPOSE


The Data Analyst will be responsible for maintaining the integrity, accuracy, and strategic utilization of data across the Right to Bear Association. This position will support executive leadership by providing actionable insights into membership growth, retention, sales performance, marketing effectiveness, partner performance, and operational efficiency. The Data Analyst will serve as the primary owner of RTBA's reporting infrastructure, HubSpot data management, dashboard development, and business intelligence initiatives. Success in this position will be demonstrated by the ability to transform raw data into meaningful insights that drive revenue growth, improve member retention, increase operational efficiency, and support strategic decision-making.


DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES


Data Management & Reporting

  • Maintain data accuracy, integrity, and organization within HubSpot and company reporting systems.
  • Develop and deliver executive dashboards, KPI reports, and business performance analytics.

Business Intelligence & Analysis

  • Analyze sales, membership, retention, and marketing performance to identify trends and growth opportunities.
  • Provide actionable recommendations to leadership based on data-driven insights.

Operational Support

  • Assist with forecasting, budgeting, and strategic planning initiatives.
  • Support departments with data requests, reporting automation, and process improvement projects.

Other

  • All other duties as assigned.


QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in data Analytics, Business Analytics, Information Systems, Statistics, Finance, Economics, Computer Science, or related field.
  • MBA preferred but not required.
  • 2-5 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or reporting.
  • Experience with CRM systems, preferably HubSpot.
  • Experience building dashboards and automated reporting systems.
  • Strong understanding of business metrics and performance measurement.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel.
  • HubSpot reporting experience preferred.
  • Data visualization and dashboard development.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

WORKING CONDITIONS


This is a remote position. While performing the duties of this position, the employee is subject to a typical office environment, including PC and phone usage. Specific job assignments may require day, evening, weekend, or holiday hours. Additional training may be required based on business needs.


PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS


PC and moderate phone usage. Sitting for long periods of time. Will be required to travel out of state once per month.


DIRECT REPORTS

N/A



Must be 18 years or older.


WE ARE AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Export Control Compliance Notice

This position may involve access to technology or software source code subject to U.S. export control laws (ITAR/EAR). Employment is contingent on verifying U.S. Person status or obtaining any necessary export license/confirming the availability of a license exception. Applicants must provide information for export control screening, which will be reviewed for compliance. Freedom Central Holdings may elect not to pursue a license or exception and may decline to proceed with an applicant on that basis.

Location: Remote.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure.
  • Experience with CI/CD and Salesforce DevOps tools.
  • Experience modernizing legacy systems and implementing enterprise cloud solutions.
  • Experience leading technical teams and mentoring Salesforce professionals.

title: Engineering Technician
description:
Position Title: Engineering Technician – Technical Expert
Department: Engineering
Location: Omaha, NE

About AGI

AGI is a global food-based infrastructure company publicly traded in Canada. With over 3,800 employees and over 30 global manufacturing brands, AGI is a leading provider of equipment and technology solutions for agricultural commodities including seed, fertilizer, grain and feed systems and an expanding platform for food processing facilities.

The Opportunity

The role is a skilled technical contributor assisting production, customers, and service with automation related tasks for the AGI NECO Dryer systems. Responsibilities include assuring that the Engineered to Order (ETO) control packages match mechanical elements, working with development team to better understand the needs of customers and provide feedback from customers to drive continuous improvement projects and. It is essential that this individual possesses hands-on experience with equipment control panels, PLC and HMI Program analysis, and schematic development. Additionally, this role will be responsible for diagnosing customer and production equipment issues to determine if issues are controls or hardware related, troubleshooting all controls related issues, and providing solution based step-by-step instructions for those issues.

Responsibilities:

  • Partner with sales and technical experts in support of the needs of customers and production.
  • Customer forward electrical and controls system diagnostics.
  • PLC Program understanding and troubleshooting methods related to both digital and analog I/O.
  • An understanding of Variable Frequency Drives (VFD) and ability to perform(learn) VFD parameter setup.
  • Research, evaluate, and recommend solutions for customer field and controls issues.
  • Navigate and understand the functions of equipment HMI interfaces.
  • Self-learning of equipment, field devices and control hardware as needed to diagnose customer issues.
  • Collaborating with the Development Engineering team to improve all existing offerings and support continuous improvement initiatives.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering with 0-2 years of experience with PLC based automation or an associate’s degree in electrical engineering, Certificate/Degree in Automation development and/or PLC programming with 2-5 years of hands-on process automation/control design experience including PLC and HMI programming.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Understanding of industrial electrical schematics.
  • Understanding of controls/automation systems and Control Theory.
  • PLC Programming Experience preferred.
  • Competency in navigating industrial networks a bonus.
  • Strong collaboration and interpersonal communication capability.
  • Attention to detail and ability to prioritize and manage time well.
  • Self-directed and results oriented.
  • MS Office platform proficient including Visio & Project
  • Understanding of industrial electrical schematics.

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE, Compute Node Team)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE, Compute Node Team) based in Spain.

This is a senior Site Reliability Engineering role focused on the infrastructure that runs and manages virtual machines across a large-scale cloud platform.
You will work close to the Linux operating system, hypervisor, and node-level services that form the foundation of the compute environment.
The role combines deep Linux systems engineering, virtualization, containerization, observability, and production reliability.
You will investigate complex issues involving CPU, memory, NUMA, cgroups, scheduling, and system performance across user and kernel space.
You will also help shape reliability practices through strong monitoring, incident response, root-cause analysis, and postmortem processes.
Collaboration with platform, kernel, hypervisor, GPU, and infrastructure teams will be central to improving system design and operability.
This is an opportunity to influence critical compute infrastructure supporting demanding AI and cloud workloads at significant scale.

Accountabilities

  • Ensure the reliability, availability, and performance of compute nodes responsible for running virtual machines.
  • Analyze and debug complex Linux systems across both user space and kernel space.
  • Investigate system capabilities, limitations, dependencies, and trade-offs across different layers of the operating system and infrastructure stack.
  • Troubleshoot complex production issues involving CPU, memory, NUMA, cgroups, and scheduling.
  • Work hands-on with virtualization technologies, primarily QEMU/KVM and Linux-native technologies.
  • Analyze VM lifecycle behavior, performance characteristics, resource utilization, and failure modes.
  • Support and improve containerized workloads using Linux-native mechanisms such as namespaces and cgroups.
  • Design and evolve observability for the compute node layer, including metrics, logs, traces, alerts, SLIs, and SLOs.
  • Build reliability signals that provide clear and actionable insight into system behavior.
  • Lead or contribute to incident response, ensuring production issues are diagnosed and resolved efficiently.
  • Conduct structured root-cause analysis and develop corrective actions for recurring or systemic reliability issues.
  • Lead and contribute to postmortems focused on long-term reliability improvements rather than short-term remediation alone.
  • Identify opportunities to automate operational processes and improve the resilience of compute infrastructure.
  • Collaborate closely with platform, kernel/hypervisor, GPU, and infrastructure teams on system design and operational improvements.
  • Contribute to improving the operability, scalability, and maintainability of node-level services.
  • Investigate performance issues across multiple layers of the compute stack and develop practical engineering solutions.
  • Help establish reliability and observability as core capabilities of the compute platform.

    • Requirements:

    • Significant professional experience in Site Reliability Engineering, Systems Engineering, Linux infrastructure, or a closely related field.
    • Deep expertise in Linux, including strong understanding of both user space and kernel space.
    • Knowledge of important Linux kernel subsystems, including scheduling, memory management, filesystems, cgroups, and namespaces.
    • Strong understanding of system boundaries, constraints, dependencies, and trade-offs across different infrastructure layers.
    • Hands-on experience with QEMU/KVM and a solid understanding of virtualization technologies.
    • Understanding of virtual machine lifecycles, performance characteristics, resource management, and failure modes.
    • Practical experience with containers, Linux namespaces, and cgroups.
    • Strong understanding of resource isolation, allocation, and control in containerized environments.
    • Excellent debugging skills and the ability to reason systematically about complex system failures.
    • Structured, hypothesis-driven approach to incident investigation and troubleshooting.
    • Strong understanding of the SRE discipline, including the relationship between software engineering, operations, reliability, and system design.
    • Experience building and operating observability stacks, rather than simply consuming existing monitoring dashboards.
    • Ability to translate complex system behavior into actionable reliability signals, alerts, SLIs, and SLOs.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate issues across operating-system and infrastructure layers.
    • Experience operating production systems and responding effectively to reliability and performance incidents.
    • Strong communication and collaboration skills when working with multidisciplinary infrastructure and engineering teams.
    • Ability to take ownership of complex technical problems and drive them through investigation, resolution, and long-term improvement.
    • Experience with Kubernetes internals or node-level components is an advantage.
    • Hands-on experience with low-level Linux debugging tools such as perf, eBPF, ftrace, strace, or kernel crash dumps is beneficial.
    • Familiarity with large-scale compute or bare-metal infrastructure is a plus.
    • Contributions to open-source infrastructure or systems software are advantageous.
    • Experience debugging hardware- and driver-level issues, including GPUs, NVLink, or InfiniBand, is a strong plus.

      • Benefits:

      • Competitive compensation.
      • Career growth and continuous learning opportunities.
      • Flexibility and significant ownership in your work.
      • Collaborative and innovative engineering environment.
      • Opportunity to work on impactful AI and cloud infrastructure projects.
      • Exposure to large-scale compute, Linux systems, virtualization, and distributed infrastructure.
      • Opportunity to collaborate with highly skilled international engineering teams.
      • Inclusive workplace committed to equal employment opportunities.
      • Workplace accommodations available during the application process where required.
      • Employment is subject to authorization to work in the country where the position is based.

title: Associate Claims Adjudicator
description:
Why join Agricorp?

Are you looking for a meaningful career? Agricorp has an opportunity for an Associate Claims Adjudicator, supporting the farmers of Ontario when they need it most. Associate Claims adjudicators help deliver financial and risk management government programs for Ontario’s agriculture sector. They’re a vital part of the Claims Services team, working alongside customer-oriented professionals in Agricorp’s Program Delivery division, and are responsible for determining program benefits across a suite of different programs.

  • Paid vacation days and sick leave to support your overall well-being
  • Work-life balance with supportive leaders who respect your time outside of work
  • Opportunities for learning and growth, including mentoring, coaching, and support for professional development

The Role

Associate Claims Adjudicators conduct financial reviews and analysis to determine the eligibility of claims. They also verify customer production information, and process claims and claim payments for programs delivered by Agricorp.

In this role, you will:

  • Review, verify and approve applications through the claims process by assessing the application against coverage, reviewing data for completeness, researching and investigating discrepancies, and calculating program benefits in accordance with Agricorp’s policies and best practices
  • Identify and escalate high-risk issues to senior team members
  • Provide technical guidance to agents and producers related to Agricorp's suite of programs
  • Maintain professional working relationships with producers and agents

Job status: Permanent Full-time (posting for existing vacancy)
Salary: $58,208 - $68,480
Work Status: Full time in office
Location: Guelph, Ontario

What you bring

  • Post-secondary degree or College diploma in finance, business, commerce, economics, agriculture or related field, or equivalent experience; additional training in accounting, risk analysis/risk management, or financial analysis, an asset
  • 1-2 years of experience in claims or risk adjudication, preferably in the financial services or agricultural sectors
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate clearly to diverse groups, including clients, brokers, agents and other professionals
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to work in a collaborative team environment
  • Agricultural knowledge is an asset

Key Competencies

  • Quality Focus – Attends to the task at hand to minimize errors and provide consistent delivery of work to the highest possible standard
  • Client focus – Meets the expectations of internal and external customers through establishing effective relationships, gaining trust and respect
  • Analytical thinking –Uses facts and available information to develop logical assumptions
  • Critical judgment, decision making and problem solving – Makes the best decision, in a timely manner, based upon a combination of analysis, knowledge, experience and judgement
  • Initiative – Identifies and handles issues and situations to take action; seizing opportunities when they arise
  • Efficiency – Effectively plan and organize time and resources to prioritize work to effectively meet objectives

Background

Agricorp, an agency of the government of Ontario.

Agricorp delivers government programs. These programs help protect the livelihood of over 47,000 Ontario farmers against the many risks farm businesses face every day. Our employees are skilled professionals who respond when industry and government need us, manage public funds with great care and integrity, and deliver a quality customer experience.

Agricorp helps grow Ontario agriculture. We underwrite $6-8 billion in risk each year. The agency was established in 1997, and since then we’ve made over $8 billion in payments to farmers when they needed it most.

description:

Lead Talent Acquisition Partner, Americas

Reports to the Head of Americas, Talent Acquisition

About Agilent

As a global leader in laboratory and clinical technologies, we are passionate about bringing great science to life. Our commitment to quality and innovation supports cutting-edge life science research, patient diagnostics, and ensures the safety of water, food, and pharmaceuticals. As scientists and clinicians pursue small, everyday advances and life-changing discoveries, we provide trusted answers to their most critical questions and challenges.

Leveraging more than 50 years of expertise, we create advanced instruments, software, and consumables supported by teams of highly skilled and knowledgeable people. With 18,000 employees around the world, our global reach and comprehensive solutions provide the most reliable and accurate results, as well as optimal scientific, economic, and operational outcomes. We work collaboratively with our customers on their journey to make a real difference in human lives. Our culture is founded on trust, respect, and uncompromising integrity, and we pride ourselves on being a dynamic and inclusive workplace that celebrates diversity and fosters innovation.

We can’t wait for you to join us as we continue our mission to improve the world around us. Information about Agilent is available at Agilent.com.

The Lead Talent Acquisition Partner, Americas plays a pivotal role in shaping the organization's future by identifying, attracting, and hiring top talent. This individual will partner closely with hiring managers and HR leaders across the organization to understand business objectives and develop recruitment strategies that align with the company's mission and strategic priorities.

As Lead Talent Acquisition Partner, Americas, this leader will serve as the Americas TA point of contact for one of our functions/businesses: Commercial, Operations, Enabling Functions, Technology, or Business Groups. This individual will partner closely with the aligned HRBP and hiring managers to conduct req activity oversight, execution of select reqs as part of a pod structure of TA delivery, and demonstrate active communication, reporting, and cross collaboration to achieve candidate, hiring manager, and stakeholder experience excellence.

As a trusted advisor, the Lead Talent Acquisition Partner, Americas will bring forward an ownership mentality, strategic insights, process excellence, and TA Advisory orientation as a business partner – demonstrating depth of knowledge of a customer base, talent market, and insights related to the respective business or function. The Lead Talent Acquisition Partner will executive full-cycle

recruitments, from sourcing and screening candidates to extending offers and ensuring a best-in class candidate experience. As part of a team/pod, the Lead Talent Acquisition Partner will work to develop robust talent pipelines and leverage data-driven insights to optimize hiring outcomes.   • Research, design, and implement tailored recruitment strategies for newly assigned requisitions.

  • Champion a continuous improvement mindset by leveraging metrics, feedback, and best practices to evolve hiring strategies and optimize processes.

  • Proven ability to act as a trusted advisor, influencing and partnering with leaders at all levels, including executives, through strong consultative communication.

  • Excellent sourcing, networking, and market research skills.

  • Strong data-driven decision-making skills with experience analyzing trends and refining recruiting strategies.

  • Action-oriented, with proven ability to lead key initiatives, motivate teams and drive decisions to closure.

Monday - Friday 10:30AM - 7:00PM | Position Pay Range: $17.70 - $21.30

Summary/Objective:

The Patient Service Representative (PSR) focuses on the delivery of patient care and facilitates the needs of the physician. Focuses purely on the patient in front of them and ensures the patient knows and feels that they are the most important person in that moment. Creates an environment where our patients know they are a priority and provides spectacular service by doing what is necessary to take care of the patient. Performs administrative tasks such as answering phones, data entry, patient check in/out, and assists in scheduling patient appointments. Enters charges, verifies patients’ insurance coverage, receives payments from patients, and issues receipts. Supports company initiatives by adopting new approaches, practices, and processes to deliver unmistakable quality, spectacular service, and operational excellence on a consistent basis.

Essential Functions

1. Answers inbound calls to the Center.

2. Provides a friendly and warm greeting to all patients and/or providers.

3. Checks scheduled patients in/out and ensures proper documentation is received from patient.

4. Collects co-pays, co-insurance, and deductible if necessary.

5. Listens and resolves patient, provider, and any customer complaints. Communicates to PSR Lead and/or Area Manager as needed.

6. Ensures accurate data entry for patient registration.

7. Assists with medical records as needed.

8. Ensures all queues are processed in a timely and efficient manner while adhering to all process & compliance requirements.

9. Manages eRIS Center workflow, including daily schedule, billing complete, priors grid, delinquent exams, waitlist, report delivery queues, and collection of TOS.

10. Stays abreast of known carrier related issues and is able to identify carrier specific concerns, (i.e. out of network, specific plan limitations, etc.)

11. Monitors schedule and ensures all data, attachments, history, etc. have been done before exam is completed.

12. Facilitates no-show appointments (calling patients, cancelling, rescheduling).

13. Reschedules and cancels appointments as needed/directed (receives incoming/outgoing calls to patients).

14. Monitors waiting room to avoid extended wait time and to assists patients as needed.

15. Requests orders and processes new/same-day requests.

16. Requests all patients complete a satisfaction survey after their exam.

17. Other duties as assigned.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Competencies

1. Communication Proficiency.

2. Organizational Skills.

3. Time Management.

4. Problem Solving/Analysis.

5. Customer/Client Focus.

6. Collaboration Skills.

Supervisory Responsibilities

This position has no supervision responsibilities.

title: Claims Adjudicator
description:
Why Join Agricorp?

Are you looking for a meaningful career? Are you someone who thrives on solving complex problems, asking the right questions, and thinking a few steps ahead? Let’s put that thinking to work.

Agricorp has an opportunity for a Claims Adjudicator, supporting the farmers of Ontario when they need it most. Claims Adjudicators help deliver financial and risk management government programs for Ontario’s agriculture sector. They’re a vital part of the Claims Services team, working alongside customer-oriented professionals in Agricorp’s Program Delivery division, and are responsible for determining program benefits across a suite of different programs.

We believe our employees are our greatest strength, which is why we offer:

  • Comprehensive health and dental benefits to keep you and your family well
  • Pension plan to support your long-term financial security
  • Paid vacation days and sick leave to support your overall well-being
  • Work-life balance with supportive leaders who respect your time outside of work
  • Opportunities for learning and growth, including mentoring, coaching, and support for professional development

The Role

Claims Adjudicators conduct production and financial analysis of farming operations to determine the eligibility of claims for programs delivered by Agricorp.

In this role, you will:

  • Review, verify and approve large and/or complex claims applications of varying complexity and payment value in accordance with program guidelines
  • Participate in claims file discussions and collaborate with senior quality advisors, claims specialists, or team leaders on cases requiring further approvals, legal counsel, or potential appeals.
  • Provide technical guidance to agents and producers related to Agricorp's suite of programs.
  • Identify and escalate high-risk issues to specialists or team leaders, as required.
  • Coach and provide technical guidance to junior members of the team and peers across the organization.
  • Maintain professional working relationships with producers and agents.

Job status: Permanent Full-time (posting for an existing vacancy)
Salary: $66,339 - $78,045
Work Status: Full-time in office
Location: Guelph, Ontario

What You Bring

  • Post-secondary degree or College diploma in finance, business, economics, commerce, agricultural science/management or related field, or equivalent experience; additional training in accounting, risk analysis/risk management, or financial analysis an asset
  • 3 or more years experience in claims or risk adjudication, preferably in the financial services or agricultural sectors
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate clearly, verbally and in writing, to diverse groups, including clients, brokers, agents, and other professionals
  • Demonstrated analytical and interpretive skills
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to work in a collaborative team environment
  • Agricultural knowledge is an asset

Key Competencies

  • Quality Focus – Attends to the task at hand to minimize errors and provide consistent delivery of work to the highest possible standard
  • Client focus – Meets the expectations of internal and external customers through establishing effective relationships, gaining trust and respect
  • Analytical thinking –Uses facts and available information to develop logical assumptions
  • Critical judgment, decision making and problem solving – Makes the best decision, in a timely manner, based upon a combination of analysis, knowledge, experience and judgement
  • Initiative – Identifies and handles issues and situations to take action; seizing opportunities when they arise
  • Efficiency – Effectively plan and organize time and resources to prioritize work to effectively meet objectives

Background

Agricorp, an agency of the government of Ontario.

Agricorp delivers government programs. These programs help protect the livelihood of over 47,000 Ontario farmers against the many risks farm businesses face every day. Our employees are skilled professionals who respond when industry and government need us, manage public funds with great care and integrity, and deliver a quality customer experience.

Agricorp helps grow Ontario agriculture. We underwrite $6-8 billion in risk each year. The agency was established in 1997, and since then we’ve made over $8 billion in payments to farmers when they needed it most.

title: Adjunct-Biomedical Engineering Instructor
description:
Biomedical Engineering

Adjunct Faculty Pool | John R. Post School of Engineering | Reading, Pennsylvania

The John R. Post School of Engineering at Alvernia University invites applications to its adjunct faculty pool in Biomedical Engineering. We seek professionals to teach both lecture and laboratory courses in person in Reading, Pennsylvania. Most engineering courses are taught at the John R. Post Center, 401 Penn Street, Reading, PA, with some activities potentially using other Alvernia Reading locations. Applicants must be available for weekday daytime teaching, primarily between 8:00 a.m. and 3:00 p.m. This daytime availability is an important requirement for these in-person positions. Lecture courses typically meet on multiple days each week, so applicants must be able to commit to a recurring weekday schedule for the full semester. Remote or hybrid teaching is not available for these pools. Hired candidates join the adjunct pool and may receive separate contracts for individual courses as needs arise. Pool appointment does not guarantee a course assignment.

Potential teaching areas

Biomechanics and Human Movement

Statics, dynamics, strength of materials, kinesiology, human movement, and related laboratory instruction.

Biomedical Instrumentation and Measurement

Circuit fundamentals, sensors, physiological measurement, instrumentation, data acquisition, measurement and dynamic response, and related laboratory work.

Biofluids and Physiological Systems

Fluid mechanics applied to biological systems, anatomy and physiology for engineers, and engineering analysis of physiological systems.

Medical Device Design and Regulatory Affairs

Medical device design, biomedical regulatory affairs, biomedical engineering design, interdisciplinary design projects, capstone instruction, and upper-level biomedical engineering electives.

Biostatistics and Biomedical Data Analysis

Biostatistics and quantitative analysis for biomedical engineering applications.

Preferred qualifications

We particularly welcome practicing engineers and technical professionals who can bring current industry experience into the classroom. Prior college teaching is not required. Preferred candidates will have at least a master's degree in Biomedical Engineering, Bioengineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a closely related field and approximately five or more years of relevant professional experience. These are preferred qualifications, not absolute minimums; comparable combinations of advanced education, professional licensure, specialized expertise, industry experience, research, and teaching will be considered. Completion of the Fundamentals of Engineering (FE) exam, Engineer in Training (EIT) certification, and/or Professional Engineer (PE) licensure is a plus.

Application and employment requirements

How to apply

All applications and application materials must be submitted through Alvernia University's ADP employment portal for the specific adjunct pool posting. Submit a current resume or curriculum vitae and a brief letter of interest identifying the courses or subject areas you believe you are qualified to teach. Do not email application materials. Email inquiries are welcome, but a formal application through ADP is required for consideration.

Work authorization

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States and able to accept employment with Alvernia University without current or future employer sponsorship.

Questions and inquiries

Prospective applicants may contact Dr. Joseph M. Mahoney, Chair of the John R. Post School of Engineering, at joseph.mahoney@alvernia.edu with questions about the School, the adjunct pool, or potential teaching needs. Application materials must be submitted through ADP and should not be emailed.

Equal employment opportunity

Alvernia University is an equal-opportunity employer committed to Franciscan values. People of all faith backgrounds, as well as people with no faith affiliation, are welcome and encouraged to apply. All employees share responsibility for advancing a culture of care in the performance of their roles while demonstrating service orientation, respect for all, intellectual curiosity, solution focus and innovation, and mutual accountability. Alvernia University strives to be a community supportive of diverse perspectives and identities.

title: Lead Data Scientist- Pro
description:

Position Purpose:

The Lead Data Scientist is responsible for leading data science initiatives that drive business profitability, increased efficiencies and improved customer experience. This role assists in the development of the Home Depot advanced analytics infrastructure that informs decision making by applying expertise of both business and Advanced Analytics Modeling techniques. Lead Data Scientists focus on seeking out business opportunities to leverage data science as a competitive advantage. Based on the specific data science team, this role has expertise in one or more data science specializations, such as optimization, computer vision, recommendation, search or NLP.


As a Lead Data Scientist, you will be responsible for large data science projects, identifying opportunities to leverage best technology and approach, and mentoring data scientists on the project team. This role is expected to own the library of reusable algorithms for future use, ensuring developed codes are documented. This role supports the building of skilled and talented data science teams by providing input to staffing needs and participating in the recruiting and hiring process. In addition, this role leads data science communities across several business units.


Key Responsibilities:

  • 30% Solution Development - Utilize expertise when designing and developing algorithms and models to use against large datasets to create business insights; Make appropriate selection, utilization and interpretation of advanced analytics methodologies; Effectively communicate insights and recommendations to both technical and non-technical leaders and business customers/partners; Clearly communicate impacts of recommendations to drive alignment and appropriate implementation
  • 25% Project Management & Team Support - Lead and manage large and complex projects and teams; Provide direction on prioritization of work and ensure quality of work; Provide mentoring and coaching to more junior roles to support their technical competencies; Collaborate with managers and team in the distribution of workload and resources; Support recruiting and hiring efforts for the team; Serve as a technical subject matter expert (SME) for one or more data science methods, both predictive and prescriptive; Lead data science communities across several business units
  • 20% Business Collaboration - Leverage extensive business knowledge into solution approach; Effectively develop trust and collaboration with internal customers and cross-functional teams; Provide technical education on advanced analytics to data science community; Partner with IT to understand potential for new tools and ways to maintain technical agility for data science; Actively seek out new business opportunities to leverage data science as a competitive advantage
  • 25% Technical Exploration & Development - Seek further knowledge on key developments within data science by attending conferences and publishing papers; Participate in the continuous improvement of data science and analytics by developing replicable solutions (for example, codified data products, project documentation, process flowcharts) to ensure solutions are leveraged for future projects; Define best practices and develop clear vision for data analysis and model productionalization; Ownership of library of reusable algorithms for future use, ensure developed code/models are documented; Develop mastery in one or more prescriptive modeling techniques, like optimization, computer vision, recommendation, search or NLP

title: Customer Escalation Lead
description:

This senior individual contributor role focuses on protecting customer confidence and resolving high-impact issues for strategic enterprise accounts.
You will own complex customer escalations from initial intake through resolution, confirmation, and follow-up.
The position combines strategic account management, executive communication, risk mitigation, and cross-functional leadership.
You will work closely with Customer Support, Product Health, Engineering, Product Management, Customer Success, QA, and Professional Services teams.
Beyond resolving immediate issues, you will identify recurring risks and customer pain points and turn them into actionable business and product insights.
The role provides significant organizational influence without direct reports, with a strong focus on customer advocacy, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Accountabilities:

  • Serve as the primary customer advocate and escalation resource for a portfolio of strategic customer accounts.
  • Develop deep knowledge of assigned accounts, including operational workflows, platform usage, priorities, initiatives, support history, and key stakeholder relationships.
  • Build trusted relationships with customer stakeholders and provide consistent communication throughout high-impact situations.
  • Conduct regular account reviews and customer touchpoints to identify emerging concerns, opportunities, and risks.
  • Own the complete lifecycle of customer escalations from intake through resolution and customer confirmation.
  • Establish clear ownership, action plans, communication cadences, documentation, and appropriate executive visibility for escalations.
  • Lead customer-facing escalation calls and executive discussions with professionalism, transparency, and a solution-oriented approach.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams and resources to accelerate issue resolution and remove delivery roadblocks.
  • Escalate critical customer risks internally when additional leadership support or organizational intervention is required.
  • Monitor customer health indicators, support activity, escalation trends, and sentiment to identify potential risks before they become major escalations.
  • Partner with Customer Success, Customer Support, and Product Health teams to develop and implement proactive risk mitigation plans.
  • Coordinate complex customer issues involving Support, Product Health, Engineering, Product Management, QA, Customer Success, and Professional Services.
  • Facilitate alignment between technical and customer-facing teams to ensure accurate communication and coordinated execution.
  • Drive accountability across stakeholder groups and ensure customer commitments are fulfilled.
  • Participate in critical customer reviews, executive briefings, and escalation governance discussions.
  • Analyze recurring customer pain points, systemic issues, product gaps, and escalation trends across strategic accounts.
  • Communicate customer risks and actionable recommendations to Product Health, Product Management, and Engineering leadership.

description:

From transaction processing to customer service, to driving innovation and launching new products, we’re building a range of tailored payment solutions powered by the latest technology. As part of our team, you can explore what motivates and energizes your career goals: partnering with our customers, our communities, and each other.

We actively uphold transparent and fair hiring practices that support individual opportunity, inclusive culture, and career mobility across all levels of our organisation.

We offer meaningful opportunities for growth, a culture of inclusion, and a strong commitment to transparency and integrity in everything we do.

Job Description

DevOps Engineer

** We are hiring a team of 4 DevOps Engineers in our Warsaw office. These roles are permanent roles (salary based - not B2B) and the expectation is to be in our Warsaw office 3 days per week **

Overview

U.S. Bank is building a next-generation Core Banking platform powered by Thought Machine Vault, a modern cloud-native banking platform that will support the future of our deposit, lending, and banking services. We are seeking experienced DevOps Engineers who have operated within highly regulated financial services environments and can help design, build, automate, and operate critical banking infrastructure at scale.

This is a unique opportunity to be part of a greenfield transformation programme, helping establish the DevOps foundations, automation frameworks, observability standards, and operational excellence required for a modern cloud-native core banking ecosystem.

The ideal candidate will bring strong DevOps engineering expertise combined with experience supporting mission-critical banking, financial services, fintech, payments, or other highly regulated platforms where resilience, security, auditability, and customer availability are paramount.

Key Accountabilities

Platform Engineering & Operations

  • Build, maintain and support the cloud infrastructure underpinning the Thought Machine core banking platform.

  • Develop and maintain Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) solutions to provision and manage highly resilient banking environments.

  • Ensure platform availability, reliability, scalability and security across development, test, staging and production environments.

  • Monitor critical banking services and proactively identify production issues before customer impact occurs.

  • Implement automated remediation, self-healing and operational tooling to reduce manual intervention.

  • Participate in major incident management and root cause analysis activities.

DevOps & Automation

  • Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines that support secure, repeatable and compliant software delivery.

  • Drive automation across infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, testing and deployment processes.

  • Partner closely with Engineering teams to improve developer experience and accelerate delivery while maintaining regulatory controls.

  • Promote DevSecOps practices throughout the software development lifecycle.

Core Banking Transformation

  • Collaborate with Thought Machine architects, platform engineers, software engineers and business stakeholders to deliver the strategic core banking roadmap.

  • Support the deployment and ongoing operation of Vault products, APIs and banking services.

  • Contribute to environment design, release management, resilience testing and disaster recovery capabilities.

  • Help establish operational standards, observability frameworks and platform governance models for the new banking ecosystem.

Compliance, Security & Risk

  • Ensure infrastructure and deployment processes meet banking regulatory requirements and internal risk controls.

  • Support audit activities and maintain appropriate operational documentation.

  • Work closely with Security, Risk and Compliance teams to implement controls around access management, logging, monitoring and change governance.

  • Ensure all operational activities align with security, resilience and regulatory standards expected within financial services.

Required Skills & Experience

Must Have

  • Extensive DevOps engineering experience within banking, financial services, fintech, payments, or other highly regulated environments.

  • Strong AWS cloud engineering experience.

  • Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, or similar.

  • Experience building, maintaining, and supporting enterprise CI/CD pipelines.

  • Strong scripting and automation skills using Python, Bash, PowerShell, or similar.

  • Experience supporting highly available, mission-critical production environments with stringent uptime and resilience requirements.

  • Experience implementing monitoring, logging, and observability solutions such as Datadog, Splunk, Prometheus, Grafana, New Relic, or Sumo Logic.

  • Strong experience with containerized platforms including Kubernetes and Docker.

  • Experience supporting and administering Apache Kafka platforms in production environments.

  • Understanding of event-driven architectures and messaging patterns using Kafka for real-time transaction processing and system integration.

  • Experience managing Kafka topics, partitions, replication, brokers, schema management, monitoring, performance tuning, and operational support.

  • Experience working with distributed systems and cloud-native architectures.

  • Strong understanding of production support, incident management, change management, and operational excellence practices.

  • Experience working within Agile delivery teams.

Skills Summary

AWS -- IAM, EKS, ECR, VPC,Security Groups, Route 53, ALB/NLB, S3, Secrets Manager, PrivateLink

Containers & Kubernetes -- Kubernetes administration, EKS, Helm, ingress controllers, autoscaling, RBAC, namespaces, networking

CI/CD -- GitOps, deployment pipelines, release automation, branching/versioning strategies

Observability --Datadog, OpenTelemetry, logging, metrics, tracing, dashboard creation, alerting

Scripting -- troubleshooting containerized workloads

DevSecOps -- Security scanning, policy-as-code, compliance controls embedded within pipelines

Preferred Skills (Bonus)

  • Experience with Thought Machine Vault or other modern Core Banking platforms.

  • Experience supporting banking products including deposits, lending, cards, payments or customer account systems.

  • Experience implementing DevSecOps capabilities and security automation.

  • Experience with event-driven architecture and API-driven platforms.

description:

With over 3,800 employees and over 30 global manufacturing brands, AGI is a leading provider of equipment and technology solutions for agricultural commodities including seed, fertilizer, grain and feed systems and an expanding platform for food processing facilities.

The Opportunity

Responsible for working both independently and as a team member to assemble products according to specifications and drawings by using various hand tools.

Responsibilities:

  • Must be able to work consistently in a safe and efficient manner with a variety of products, various components, to finish products for sales to customers.
  • Positions parts according to knowledge of unit being assembled and/or must be able to read and understand a work order, blueprint and tape measure and tailor assembly accordingly to varying specifications.

  • May perform assembly as specialist in one area or rotated to other areas where customer or shop demands dictate.

  • High school diploma or equivalent

title: MuleSoft Integration Developer (Veeva Vault)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a MuleSoft Integration Developer (Veeva Vault) based in France.

This is a remote contract opportunity for an experienced integration developer supporting enterprise systems within the pharmaceutical industry. You will design, develop, and deploy integrations connecting Veeva Vault with other business-critical platforms. The role combines hands-on MuleSoft Anypoint Platform development with practical knowledge of Veeva Vault APIs, authentication, objects, and metadata. You will build reliable API-led and event-driven integrations supporting both real-time and batch data flows. Reliability is central to the role, with a focus on error handling, retries, and idempotent processing. This opportunity is well suited to a technically strong integration specialist who can work independently in a project-focused environment.

Accountabilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain APIs and integration flows using the MuleSoft Anypoint Platform.

  • Work with Veeva Vault APIs, authentication mechanisms, objects, metadata, and related data structures.
  • Design and implement API-led connectivity patterns to support scalable enterprise integrations.
  • Develop publish/subscribe messaging patterns where required by integration architecture.
  • Implement both batch and real-time data synchronization processes.
  • Build robust integration flows with appropriate error handling and recovery mechanisms.
  • Implement retry strategies to improve reliability and resilience across integration processes.
  • Apply idempotency patterns to prevent duplicate processing and maintain data integrity.
  • Design integrations with appropriate handling of failures, exceptions, and downstream system issues.
  • Deploy integration applications using MuleSoft CloudHub or Runtime Fabric (RTF).
  • Participate in the full development lifecycle from integration design through implementation and deployment.
  • Collaborate with relevant technical and business stakeholders to understand integration requirements.
  • Troubleshoot integration issues and refine solutions to ensure stable production operation.
  • Apply API integration best practices across REST, SOAP, and related enterprise integration technologies.

    • Requirements:

    • 4–7 years of total IT experience, including at least 2–3 years of hands-on MuleSoft/Anypoint Platform development.
    • Strong practical experience developing integrations using the MuleSoft Anypoint Platform.
    • Experience designing and implementing APIs, integration flows, and MuleSoft connectors.
    • Practical understanding of API design principles and enterprise integration patterns.
    • Working knowledge of Veeva Vault APIs, authentication mechanisms, objects, and metadata.
    • Sufficient understanding of the Veeva Vault data and object model to independently develop integrations.
    • Experience with API integration technologies, particularly REST and SOAP.
    • Understanding of API-led connectivity and its application to enterprise integration architectures.
    • Experience implementing publish/subscribe messaging patterns.
    • Understanding of the differences between batch and real-time data synchronization and when to apply each approach.
    • Hands-on experience implementing error handling, retry mechanisms, and idempotency.
    • Ability to design integrations that minimize duplicate processing and maintain data consistency.
    • Experience deploying MuleSoft applications using CloudHub and/or Runtime Fabric (RTF).
    • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills for diagnosing integration and API issues.
    • Ability to work independently in a remote environment and manage technical responsibilities effectively.
    • Good communication and collaboration skills when working with technical stakeholders and project teams.
    • Experience in the pharmaceutical industry would be advantageous.

description:
Calling all innovators - find your future at Fiserv.

We're Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants and consumers to one another millions of times a day - quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we're involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.

Job Title

Solution Architecture Advisor

About your role:

As a Solution Architecture Advisor, you will lead client-facing solution design for complex initiatives supporting the client environment. You will serve as a single point of accountability for translating business and technical needs into end-to-end digital banking solutions for one of Fiserv’s top three strategic enterprise clients. You will bring a strong technical background with solid integration and architecture experience, paired with the ability to understand client priorities and shape how they are met through Fiserv products, platforms, and delivery teams. Acting as the bridge between Fiserv and client counterparts, this role translates prioritized needs into comprehensive solution architecture, integration approaches, and implementation-ready direction for the current and future-state environment.

What you'll do:

  • Translate client business and technical needs into well-framed solution architecture, drawing on a solid understanding of integrations and how the product stack fits together.
  • Own end-to-end solution design across client and Fiserv architecture, identify product and platform integration points, and provide technical governance throughout delivery.

  • Understand prioritized business and capability needs, translate those needs into technical solution requirements, and define end-to-end architecture across Fiserv products and platforms.
