  • Support Agile delivery teams by translating business and capability needs into technical requirements, define and clarify end-to-end architecture decisions, and frame phased implementation approaches that balance near-term delivery with future-state architecture direction.

Experience that would be great to have:

title: Product Manager, Payment Messaging
description:
About VGS

VGS is building the trust infrastructure for a new era of commerce. As commerce becomes agentic, payments are increasing dramatically in volume, speed, and complexity, and the companies driving that shift need a foundation they can fully trust.

That's where VGS comes in. We're the world's leader in payment tokenization, trusted by the most innovative AI and Fortune 500 companies, merchants, banks, and fintechs to power modern payments and agentic commerce. We store more than 9 billion tokens and process more than 10 billion monthly interactions, touching a third of all e-commerce. That scale isn't incidental. It's why leading companies embed our universal token vault and credential management platform directly into their stack, taming the complexity of payment data so they can move faster.

Come build the platform that enables modern payments for the world's largest companies. We're helping businesses unlock new possibilities in an industry that never stops moving. And that takes exceptional people.

About the Role

We are seeking a Product Manager to help drive the evolution of our payments & banking technology. This is a role for a high-agency leader who thrives on technical complexity and demands perfection from their systems. You won't just build features; you will envision new ways of looking at decades-old problems, manage sophisticated relationships and product enhancements with industry experts, and help create the technical foundation on top of which the payments world is built.

In this role, you will work across the payments and banking industry to deliver products in the service of technologists on both sides of the network. This includes creating products in the realm of payments messaging, processor integration management, legacy system modernization, security, and compliance. You will need to understand users, products, and business needs to define new capabilities in our payments messaging offerings.

We seek a curious, tech-minded, and highly resourceful PM who can build and iterate solutions that are understood by both bankers and the engineers who build the system. You must be willing to drive technical rigor at the lowest level.

What You’ll Do

  • Product Strategy & Discovery: Meet with banks, processors, customers, partners, and engineering leaders to map complex technical problems to business needs. Define technical requirements, prioritize features, and create roadmaps that align with business objectives.

  • Manage complex implementation rollouts that span multiple continents to modernize banking, acquiring, and similar use-cases.

  • Ideate a sophisticated and configurable developer-friendly product interface that supports payments technologists, customer implementation specialists, and the business stakeholders that manage the finances. This interface will be used to interpret ISO8583, ISO20022, and similar messaging formats over a wide-array of protocols.

  • Understand, integrate with, and build on top of the pre-existing products, platforms, and concepts within the VGS ecosystem.

What You Bring

  • Experience: 10+ years of experience in payments technology as a software engineer, product manager, or related functions. Must have experience launching new initiatives that involve designing and building APIs, O11y, private networking, enterprise authentication systems, and other software developer-related technologies.

  • Deep experience working in banking and/or payments gateways in a way that is either directly interacting with the networks or the acquirer/issuer processors. The expectation is that you will have experience working with AS/400 servers, ISO8583, ISO20022, and similar technologies.

  • T-Shaped Technical Mastery: This position requires a broad proficiency across the payments ecosystem. This includes DUKPT encryption for terminal/ATM messages, EBCDIC encoding, ISO8583 messaging, observability, and modern software development. It is required that you have deep knowledge related to one of these technologies in a way that is pertinent to payments messaging.

  • Technical Conviction: You have strong, well-founded opinions on software architecture. You are willing to advocate for systems that can be operationalized via configuration by an implementation/product team such that software systems do not require engineers to make minor changes on a per-implementation basis.

  • Communication Skills: This position involves communicating new ideas to prospects, customers, executives, GTM leaders, and implementation teams. Therefore, strong written, verbal, and visual communication skills are required to be successful in this role. This includes writing technical documentation that is ready to be published online and that can be included in technical RFP presentations.

Mindset:

  • Born Inventor: You love designing and building. Your house is likely full of projects that you have figured out and put together from scratch. When you’re alone, you think of things to build and ways systems can be improved.

  • Abstract Problem Solver: When faced with a problem set, you break it down into the conceptual “building blocks” and solve the meta problem, not just the problem right in front of you.

  • Technical Optimism: You view technical blockers as the list of steps that need to be taken in order to accomplish the goal. Integrating with legacy systems and technologies is strangely energizing. You look forward to it in the same way you would want to solve a puzzle without even having the source picture. You bring energy and a "can-do" spirit to the most difficult modernization challenges that the industry has to offer.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with tokenization, payment processing, or security products

  • BA/BS degree

  • A knack for out-of-the-box thinking that thrives in a fast-paced startup environment

  • Experience working with GTM teams to bring new products to market.

  • Experience working in the payments/data tokenization space directly.

We're looking for passionate professionals who take pride in their craft and want to help grow a team tackling some of the most critical problems in payments. People who thrive here are curious by nature, unafraid of hard problems, and motivated by the chance to build something that matters at scale.

If you're driven to make a meaningful impact, work at the leading edge of payment technology, and grow your career alongside a team that values ownership, collaboration, and continuous learning, you'll feel right at home at VGS.

How We Work

At VGS, we embrace a remote-first philosophy because we believe flexibility leads to great work and a healthy work-life balance. That said, if you live within 30 miles of one of our office locations, you'll be on a hybrid schedule with some in-person time, because we know there's real value in coming together.

We're not about being in the office every day. We are about connection, collaboration, and the energy that comes from a great brainstorm, a team lunch, or celebrating a big win in person.

Our Benefits

Financial and retirement

  • Competitive salary

  • 401 (k) with a 4% match and immediate vesting (applies to US only)

  • Early equity

  • Internet Stipend

  • Learning Stipend

  • Office set-up stipend (applies to US only)

  • Pet insurance

Vacation and time off

Professional Development

  • Lunch and learns

  • Team events and summits

Office life and perks

  • Remote and hybrid opportunities

  • Flexible working hours

  • Weekly office lunches

  • Employee discount platform

We consider all applicants without regard to race, color, national origin, sex, age, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, marital status, physical or mental disability, or other protected classes under all applicable local, state, and federal laws and ordinances (AA/EOE/W/M/Vet/Disabled).

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer — Token Factory (Inference Platform) based in Netherlands.

This is a senior engineering role focused on the reliability, performance, and observability of a large-scale AI inference platform.
You will help operate infrastructure serving foundation models across text, vision, audio, and emerging multimodal workloads.
The role combines Kubernetes, infrastructure-as-code, observability, automation, and production incident management at significant scale.
You will optimize GPU-heavy workloads, strengthen resilience, and ensure high-throughput APIs meet demanding reliability and cost targets.
You will work closely with software engineers and infrastructure teams to build self-healing systems and robust operational processes.
The environment is fast-moving, highly technical, international, and focused on solving complex infrastructure challenges for the AI ecosystem.
This is an opportunity to have a direct impact on the infrastructure powering next-generation AI applications.

Accountabilities

  • Own the reliability, performance, and observability of the inference platform and its supporting infrastructure.
  • Design, implement, and continuously improve telemetry pipelines covering metrics, logs, and traces.
  • Build monitoring and observability solutions capable of processing large volumes of production signals and converting them into actionable insights.
  • Configure and optimize Kubernetes infrastructure for high availability, scalability, and efficient resource utilization.
  • Tune Kubernetes autoscaling mechanisms to improve the efficiency and utilization of GPU resources.
  • Develop and maintain Terraform modules and infrastructure-as-code patterns that embed resilience and reliability into new clusters and services.
  • Design and improve request-routing, retry, and failure-handling mechanisms to minimize the impact of transient infrastructure or service failures.
  • Develop automation and operational tooling to detect, isolate, and remediate incidents quickly.
  • Create, maintain, and improve runbooks for incident response and operational procedures.
  • Participate in production incident management, troubleshooting issues and restoring services within demanding reliability objectives.
  • Lead or contribute to post-mortem processes and implement corrective actions to prevent recurring incidents.
  • Define and improve reliability practices for high-throughput APIs, including alerting strategies and Service Level Objectives (SLOs).
  • Investigate distributed-system failures and performance issues across infrastructure and application layers.
  • Optimize systems from the kernel and infrastructure layer through to the application layer.
  • Support and improve the operation of GPU-intensive inference workloads and accelerator-based infrastructure.
  • Contribute to scaling the inference platform while balancing performance, reliability, and infrastructure costs.
  • Collaborate closely with software engineers to incorporate reliability and operational excellence into product and platform development.
  • Promote automation, self-healing capabilities, and engineering practices that reduce operational overhead and improve system resilience.

    • Requirements:

    • Significant experience in Site Reliability Engineering, Production Engineering, DevOps, or a closely related infrastructure discipline.
    • Deep practical knowledge of Kubernetes in production environments.
    • Strong experience with Prometheus and Grafana for monitoring, metrics, dashboards, and observability.
    • Advanced experience with Terraform and infrastructure-as-code practices.
    • Strong scripting and automation skills using Python and/or Bash.
    • Solid understanding of distributed systems and the ways production backends can fail under real-world conditions.
    • Experience designing effective alerts, monitoring strategies, and SLOs for high-throughput services or APIs.
    • Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills across infrastructure, networking, operating systems, and application layers.
    • Experience designing systems for high availability, resilience, scalability, and graceful failure recovery.
    • Hands-on experience with GPU-heavy workloads or accelerator-based infrastructure is highly valuable.
    • Familiarity with GPU inference technologies such as vLLM, Triton, Ray, or comparable accelerator and model-serving stacks.
    • Experience with MLOps, model hosting, AI infrastructure, or machine-learning platforms is advantageous.
    • Strong understanding of infrastructure automation, deployment, configuration management, and operational tooling.
    • Ability to analyze complex performance and reliability problems and translate findings into practical engineering improvements.
    • Strong incident-management and root-cause-analysis capabilities.
    • Ability to collaborate effectively with software engineers and other technical teams to integrate reliability into platform development.
    • Proactive mindset with a strong focus on automation, self-healing systems, and continuous improvement.
    • Comfortable working independently, taking ownership of critical infrastructure, and operating effectively in a fast-paced technical environment.

title: Lead Experience Designer
description:
Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we design, build, manage and modernize the mission-critical technology systems that the world depends on every day. So why work at Kyndryl? We are always moving forward – always pushing ourselves to go further in our efforts to build a more equitable, inclusive world for our employees, our customers and our communities.

The Role

Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we design, build, manage and modernize the mission-critical technology systems that the world depends on every day. So why work at Kyndryl? We are always moving forward always pushing ourselves to go further in our efforts to build a more equitable, inclusive world for our employees, our customers and our communities.


The Role

As a Lead Experience Designer at Kyndryl Vital, you will own design workstreams end to end — from research and requirements definition through detailed design documentation, prototyping, and delivery. You will work directly with clients to understand their users and their business, lead design reviews, advocate for design decisions with internal and external stakeholders, and collaborate with engineering, data, and consulting teams to ensure a cohesive experience. You will use stakeholder and user feedback to iterate and refine solutions to a high standard of quality and usability.

An increasing share of our work involves designing how people work with AI — including agentic systems that plan, act, and hand work back to humans. You will map journeys and build service blueprints that span human and AI actors, design agentic workflows and human-in-the-loop hand-off moments, and define interaction patterns for systems that are non-deterministic: handling latency, ambiguity, uncertainty, and error states in ways that keep users informed and in control. You will help establish our best practices for visualizing, prototyping, and evaluating human/AI interaction, and you will bring a clear point of view on where automation serves people and where it doesn’t.

This is not an AI-only role. Our clients run the world’s critical systems, and your portfolio of work will also include dashboards, web and enterprise applications, design systems, service design, and client-facing presentations and workshops. We are looking for a strong generalist designer who can extend proven human-centered methods into the agentic era — not a specialist who only works on one class of problem.

What You Will Do

  • Lead design workstreams: own discovery through delivery on client engagements, producing journey maps, service blueprints, flows, wireframes, and low-to-high fidelity prototypes appropriate to the problem.

  • Design for human/AI collaboration: define agentic workflows, human-in-the-loop validation and hand-off moments, and interaction patterns for non-deterministic system behavior — latency, ambiguity, and graceful error recovery — with transparency and user control as defaults.

  • Conduct and apply research: plan and run generative and evaluative research, including research into how users build (or lose) trust in AI-driven features, and translate findings into design decisions.

  • Facilitate co-creation: lead workshops and collaborative sessions that align client stakeholders, balancing desirability with technical feasibility alongside engineers, data scientists, and creative technologists.

  • Deliver traditional experience work: design dashboards, enterprise web applications, and information visualizations, and produce clear, persuasive client presentations.

  • Communicate and advocate: present design decisions with clear storytelling and rationale; lead design reviews and build alignment across the full lifecycle from discovery to delivery.

  • Champion responsible design: advocate for accessibility, inclusion, and ethical use of AI, ensuring experiences are equitable and that automated behavior is appropriately transparent to the people it affects.

  • Use AI in your own practice: apply AI-powered design and research tools to accelerate iteration while maintaining quality, judgment, and craft.

Your Future at Kyndryl
Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

Kyndryl currently does not require employees to be fully vaccinated against COVID-19, however, if you are hired to work at a client, customer, or partner location, you may be required to show proof of vaccination to align with their respective COVID-19 vaccination policies. Those who believe they are eligible may apply for a medical or religious accommodation prior to the start of employment.

Who You Are

Who You Are

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important, you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused, someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless, naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

Required Skills and Experience

  • 6–7 years of experience in experience design or a related field.

  • Human-centered design: deep grounding in human-centered design methods and mindset, with a portfolio of enterprise, consulting, or innovation-studio work.

  • Journey and service design: demonstrated ability to create journey maps and service blueprints for complex, multi-actor systems — including systems where some actors are AI agents.

  • Designing for AI: hands-on experience designing AI-driven or agentic product experiences: human/AI interaction flows, human-in-the-loop patterns, and interfaces for non-deterministic behavior. You can show this work and explain your decisions.

  • User research: ability to design and conduct generative and evaluative research and translate it into delivery with developers and product managers.

  • Prototyping: fluency in Figma or similar tools; ability to create context-appropriate prototypes from low to high fidelity, including working prototypes of AI-assisted interactions.

  • Facilitation and storytelling: comfort facilitating co-creation sessions and presenting to clients; excellent communication skills in English.

  • Visual communication: strong information design and visual communication skills.


Preferred Skills and Experience

  • Experience in both enterprise and agency/consulting environments.

  • Knowledge of IT infrastructure or other complex technical domains.

  • Background in human behavior, change management, or applied social sciences.

  • Data science or AI/ML background, or experience working closely with AI engineering teams.

  • Familiarity with AI-assisted design and prototyping tools (e.g., Figma Make, Miro AI, Lovable, or similar).

  • Excellent communication skills in English

  • Deeper specialization in one or more of:

    • Service Design

    • User Experience / Interaction Design

    • Interface Design

    • Information Architecture

    • Data Visualization

    • Conversational and Agentic Interfaces

Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE) Statement

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

Being You

Diversity is a whole lot more than what we look like or where we come from, it’s how we think and who we are. We welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. But we’re not doing it single-handily: Our Kyndryl Inclusion Networks are only one of many ways we create a workplace where all Kyndryls can find and provide support and advice. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you – and everyone next to you – the ability to bring your whole self to work, individually and collectively, and support the activation of our equitable culture. That’s the Kyndryl Way.

What You Can Expect

With state-of-the-art resources and Fortune 100 clients, every day is an opportunity to innovate, build new capabilities, new relationships, new processes, and new value. Kyndryl cares about your well-being and prides itself on offering benefits that give you choice, reflect the diversity of our employees and support you and your family through the moments that matter – wherever you are in your life journey. Our employee learning programs give you access to the best learning in the industry to receive certifications, including Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Skillsoft, and many more. Through our company-wide volunteering and giving platform, you can donate, start fundraisers, volunteer, and search over 2 million non-profit organizations. Civil Engineering

Adjunct Faculty Pool | John R. Post School of Engineering | Reading, Pennsylvania

The John R. Post School of Engineering at Alvernia University invites applications to its adjunct faculty pool in Civil Engineering. We seek professionals to teach both lecture and laboratory courses in person in Reading, Pennsylvania. Most engineering courses are taught at the John R. Post Center, 401 Penn Street, Reading, PA, with some activities potentially using other Alvernia Reading locations. Applicants must be available for weekday daytime teaching, primarily between 8:00 a.m. and 3:00 p.m. This daytime availability is an important requirement for these in-person positions. Lecture courses typically meet on multiple days each week, so applicants must be able to commit to a recurring weekday schedule for the full semester. Remote or hybrid teaching is not available for these pools. Hired candidates join the adjunct pool and may receive separate contracts for individual courses as needs arise. Pool appointment does not guarantee a course assignment.

Potential teaching areas

Surveying and Geomatics

Surveying, field methods, measurement, geomatics, and surveying laboratory instruction.

Structural Engineering and Construction Materials

Statics, strength of materials, structural analysis, structural design, concrete and steel behavior, construction materials, materials testing, and related laboratories.

Geotechnical Engineering

Soil mechanics, foundations, geotechnical analysis, and geotechnical laboratory instruction.

Water Resources and Environmental Engineering

Fluid mechanics, hydraulics, hydrology, water resources, introductory environmental engineering, water quality, and related laboratories.

Transportation, Construction, and Professional Practice

Transportation engineering, construction engineering, infrastructure, project management, FE exam preparation, engineering design, capstone, and civil engineering electives.

Professional Engineer licensure, or progress toward licensure, is especially valued for civil engineering assignments.

Preferred qualifications

We particularly welcome practicing engineers and technical professionals who can bring current industry experience into the classroom. Prior college teaching is not required. Preferred candidates will have at least a master's degree in Civil Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Construction Engineering or a closely related field and approximately five or more years of relevant professional experience. These are preferred qualifications, not absolute minimums; comparable combinations of advanced education, professional licensure, specialized expertise, industry experience, research, and teaching will be considered. Completion of the Fundamentals of Engineering (FE) exam, Engineer in Training (EIT) certification, and/or Professional Engineer (PE) licensure is a plus.

Application and employment requirements

How to apply

All applications and application materials must be submitted through Alvernia University's ADP employment portal for the specific adjunct pool posting. Submit a current resume or curriculum vitae and a brief letter of interest identifying the courses or subject areas you believe you are qualified to teach. Do not email application materials. Email inquiries are welcome, but a formal application through ADP is required for consideration.

Work authorization

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States and able to accept employment with Alvernia University without current or future employer sponsorship.

Questions and inquiries

Prospective applicants may contact Dr. Joseph M. Mahoney, Chair of the John R. Post School of Engineering, at joseph.mahoney@alvernia.edu with questions about the School, the adjunct pool, or potential teaching needs. Application materials must be submitted through ADP and should not be emailed.

Equal employment opportunity

Alvernia University is an equal-opportunity employer committed to Franciscan values. People of all faith backgrounds, as well as people with no faith affiliation, are welcome and encouraged to apply. All employees share responsibility for advancing a culture of care in the performance of their roles while demonstrating service orientation, respect for all, intellectual curiosity, solution focus and innovation, and mutual accountability. Alvernia University strives to be a community supportive of diverse perspectives and identities.

title: Scientist, Nucleic Acid Biology and Therapeutics (GIS)
description:
The YUcleic Lab at GIS, A*STAR, is recruiting a Scientist or Senior Scientist to develop innovative therapeutic strategies targeting RNA and DNA.

Our lab integrates nucleic acid biology, chemical biology, functional genomics, and molecular pharmacology to develop antisense oligonucleotides, small molecules, and other gene-targeting approaches. We aim to achieve precise and programmable regulation of disease-relevant genes, including targets and pathways that are currently difficult to drug.

The successful candidate will have the opportunity to lead multidisciplinary projects, shape new research directions, and contribute to emerging RNA- and DNA-targeted therapeutic platforms.

Research Areas

Projects may include:

  • RNA regulation of translation, stability, splicing, and processing.
  • Discovery of RNA-binding proteins and disease-relevant regulatory elements.
  • Development of ASO- and small-molecule-based gene-regulation strategies.
  • Cellular screening and functional genomics.
  • Mechanistic studies of nucleic acid–drug interactions.
  • Transcriptomic and genomic analysis of therapeutic activity and selectivity.

Candidate Profile

  • PhD in RNA biology, nucleic acid biology, functional genomics, molecular biology, pharmacology, or a related field.
  • Strong knowledge of RNA regulation and gene-expression control.
  • Hands-on experience in relevant techniques such as CRISPR, CLIP-seq, ChIP-seq, Ribo-seq, RNA-seq, co-IP, western blotting, reporter assays, or cellular screening.
  • Strong scientific writing, presentation, and project-management skills.
  • Independent, collaborative, and motivated to explore innovative therapeutic strategies.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and test innovative hypotheses in nucleic acid biology and therapeutics.
  • Design mechanistic and functional studies in disease-relevant cellular models.
  • Establish screening platforms to identify regulatory factors, ASOs, and small molecules.
  • Apply functional genomics and sequencing-based approaches.
  • Collaborate with biologists, chemists, and computational scientists.
  • Lead research projects, mentor junior researchers, and contribute to publications and grant proposals.

Why Join Us?

GIS is Singapore’s national flagship institute for genomic sciences and provides access to world-class genomics, sequencing, computational, and translational research platforms.

The position offers:

  • Opportunities to lead high-impact research.
  • A multidisciplinary and collaborative environment.
  • Strong opportunities for publication, grant development, mentorship, and intellectual property generation.

Application

Please email your CV and a brief description of your research interests to:

Dr. Zutao Yu
yuzt@a-star.edu.sg

Email subject: Scientist/Senior Scientist Application – [Your Name]

More information: www.yucleiclab.com

Join us in developing the next generation of RNA- and DNA-targeted therapeutics.

The above eligibility criteria are not exhaustive. A*STAR may include additional selection criteria based on its prevailing recruitment policies. These policies may be amended from time to time without notice. We regret that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

title: 22484 - Programmes Facilitator
company: His Majesty's Prison and Probation Service
description:
Working Arrangements & Further Information

The MoJ offers Hybrid Working arrangements where business need allows. This is an informal, non-contractual form of flexible working that blends working from your base location, different MoJ sites and / or from home (please be aware that this role can only be worked in the UK and not overseas). Some roles will not be suitable for Hybrid Working. Similarly, Hybrid Working will not suit everyone’s circumstances. Arrangements will be discussed and agreed with the successful candidate(s) and subject to regular review.

For nationally advertised roles, the successful candidate(s) will be appointed to a MoJ office location, which may include their nearest Justice Collaboration Centre or Justice Satellite Office. This will be discussed and agreed on the completion of pre-employment checks.

Some of MoJ’s terms and conditions of service are changing as part of Civil Service reform. The changes will apply to staff joining MoJ who are new to the Civil Service. Staff joining MoJ from other civil service employers will transfer onto the new MoJ terms if they are already on 'modernised' terms in their current post or onto 'unmodernised' MoJ terms if they are on 'unmodernised' terms at their current post. Details will be available if an offer is made.

Standard full time working hours are 37 hours per week excluding breaks which are unpaid. HMPPS welcomes part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns, where they meet the demands of the role and business needs. All applications for part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns will be considered in accordance with the HMPPS’ Flexible Working policy.

If you are a current NPS employee, this vacancy may be available on a Loan basis for up to 2 years. Applications are invited from suitable qualified staff.

The Loan/Secondment is subject to the approval of the selected candidate's Business Unit, which should be obtained before confirmation of appointment.

Benefits

Annual Leave

-The holiday year runs from 1 March. If you work a non standard work pattern your leave entitlement may be expressed in either hours or days as appropriate. Leave entitlement is calculated on a pro-rata basis and you will be advised of your actual entitlement on appointment. If you were appointed internally and your leave was previously calculated in days, this will continue to be the case.

Bank, Public and Privilege Holidays

-You are entitled to 9 days (66 hours 36 minutes) in recognition of bank, public and privilege holidays. These hours are added to your annual leave allowance. There is a requirement to work some public and bank holidays subject to your shift pattern and the operational needs of the establishment

Pension

-The Civil Service offers a choice of two pension schemes, giving you the flexibility to choose the pension that suits you best.

Work Life Balance

HM Prison & Probation Service (HMPPS) is keen to encourage alternative working arrangements. Work life balance provides greater opportunities for staff to work more flexibly wherever managers and establishments can accommodate requests to do so. HMPPS offers flexible working subject to completion of a satisfactory probationary period and NVQ

Season Ticket Advance

-After two months’ service, you’ll be eligible to apply for a season ticket advance to purchase a quarterly or longer-period season ticket for travel between home and your place of work

Childcare Vouchers

For any moves across the Civil Service may have implications on your ability to carry on claiming childcare vouchers

Training

HMPPS is committed to staff development and offers a range of training and development opportunities, including areas such as Equality and Diversity, Dealing with Challenging Behaviour, Suicide Prevention and Anti Bullying Programmes

-There are opportunities to access promotion programmes and HMPPS provides a variety of training appropriate to individual posts

-All staff receive security and diversity training and an individual induction programme into their new roles

Eligibility

-All candidates are subject to security and identity checks prior to taking up post

-All external candidates are subject to 6 months probation. Internal candidates are subject to probation if they have not already served a probationary period within HMPPS

-All staff are required to declare whether they are a member of a group or organisation which the HMPPS considers to be racist

Working for the Civil Service

The Civil Service Code sets out the standards of behaviour expected of civil servants.

We recruit by merit on the basis of fair and open competition, as outlined in the Civil Service Commission's recruitment principles. Should you feel that the recruitment process has breached the recruitment principles you are able to raise a formal complaint in the following order

  • To Transformative Business Services (0345 241 5358 (Monday to Friday 8am - 6pm) or e mail moj-recruitment-vetting-enquiries@resourcing.soprasteria.co.uk);
  • To Ministry of Justice Resourcing team (resourcing-management-office@justice.gov.uk);
  • To the Civil Service Commission (details available here)

As a Disability Confident employer, MoJ are committed to providing everyone with the opportunity to demonstrate their skills, talent and abilities, by making adjustments throughout all elements of the recruitment process and in the workplace. MoJ are able to offer an interview to disabled candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns.

You will be able to request reasonable adjustments to the recruitment process within the application form. If you need additional help completing the application form, please contact the TBS Recruitment Enquiries Team.

For more information on applying for a role as a candidate with a disability or long-term condition, please watch our animated videos.

Diversity & Inclusion

The Civil Service is committed to attract, retain and invest in talent wherever it is found. To learn more please see the Civil Service People Plan and the Civil Service Diversity and Inclusion Strategy.

A Great Place to Work for Veterans

The "Making the Civil Service a Great Place to work for veterans" initiative includes a guaranteed interview scheme to those who meet the minimum criteria to provide eligible former members of the Armed Forces with opportunities to secure rewarding jobs. Allowing veterans to continue to serve their country, and to bring highly skilled individuals with a broad range of experience into the Civil Service in an environment, which recognises and values your previous service in the Armed Forces.
For further details about the initiative and eligibility requirements visit:

Redeployment Interview Scheme

Civil Service departments are expected to explore redeployment opportunities before making an individual redundant. The MoJ is committed, as part of the Redeployment Interview Scheme, to providing opportunities to those who are 'at risk of redundancy'.

MoJ is able to offer an interview to eligible candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns. Candidates will not be eligible for the Redeployment Interview Scheme if they are applying on promotion.

Civil Service Nationality Rules

This job is broadly open to the following groups:

  • UK nationals
  • nationals of the Republic of Ireland
  • nationals of Commonwealth countries who have the right to work in the UK
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities with settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS) (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/settled-status-eu-citizens-families
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities who have made a valid application for settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS)
  • individuals with limited leave to remain or indefinite leave to remain who were eligible to apply for EUSS on or before 31 December 2020
  • Turkish nationals, and certain family members of Turkish nationals, who have accrued the right to work in the Civil Service

Further information on nationality requirements (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/nationality-rules

Reserve list

A reserve list may be held for up to 12 months from which further appointments may be made for the same or similar roles.

title: Die Mounter - 3rd Shift
description:
About the Role:

The Die Mounter on the 3rd shift plays a critical role in the manufacturing process by accurately mounting dies onto machines. This position requires meticulous attention to detail and precision to guarantee that each die is positioned correctly to meet stringent quality standards. The role involves working with specialized equipment and tools to handle delicate materials, contributing directly to the efficiency and reliability of the production line. The Die Mounter will collaborate closely with quality control and production teams to identify and resolve any mounting issues, thereby minimizing defects and downtime. Ultimately, this position supports the company’s commitment to delivering superior products by maintaining consistent and precise die mounting operations during overnight hours.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Previous experience in a manufacturing environment, preferably in semiconductor or electronics assembly.
  • Ability to work the 3rd shift (overnight hours) consistently.
  • Basic mechanical aptitude and manual dexterity.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to follow precise instructions.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience specifically with die mounting or semiconductor assembly processes.
  • Basic understanding of quality control principles and documentation.
  • Ability to read and interpret technical drawings or work instructions.
  • Certification or training in manufacturing equipment operation or safety.

Responsibilities:

  • Operate die mounting machinery and tools to accurately place dies..
  • Inspect dies and substrates for defects or irregularities prior to mounting to ensure quality standards are met.
  • Perform routine maintenance and cleaning of equipment to maintain optimal functionality and prevent production delays.
  • Document production data and report any issues or deviations to supervisors promptly for corrective action.
  • Collaborate with quality assurance and engineering teams to troubleshoot and resolve mounting problems.
  • Adhere to all safety protocols and company policies to maintain a safe working environment during the 3rd shift.
  • Maintain a clean and organized work area to support efficient workflow and compliance with manufacturing standards.

Skills:

The required skills such as manual dexterity and attention to detail are essential for accurately mounting delicate semiconductor dies, ensuring product quality and minimizing defects. Mechanical aptitude helps the Die Mounter operate and maintain specialized equipment effectively, reducing downtime and maintaining production flow. Communication skills are used daily to report issues and collaborate with quality and engineering teams to resolve problems quickly. Preferred skills like familiarity with cleanroom and ESD protocols enhance the ability to work safely and maintain product integrity in sensitive manufacturing environments. Additionally, the ability to interpret technical instructions supports consistent adherence to manufacturing standards and improves overall efficiency.

title: Engineering Technician
description:
With a career at The Home Depot, you can be yourself and also be part of something bigger.

Position Summary

The Engineering Technician is a hands-on member of the engineering team supporting the development, build, testing, deployment, and improvement of the company’s automation products and systems.

Working with mechanical, electrical, software, systems, manufacturing, and realization teams, the technician helps turn designs into robust, field-ready products. This includes building and evaluating prototypes, supporting testing and troubleshooting, and providing practical feedback on manufacturability, assembly, installation, serviceability, and maintainability.

The ideal candidate is mechanically inclined, technically curious, organized, and comfortable using hands-on judgment to identify problems and improve products and processes.

Key Responsibilities

Engineering & Prototype Support — 40%

  • Build, assemble, modify, and evaluate prototype automation equipment and assemblies.
  • Support the transition from engineering designs and CAD models to functional hardware.
  • Identify issues during assembly, integration, testing, and early product builds.
  • Provide practical feedback on manufacturability, assembly sequence, installation, serviceability, tool access, cable routing, hardware selection, and component accessibility.
  • Recommend design and process improvements based on hands-on experience.
  • Support mechanical and electromechanical assembly, adjustment, alignment, and system integration.
  • Assist with design iterations, prototype builds, NPI, and early production activities.
  • Coordinate periodically with outside suppliers and technical partners to support prototype builds, fixtures, components, and other engineering needs.
  • Support contract manufacturing activities, including first-article builds, build issue resolution, and verification of drawings, work instructions, test procedures, and manufacturing processes.

Testing & Troubleshooting — 30%

  • Perform hands-on testing of products, assemblies, components, and subsystems.
  • Set up equipment, fixtures, and instrumentation for engineering evaluations.
  • Execute functional, validation, endurance, burn-in, and reliability testing.
  • Troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, controls, and system-level issues.
  • Reproduce product and field failures to support root-cause investigations.
  • Use technical judgment to identify unexpected behavior requiring further investigation.
  • Verify engineering changes and corrective actions through structured testing.
  • Clearly document test setups, results, failures, and observations.

Product Support, Documentation & Training — 20%

  • Serve as a hands-on subject matter expert for the installation, deployment, operation, and maintenance of fielded products.
  • Train and support external technicians, partners, and other resources responsible for equipment at customer sites.
  • Support documentation of product designs, build configurations, test setups, and engineering changes.
  • Develop and update assembly instructions, test procedures, troubleshooting guides, service procedures, and installation instructions.
  • Capture photographs, measurements, diagrams, and technical information needed to document products accurately.
  • Validate documentation by performing the procedures and identifying missing or unclear information.
  • Support product demonstrations and hands-on technical training as needed.

Lab & Equipment Support — 10%

  • Maintain an organized, safe, and effective engineering lab.
  • Organize and maintain tools, test equipment, prototype hardware, fixtures, and commonly used components.
  • Maintain spare parts inventory
  • Coordinate with engineering and sourcing teams to obtain parts and equipment required for builds and testing.

Qualifications

  • Associate degree, technical certification, apprenticeship, or equivalent practical experience in engineering technology, electromechanical systems, robotics, manufacturing, industrial automation, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in an engineering lab, prototype environment, automation company, equipment manufacturer, field service role, or similar technical position preferred.
  • Strong mechanical aptitude and ability to build, modify, troubleshoot, and repair mechanical and electromechanical equipment.
  • Comfortable using hand tools, power tools, measurement equipment, wiring, sensors, fasteners, and industrial hardware.
  • Ability to read engineering drawings, assembly drawings, bills of material, schematics, and technical specifications.
  • Ability to evaluate designs from an assembly, manufacturing, installation, maintenance, and service perspective.
  • Experience performing structured testing, troubleshooting equipment, and documenting technical results.
  • Strong practical problem-solving, communication, and organizational skills.

Preferred Characteristics

The successful candidate will:

  • Enjoy building equipment and understanding how engineering designs perform in the real world.
  • Naturally look for ways to make products easier to build, install, maintain, and repair.
  • Be comfortable providing practical feedback to engineers.
  • Notice poor fits, difficult assembly sequences, inaccessible hardware, awkward cable routing, and other design issues.
  • Be comfortable assembling, modifying, disassembling, testing, and troubleshooting complex equipment.
  • Be capable of becoming a go-to technical resource for how the product is built, deployed, and maintained.
  • Communicate effectively with engineers, technicians, suppliers, manufacturing partners, and field personnel.
  • Take ownership of assigned builds, tests, and technical issues through resolution.
  • Work well in a fast-moving environment where priorities shift between prototype development, testing, production support, and field activities.

Travel & Work Schedule

The position will primarily support engineering development, prototype builds, and testing at the company facility.

Periodic travel to customer sites, suppliers, manufacturing partners, and project locations may be required to support builds, installation, training, troubleshooting, and product evaluation.

Occasional non-standard working hours may be required to support testing, installations, deployments, or critical engineering activities.

Shift: 1:30 PM-11:00 PM

Hourly Rate: $21.75 an hour

The Gauging Station Operator sets up assigned equipment for production startup, coordinating with leads to startup the line, monitoring dough for defects making equipment adjustments as needed to ensure quality standards are met, and tracking line downtime following procedure. You will report to the Production Team Leader. You will work onsite at the Council Bluffs Location.

  • Regular attendance to ensure production requirements are met

  • Read, write, communicate, and comprehend written instructions in English

Job Responsibilities:

  • Set control panel and review settings according to scheduled production run

  • Coordinate with leads on production startup

  • Monitor dough for defects making adjustments to control panel to meet specified standards (e.g., texture, broken, and holes)

  • Ensure flour dusters are filled

  • Ensure good housekeeping (e.g., sweeping, mopping)

  • Participate in PM, drumbeat, and AM activities as assigned (varying start times)

  • Will read a work order and receive verbal instructions from supervisors/leads

  • Perform training as assigned

  • Complete Centerline and CIL audits and other required audits and paperwork in English

Skills Required:

  • Distinguish normal/abnormal operations of the production line

  • And with others as a team at all levels

  • Knowledge of GMP's and safety standards

  • Be LOTO certified

  • Work with pork, chicken, beef and shellfish products in addition to many other ingredients and allergens

  • Be SPC certified

Qualifications:

Education: High school diploma or GED.

Experience Required: Minimum 3 months production or related experience.

Anticipated Close Date: November 17, 2026

Location: Council Bluffs, Iowa

Our Benefits

title: Network Engineer (Load Balancing & Network Services)
description:
About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Network Security Engineer to join our high-performing team responsible for critical network services, load balancing platforms, and automation initiatives across a large-scale enterprise environment.

In this role, you will lead platform enhancement and migration activities, support business-as-usual operations, and contribute to the adoption of network automation solutions that improve operational efficiency and service delivery.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and support critical network infrastructure services, load balancing platforms and DNS, DHCP, NTP.
  • Maintain the stability, performance, and security of network services across enterprise environments.
  • Drive platform upgrades, software lifecycle management, and migration initiatives.
  • Design and implement scalable network solutions that align with business and operational requirements.
  • Support the onboarding of new applications and services onto load balancing platforms.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional infrastructure, security, and application teams.
  • Identify and develop automation opportunities to streamline operational tasks and improve service efficiency.

Required Experience & Qualifications

  • 7-9+ years of experience in network engineering, infrastructure, or related disciplines.
  • Strong hands-on experience with load balancing technologies such as:

o F5 Networks

o VMware AVI / NSX Advanced Load Balancer

  • Solid understanding of IP services, including DNS, DHCP & NTP
  • Experience designing and supporting large-scale enterprise network environments.
  • Strong knowledge of routing and switching protocols, including BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, Multicast technologies
  • Experience with Cisco networking platforms, including Catalyst and Nexus solutions.
  • Knowledge of network virtualization platforms such as VMware ESXi and NSX-T.
  • Exposure to automation technologies, scripting, and APIs
  • Understanding of network security principles and best practices.

Desired Skills

  • Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Industry certifications such as CCNP, CCIE, F5 Certified Technology Professional (F5-CTP), or equivalent.
  • Experience with DDI platforms and enterprise DNS solutions.
  • Exposure to network automation frameworks and infrastructure-as-code concepts.

title: Buyer
description:
Enjet Aero machines and fabricates complex jet engine parts, components and assemblies for leading OEMs in the commercial, defense and general aviation sectors. Our goal is to be regarded as an irreplaceable resource by our customers. The only way for a company to meet such a goal is to consistently meet production deadlines and expectations.

Position Description:

The Buyer reports to the Supply Chain Manager. The Buyer is responsible for negotiating purchase price, lead times, reviewing contracts and driving the highest value for the company. The Buyer reviews, analyzes, and executes MRP generated material requisitions and internal purchase requests in support of internal and external customer schedules and requirements; ensures a controlled flow of approved materials to meet production requirements in a cost-effective manner.

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for all aspects of purchasing including purchase price, delivery, lead-time, and terms & conditions, to achieve the best value for the company.
  • Help achieve increased inventory turns, by working with suppliers through consignment, stocking agreements and other programs. Understand the importance of economic order quantity (EOQ).
  • Collaborate with other departments (Engineering, Quality, Operations) to research, analyze and purchase new material and service requirements and establish new suppliers as required.
  • Responsible for Purchase Order placement to support MRP material requirements for direct materials.
  • Generate, manage, and maintain purchase orders, contract documents, and long-term agreement deliverables, ensuring on time delivery and swift resolution of supplier issues.
  • Assure that purchase orders are entered into and updated within the ERP system in an accurate, complete, and timely manner and that customer flow downs are clearly defined.
  • Gather technical data and scope of work details to act as central point of communication with suppliers.
  • Manage supplier compliance with and flow down of US government procurement related requirements.
  • Recommend and assist in development and implementation of process improvements.
  • Work with Accounting to resolve invoice discrepancies.
  • Maintain a professional image with colleagues, customers, and suppliers.
  • Ability to travel, as necessary.
  • Other duties as required.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience. APICS CPIM or Purchasing CPM certification preferred.
  • Five (5) years’ experience as a Buyer in a manufacturing environment, Aerospace experience preferred.
  • Experience with ERP systems such as Oracle or SAP. Epicor experience preferred.
  • Proficient in MRP, BOM structures, Shop-Floor Control, Configuration Management, and Warehouse Operations.
  • Familiar with Lean Manufacturing (5S, Kaizen, etc.)
  • Assertive and win-win negotiating ability.
  • Self-motivated, team player willing to assist where needed.
  • Strong analytical mindset with ability to prioritize workload.
  • Position is on-site, M-F, normal business hours.

Benefits: Enjet offers a comprehensive benefits package to full-time employees including paid time off, health insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, paid holidays, a 401K retirement plan, disability insurance, and more.

As an EOE/AA employer, Enjet Aero will not discriminate in its employment practices due to an applicant's race, color, religious creed, national origin, ancestry, sex, age, veteran status, marital status or physical challenges.

title: Associate Principal, Policy (Vaccines)- Remote US Work role
description:
About Avalere Health

United by one profound purpose: to reach EVERY PATIENT POSSIBLE. At Avalere Health, we ensure every patient is identified, treated, supported, and cared for. Equally. Our Advisory, Medical, and Marketing teams come together – powerfully and intentionally – to forge unconventional connections, building a future where healthcare is not a barrier and no patient is left behind.

Achieving our mission starts with providing enriching, purpose-driven careers for our team that empower them to make a tangible impact on patient lives. We are committed to creating a culture where our employees are empowered to bring their whole selves to work and tap into the power of diverse backgrounds and skillsets to play a part in making a difference for every patient, everywhere.

Our flexible approach to working allows our global teams to decide where they want to work, whether in-office or at home based on team and client need. Major city hubs in London, Manchester, Washington, D.C., and New York, and smaller offices globally, serve as collaboration hubs allowing our teams to come together when it matters. Homeworkers are equally supported, with dedicated social opportunities and resources.

Our inclusive culture is at the heart of everything we do. We proudly support our employees in bringing their whole selves to work with our six Employee Network Groups – Diverse Ability, Family, Gender, LGBTQ+, Mental Health, and Race/Ethnicity. These groups provide opportunities to promote diversity, equity, and inclusion and to connect, learn, and socialise through regular meetings and programs of activity. We are an accredited Fertility Friendly employer with our Fertility Policy, enhanced parental leave, and culture of flexibility ensuring every employee feels supported across their family planning journey and can work in a way that suits their family’s needs.

We are deeply invested in supporting professional growth for our employees through day-to-day career experiences, access to thousands of on-demand training sessions, regular career conversations, and the opportunity for global, cross-capability career moves.

We take pride in being part of the Disability Confident Scheme. This helps make sure you can be interviewed fairly if you have a disability, long term health condition, or are neurodiverse. If you'd like to apply and need adjustments made, you can let us know in your application.

Avalere Health is seeking an Associate Principal to join our Policy Practice Vaccines Team. Associate Principals are critical roles within the Policy Practice and lead multiple projects and accounts and serve as subject matter experts to execute projects and provide clients with actionable policy and business support. This position is a key member of the Policy Practice’s vaccine team and will directly interface with vaccines clients. Specifically, we are seeking a candidate with direct experience in and enthusiasm for vaccine-specific market access, marketing, commercialization, and access-related lifecycle management.

Avalere Health’s Policy Practice relies on deep subject matter expertise and understanding of the business issues facing our clients to assess how the changing policy landscape impact the pharmaceutical industry, managed care plans, providers, and patients. We provide analytic support and advisory services, including regulatory analysis, evidence generation/review support, policy analysis, legislative strategy, and modelling of proposed and enacted policies to a wide range of clients across the healthcare industry, using both qualitative and quantitative research methods.
Avalere Health values people over place; we want our employees to thrive wherever they do their best work, whether fully remote or connected through one of our office hubs across major U.S. cities (Washington D.C., NYC, Philadelphia).

What you'll do

• Serve as a key subject matter expert on policies that affect vaccine coverage, payment and reimbursement, specifically as it may relate to acquisition and contracting, billing complexity, and payer specific strategies.
• Generate both strategic and tactical recommendations for clients that are responsive to their policy and business needs.
• Lead the day-to-day execution of projects and engagements with clients, under the direction of executive leadership, which include managing a project team, setting the strategy to execute the objective of the project or engagement, and ensure quality and timely delivery to the client
• Develop new and creative offerings that respond to the changing needs of our clients
• Participate in strategic and planning discussions across the firm to develop new business and create and execute business development plans to meaningfully contribute toward the Policy Practice’s annual sales and revenue goals.
• Supervise, train and mentor staff members within the practice and across the firm.
• Author thought leadership that raises the profile of your expertise and the practice’s capabilities.

About you

Education Requirements

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in health policy, public policy, public health, healthcare management, business administration, health economics, or biological sciences.

Minimum Requirements:
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in health policy, public policy, public health, healthcare management, business administration, health economics, or biological sciences.
• 6+ years of relevant experience in a healthcare consulting role, vaccine manufacturer, or similar company focusing on policy and market access, marketing, or commercialization for vaccine products.
• Established Subject Matter Expertise on the U.S. vaccine policy and market access landscape at federal and state levels, including how vaccines differ from other medical benefit drugs; pricing, contracting, and reimbursement across Medicare, Medicaid, VFC, Section 317, Universal Purchase states and Commercial markets; state provider scope of practice laws and vaccine purchasing policies.
• Experience reviewing vaccine reimbursement rates, payment analytics, and competitive information to identify and resolve payer-specific barriers for new and existing vaccines.
• Demonstrated experience managing primary market research projects, including IDIs and advisory boards with payers, IDNs, public health providers, and other healthcare decision-makers. Ability to then translate findings into client-facing strategic recommendations.
• Hands-on experience developing market access resources and promotional/non-promotional materials including managing MLR review cycles, incorporating stakeholder feedback, and clearing content through Veeva Vault submission and approval processes.
• Readiness to develop exceptional client-ready PowerPoint presentations and Excel-based analyses that turn complex policy, market, and data insights into clear, compelling narratives.
• Experience in project management and leadership, including developing and finalizing scopes of work, tracking budgets, managing development of client deliverables, adhering to timelines and client engagement.
• Proven situational leadership skills and the ability to motivate and generate enthusiasm with individuals across all levels of the organization.
• Exemplary interpersonal skills that translate into positive relationships with colleagues and clients.
• Commitment to working in a team environment with an emphasis on collaboration and maintaining positive relationships with colleagues and clients.
• Outstanding problem-solving and analytic skills with the ability to apply knowledge outside of one’s immediate functional area.
• Solid communication skills (written and verbal) including the ability to concisely explain complicated concepts to executives within and outside of the firm.

Preferred but not required qualifications:
• Knowledge of vaccine coding, including experience developing applications for the AMA CPT Staff and Panel.
• Ability to evaluate different channel options for pipeline immunization products and identify strategic opportunities based on a target product profile.

What we can offer

You will receive a 401K plan with an employer match contribution up to 4% (immediately vested), as well as life insurance, disability coverage, and medical, dental, and vision plans for peace of mind. Enjoy flexible working arrangements, including hybrid and remote work, along with the option to work from anywhere across the globe two weeks each year. We provide 20 vacation days plus one personal well-being day, recognise 9 public holidays, along with gifted end-of-year holidays and an early Summer Friday finish in June, July, and August.

Access free counselling through our employee assistance program and personalized health support. Our enhanced maternity, paternity, family leave, and fertility policies provide support across every stage of your family-planning journey. You can also benefit from continuous opportunities to professionally develop with on-demand training, support, and global mobility opportunities across the business.

We encourage all applicants to read our candidate privacy notice before applying to Avalere Health.

title: Medical Records Coordinator
description:
About Company:


As one of the largest primary care practices in Southwest Georgia, Albany Area Primary Health Care (AAPHC) provides health care services to more than 54,000 patients and nearly 217,000 office visits per year. AAPHC is also one of the largest Community Health Centers in our region! To learn more about Community Health Centers, and how this benefits Southwest Georgia.

At AAPHC, we strive to provide comprehensive, coordinated, and continuous care to all who access our services. Support regulatory inter-agency frameworks and on-chain controls related to FinCEN Section 314(b) processes, global sanctions compliance, and FinCEN 311-related restrictions.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
About VGS

VGS is building the trust infrastructure for a new era of commerce. As commerce becomes agentic, payments are increasing dramatically in volume, speed, and complexity, and the companies driving that shift need a foundation they can fully trust.

That's where VGS comes in. We're the world's leader in payment tokenization, trusted by the most innovative AI and Fortune 500 companies, merchants, banks, and fintechs to power modern payments and agentic commerce. We store more than 9 billion tokens and process more than 10 billion monthly interactions, touching a third of all e-commerce. That scale isn't incidental. It's why leading companies embed our universal token vault and credential management platform directly into their stack, taming the complexity of payment data so they can move faster.

Come build the platform that enables modern payments for the world's largest companies. We're helping businesses unlock new possibilities in an industry that never stops moving. And that takes exceptional people.

Trusted Engineering That Matters

Engineering at VGS

VGS is building the platform powering agentic commerce and global payments infrastructure. VGS Engineering is the pillar that supports that vision. We create a platform that is an indispensable, ubiquitous component of our partners' payments and security infrastructure. We build and operate high-scale, reliable, and resilient systems that manage mission-critical payment data across the globe. We don't just participate in the payments ecosystem; we power it.


Our Environment & Culture

  • Modern Tooling as Leverage: We value speed and impact. To ensure nothing slows you down, we arm you with a highly consistent modern stack (e.g. AWS, Kubernetes, Java, TypeScript, Python) and world-class AI-augmented SDLC tooling. We strip away the friction so you can focus on the problems that demand creativity and judgment.

  • Ownership of Outcomes: Scaling global payments infrastructure requires individuals who take personal ownership of outcomes from day one. We look for builders who combine high agency with deep strategic alignment; channeling their urgency and relentless iteration into what matters most.

  • Mission-Critical Accountability: We power payments infrastructure for global market leaders, making system trust and integrity our core deliverable. We don't treat compliance (PCI, SOC2, ISO27001), security patching, and platform maintenance as administrative overhead—we engineer them with first-class product discipline. In payments infrastructure, reliability is not background work, it’s part of what customers buy.


Learn More: See how our engineering practices drive trust and innovation in our official blog and our reliability practices.

About the Role

We’re building payment infrastructure for a world where AI agents don’t just recommend, search, and summarize. They transact.


The Agentic API is creating the secure backend layer that enables trusted agents to initiate purchases, operate within user-approved mandates, retrieve scoped payment credentials, and complete transactions without exposing raw card data.


As a Staff Software Engineer, you’ll help pioneer a new category of payment infrastructure at the intersection of AI, card networks, cryptography, and secure money movement, building clean, reliable APIs for the next generation of commerce.

What You’ll Do


  • Architect Agentic Payment Infrastructure: Lead the design and evolution of Python 3.13+ and FastAPI services powering secure, production-critical agentic payment flows.

  • Define the Core API Platform: Design APIs and domain models for card enrollment, agentic token provisioning, purchase intents, mandates, device attestation, OTP flows, confirmations, and cryptogram retrieval.

  • Own Security, Reliability & Scale: Drive architectural decisions across security, scalability, availability, performance, and developer experience for sensitive payment and cryptographic workflows.

  • Build Deep Observability: Establish consistent patterns for error handling, traceability, structured logging, metrics, and distributed tracing using OpenTelemetry and Prometheus.

  • Automate Platform Provisioning: Design extensible provisioning workflows using Kubernetes APIs and Custom Resource Definitions.

  • Set the Quality Bar: Define rigorous unit, integration, acceptance, and end-to-end testing strategies for high-risk payment flows, including canary-safe production validation.

  • Lead Complex Initiatives: Lead technical design reviews, surface architectural and delivery risks early, and drive cross-functional initiatives from initial exploration through reliable production operation.

  • Pioneer AI-Native Engineering: Apply AI-assisted development and agentic workflows across the SDLC to accelerate prototyping, testing, refactoring, investigation, and delivery while maintaining a high quality and security bar.

  • Partner Across the Ecosystem: Collaborate with Product, Security, Infrastructure, Platform, and external card-network partners to translate evolving requirements into secure, scalable systems.

What You Bring

  • Ownership at Scale: 10+ years of experience taking personal ownership of outcomes in complex, large-scale distributed systems within mission-critical environments.

  • AWS & Infrastructure-as-Code: Advanced proficiency in AWS ecosystems leveraging Terraform to build reproducible environments.

  • Containerization & Orchestration: Strong, hands-on experience with Kubernetes (EKS), Docker, and GitOps workflows (Flux, Argo, GitHub Actions).

  • Automation & Scripting: Strong coding skills in Python to automate infrastructure and build operational tools.

  • Observability Expertise: Experience implementing Prometheus, Grafana, or OpenTelemetry at scale.

  • Security & Networking Foundations: Solid understanding of cloud security, API Gateways, load balancing, and network isolation, viewing security as a fundamental engineering constraint, not an afterthought.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with tokenization, payment processing, or security products

  • BA/BS degree

  • A knack for out-of-the-box thinking that thrives in a fast-paced startup environment

  • Experience designing mandate, credential-provisioning, authentication, attestation, or cryptogram-based workflows.

  • Experience applying AI developer tools or agentic automation to day-to-day engineering workflows.

We're looking for passionate professionals who take pride in their craft and want to help grow a team tackling some of the most critical problems in payments. People who thrive here are curious by nature, unafraid of hard problems, and motivated by the chance to build something that matters at scale.

If you're driven to make a meaningful impact, work at the leading edge of payment technology, and grow your career alongside a team that values ownership, collaboration, and continuous learning, you'll feel right at home at VGS.

How We Work

At VGS, we embrace a remote-first philosophy because we believe flexibility leads to great work and a healthy work-life balance. That said, if you live within 30 miles of one of our office locations, you'll be on a hybrid schedule with some in-person time, because we know there's real value in coming together.

We're not about being in the office every day. We are about connection, collaboration, and the energy that comes from a great brainstorm, a team lunch, or celebrating a big win in person.

Our Benefits

Financial and retirement

  • Competitive salary

  • 401 (k) with a 4% match and immediate vesting (applies to US only)

  • Early equity

  • Internet Stipend

  • Learning Stipend

  • Office set-up stipend (applies to US only)


Health and Wellness

  • Insurance (medical, dental, and vision)

  • HSA/FSA Options

  • Life and disability insurance

  • Pet insurance


Vacation and time off

  • Flexible PTO

  • Paid national holidays

  • Global parental leave program


Professional Development

  • Promote from within

  • Lunch and learns

  • Team events and summits


Office life and perks

  • Remote and hybrid opportunities

  • Flexible working hours

  • Weekly office lunches

  • Employee discount platform

Equal Opportunity

We consider all applicants without regard to race, color, national origin, sex, age, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, marital status, physical or mental disability, or other protected classes under all applicable local, state, and federal laws and ordinances (AA/EOE/W/M/Vet/Disabled).

Qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records will be considered for this position in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Where We're Hiring

title: Principal Engineer – NAND Process Pathfinding – Dry Etch

description:
Welcome to Micron's Advanced NAND Process Pathfinding Team — where the next generation of memory technology is developed. We operate at the groundbreaking forefront of semiconductor innovation, engineering world-class memory solutions built for uncompromising performance. If you're ready to redefine what's possible in NAND process technology, we'd love you on this journey with us.

As a Principal Engineer – Dry Etch, you will be part of an innovative Advanced NAND research & development dry etch team. This role offers significant opportunities for inventive work, cooperation, and pushing boundaries with Advanced NAND. You will engage directly with process integration and other process domains including Wet etch, CVD, Diffusion, Metals, Lithography & CMP. You will manage brand new and high-performance dry etch chambers and lead the process roadmap to fulfill program and yield targets.

Responsibilities:

  • Explore advanced dry etch methods to satisfy structural, electrical, yield, and integration demands throughout the NAND technology roadmap.

  • Develop new plasma chemistries, process technologies, and equipment capabilities to enable future technology nodes.

  • Apply advanced data analytics, AI/ML tools, and statistical methodologies to accelerate process learning and improve etch performance.

  • Drive process pathfinding through automation, predictive modeling, and data-driven decision making.

  • Work closely with Process Integration, Thin Films, Wet Etch, Diffusion, Lithography, CMP, and Device teams to drive technology development and manufacturability forward.

  • Leverage AI-enabled engineering tools, advanced analytics, and digital workflows to accelerate process development, improve decision-making, enhance knowledge management, and increase R&D productivity across thin film technology initiatives.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Practical experience with ICP and/or CCP plasma etch technologies in semiconductor process development.

  • Strong understanding of plasma-surface interactions, etch chemistry, profile control, and dry etch equipment fundamentals.

  • Solid foundation in plasma physics, materials interactions, and semiconductor process integration.

  • Experience in developing and refining dry etch processes for advanced semiconductor technologies.

  • Familiarity with statistical analysis, data analytics, and process optimization methodologies.

  • Strong cooperative abilities with the capacity to work efficiently across multidisciplinary engineering teams.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • PhD/MS with 7–10 years of relevant experience in dry etch / semiconductor process development.

  • Experience with high aspect ratio etch, advanced pattern transfer, selective etch, and structural process optimization.

  • Experience applying machine learning, predictive modeling, automation, or virtual process modeling to technology development.

  • Strong problem-solving abilities and the capacity to work autonomously in a dynamic development setting.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.

  • Experience mentoring engineers or leading technical projects is beneficial.

Join a team where curiosity is currency, collaboration is culture, and your work directly develops the memory that powers AI, mobile, automotive, and data center innovation worldwide. If advancing the boundaries of NAND technology excites you, this is where you belong!

title: Director of Football Initiatives & Sponsorships
description:
At AIA we’ve started an exciting movement to create a healthier, more sustainable future for everyone.

It’s about finding new ways to not only better people's lives, but to better the communities and environments we live in. Encompassing our ambition of helping a billion people live Healthier, Longer, Better Lives by 2030.

And as part of our marketing, distribution & partnership team, you’ll play a vital part in advancing this movement.
