title: Global Customs Excellence Lead (80-100%), (m/f/d)
description:
Accelleron is accelerating sustainability in the marine and energy industries as a global technology leader in turbocharging, fuel injection, and digital solutions for heavy-duty applications. Building on a heritage of over 100 years as a trusted industry partner, the company serves customers in more than 100 locations in over 50 countries. Accelleron’s 3,000 employees are continuously innovating to deliver best-in-class products, services, and solutions that are mission-critical for the energy transition. You will join a team of experts in an exciting international environment, committed to excellence and innovation. Together, we support our customers in driving the transition toward sustainable industries with cutting-edge technology, deep expertise, and smart solutions. At Accelleron, we foster diversity and inclusion, welcoming and celebrating individual differences as a source of strength.

In this role, you will be responsible for designing, implementing and continuously improving Accelleron's global customs target operating model, governance framework and customs capabilities.
Working within the Value Chain organization and reporting to the Head of Group Trade Compliance, you will build and continuously develop a best-practice customs organization, establish global process ownership and drive the ongoing development of customs governance, processes, controls and capabilities across the company.

Your responsibilities:
  • Design, implement and continuously improve Accelleron's global customs operating model, including governance, process ownership and organizational responsibilities across the organization.
  • Lead the development of global customs frameworks and controls covering customs valuation, origin & preference, classification, customs procedures and broker governance.
  • Develop, implement and maintain a risk-based customs maturity roadmap and translate strategic objectives into executable improvement initiatives.
  • Own and maintain Accelleron's global customs governance framework, ensuring that customs processes, controls and capabilities continue to evolve in line with business growth, regulatory requirements and strategic priorities.
  • Define customs business requirements, master data governance and reporting requirements and collaborate with key stakeholders to ensure appropriate integration into business and digitalization initiatives.
  • Establish customs monitoring, analytics, KPI frameworks and assurance mechanisms to support sustainable customs governance and continuous improvement.
  • Build customs capabilities across the organization through training, guidance, governance and stakeholder engagement.
  • Act as a trusted advisor on customs-related matters and support interactions with internal and external stakeholders, including customs authorities and external advisors.

Your background:
  • 10+ years of experience in customs and international trade within a multinational environment.
  • Proven experience building, transforming or significantly improving a customs organization, governance framework or customs operating model.
  • Strong expertise in customs valuation, including related-party transactions, transfer-pricing interaction, circumstances-of-sale analysis and customs audit readiness.
  • Strong knowledge of origin & preference, customs classification, free trade agreements and customs procedures.
  • Hands-on experience working with SAP GTS and ERP solutions in a customs and trade compliance environment; experience with SAP S/4HANA is considered a strong advantage.
  • Strong project management, change management and stakeholder management capabilities.
  • Ability to influence and drive change across a global organization without direct authority.
  • University degree in International Trade, Business, Supply Chain, Finance, Law or a related discipline.
  • Fluent written and spoken English.

Your benefits:

  • Development & Growth Opportunities
  • Attractive compensation & benefits
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Global Parental Leave Program
  • Opportunity to Build and Shape a Global Customs Excellence Function

We look forward to receiving your application. If you want to discover more about Accelleron, take another look at our website accelleron.com.

title: Gate Attendant - 2nd Shift (3:30 pm to 1:30 am)
description:
Position Summary:

The Gate Attendant is responsible for controlling access to the warehouse facility by verifying the identity and purpose of visitors, contractors, and truck drivers. This role ensures the safety and security of the premises through thorough documentation, badge issuance, and communication with warehouse personnel.

***This is a 2nd shift position working Monday – Friday from 3:30 pm to 1:30 am and Saturdays during peak season. ***

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Monitor entry and exit points to ensure only authorized individuals are granted access.
  • Verify visitor and driver identification using valid government-issued ID.
  • Issue visitor and driver badges, maintaining accurate records. Register visitors in the logbook or digital system, noting: Full name, company name, contract number, host employee, purpose of visit, time in and time out.
  • Maintain visitor badges and ensure they are returned upon exit.
  • Notify warehouse personnel or department contacts of visitor arrivals.
  • Maintain clear and professional communication with drivers and visitors.
  • Report any irregularities or unauthorized access attempts.
  • Periodically check containers coming in and out of the facility.

Truck and Driver Processing:

  • Record truck details including license plate, carrier, and cargo information.
  • Direct drivers to designated loading/unloading areas.
  • Ensure that yard safety protocols are communicated to each driver.

Security and Safety Compliance:

  • Conduct routine checks of the premises and surrounding area.
  • Follow emergency protocols in case of incidents or security breaches.
  • Report safety hazards or suspicious activity immediately.

Required Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Previous experience in security or warehouse operations preferred.
  • Strong communication and customer service skills.
  • Ability to operate digital logging systems and radio communication devices.
  • Knowledge of warehouse safety procedures is a plus.
  • Attention to detail and accuracy in record-keeping.
  • Ability to remain calm and professional in high-pressure situations.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to multitask.
  • Basic computer skills for log entry and reporting.

Physical Demands:

  • Ability to stand for extended periods.
  • Moderate lifting (up to 30lbs) may be required

Work Environment:

  • Primarily stationed indoors of the warehouse with periodic outdoor duties.

Equipment Used:

title: MuleSoft Integration Developer (Veeva Vault)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a MuleSoft Integration Developer (Veeva Vault) based in Netherlands.

This is a remote contract opportunity for an experienced integration developer supporting enterprise systems within the pharmaceutical industry. You will design, develop, and deploy integrations connecting Veeva Vault with other business-critical platforms. The role combines hands-on MuleSoft Anypoint Platform development with practical knowledge of Veeva Vault APIs, authentication, objects, and metadata. You will build reliable API-led and event-driven integrations supporting both real-time and batch data flows. Reliability is central to the role, with a focus on error handling, retries, and idempotent processing. This opportunity is well suited to a technically strong integration specialist who can work independently in a project-focused environment.

Accountabilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain APIs and integration flows using the MuleSoft Anypoint Platform.
  • Build enterprise integrations connecting Veeva Vault with other business and technology systems.
  • Configure MuleSoft connectors and implement reliable integrations with Veeva Vault.
  • Work with Veeva Vault APIs, authentication mechanisms, objects, metadata, and related data structures.
  • Design and implement API-led connectivity patterns to support scalable enterprise integrations.
  • Develop publish/subscribe messaging patterns where required by integration architecture.
  • Implement both batch and real-time data synchronization processes.
  • Build robust integration flows with appropriate error handling and recovery mechanisms.
  • Implement retry strategies to improve reliability and resilience across integration processes.
  • Apply idempotency patterns to prevent duplicate processing and maintain data integrity.
  • Design integrations with appropriate handling of failures, exceptions, and downstream system issues.
  • Deploy integration applications using MuleSoft CloudHub or Runtime Fabric (RTF).
  • Participate in the full development lifecycle from integration design through implementation and deployment.
  • Collaborate with relevant technical and business stakeholders to understand integration requirements.
  • Troubleshoot integration issues and refine solutions to ensure stable production operation.
  • Apply API integration best practices across REST, SOAP, and related enterprise integration technologies.

    • Requirements:

    • 4–7 years of total IT experience, including at least 2–3 years of hands-on MuleSoft/Anypoint Platform development.
    • Strong practical experience developing integrations using the MuleSoft Anypoint Platform.
    • Experience designing and implementing APIs, integration flows, and MuleSoft connectors.
    • Practical understanding of API design principles and enterprise integration patterns.
    • Working knowledge of Veeva Vault APIs, authentication mechanisms, objects, and metadata.
    • Sufficient understanding of the Veeva Vault data and object model to independently develop integrations.
    • Experience with API integration technologies, particularly REST and SOAP.
    • Understanding of API-led connectivity and its application to enterprise integration architectures.
    • Experience implementing publish/subscribe messaging patterns.
    • Understanding of the differences between batch and real-time data synchronization and when to apply each approach.
    • Hands-on experience implementing error handling, retry mechanisms, and idempotency.
    • Ability to design integrations that minimize duplicate processing and maintain data consistency.
    • Experience deploying MuleSoft applications using CloudHub and/or Runtime Fabric (RTF).
    • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills for diagnosing integration and API issues.
    • Ability to work independently in a remote environment and manage technical responsibilities effectively.
    • Good communication and collaboration skills when working with technical stakeholders and project teams.
    • Experience in the pharmaceutical industry would be advantageous.

      • Benefits:

      • Remote working opportunity.
      • Location: Europe, with the role based in the Netherlands.
      • Freelance / Contract engagement.
      • Start date: October 2026.
      • 40 hours per week.
      • Opportunity to work on enterprise integration projects within the pharmaceutical industry.
      • Hands-on exposure to MuleSoft Anypoint Platform and Veeva Vault integration technologies.
      • Opportunity to work with API-led connectivity, real-time and batch integration, and enterprise integration patterns.
      • Technical environment focused on reliable, scalable, and resilient system integrations.

title: Creative Strategist
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Creative Strategist based in Canada.

This is a hands-on creative strategy role focused on building and scaling high-performing paid advertising creative. You will own the full creative lifecycle, from concept development and briefing through production, testing, and iteration. Working closely with creative and production teams, you will turn performance insights into new hooks, angles, scripts, and campaigns. The role offers significant ownership within a fast-moving, mission-led environment. You will manage a high-volume creative pipeline while balancing brand consistency with performance objectives. Success will be measured through creative quality, throughput, learning, and measurable advertising results.

Accountabilities:

  • Own the creative pipeline from ideation and briefing through production, launch, testing, and learning.
  • Develop advertising concepts, hooks, angles, scripts, and creative approaches across acquisition, consideration, conversion, and retargeting.
  • Translate concepts into clear, actionable briefs that editors, designers, creators, and videographers can execute independently.
  • Brief and coordinate creative production while maintaining quality, pace, brand alignment, and delivery standards.
  • Collaborate closely with the Creative Director and production team to ensure creative work reflects the appropriate brand voice and direction.
  • Establish clear hypotheses and performance objectives for each creative concept.
  • Monitor creative performance and use metrics and testing results to guide new concepts, iterations, and variations.
  • Identify creative fatigue and proactively develop fresh angles and creative variations to sustain performance.
  • Build and maintain repeatable creative systems, including briefs, trackers, templates, guidelines, and production workflows.
  • Manage a high-volume pipeline of approximately 30 creative concepts per month, depending on production requirements.
  • Provide evidence of previous creative strategy work, including briefs, testing processes, performance results, and examples of campaigns or concepts developed personally.
  • Complete a paid trial involving an initial batch of concepts taken through the creative process from concept and briefing through production and review.

    • Requirements:

    • 4–5 years of relevant professional experience in creative strategy, paid social, direct-response advertising, or performance marketing.
    • Strong hands-on experience developing creative for paid social platforms, particularly Meta and TikTok.
    • Proven ability to develop and scale advertising creative at meaningful volume, supported by specific examples and measurable results.
    • Strong understanding of creative performance metrics and testing, including CTR, CVR, ROAS, hook rate, and creative fatigue.
    • Excellent concept development, hook creation, scriptwriting, and creative briefing skills.
    • Experience managing or coordinating editors, creators, designers, videographers, or other creative production resources.
    • Ability to independently manage the full concept → brief → production → launch → learning lifecycle.
    • Strong understanding of full-funnel creative strategy across acquisition, consideration, conversion, and retargeting.
    • Excellent creative judgment, communication, organization, ownership, and independent working skills.
    • Comfortable challenging ideas constructively while remaining responsive to brand direction and performance data.
    • Collaborative, low-ego approach and ability to work effectively within a founder-led environment.
    • Experience with DTC and e-commerce brands, UGC, creator-led content, partnership ads, or influencer creative is a plus.
    • Experience with premium, values-driven, heritage, food, or mission-led brands is helpful but not essential.
    • Familiarity with Palestinian culture, history, agriculture, or initiatives supporting Palestinian farmers is considered an advantage.

      • Benefits:

      • Remote contractor engagement.
      • Primary, near full-time commitment of approximately 30–40 hours per week.
      • Flexible engagement measured primarily by creative output, quality, and delivery rather than fixed working hours.
      • Paid trial at the beginning of the engagement, with successful completion leading to an ongoing monthly contractor arrangement.
      • Opportunity to own a high-volume creative pipeline and directly influence advertising performance.
      • Close collaboration with creative leadership and production specialists.
      • Exposure to a mission-led organization focused on supporting small-scale farmers and connecting their products with consumers globally.
      • Contractors provide their own laptop, basic equipment, reliable connectivity, and secure working environment.
      • Any specialized equipment, leave, stipend, wellbeing benefits, or other additional support will be provided only where separately approved.
      • Planned engagement check-ins are expected around month 1 and month 3, or according to an otherwise approved cadence.

BorgWarner is a global product leader in delivering innovative and sustainable mobility solutions. title: Mammography Technologist
description:
Envision Imaging is seeking a Full-Time Mammography Technologist
Bone density experience preferred
Monday - Friday / 40 hours a week| Position pay range: $35.48 - $49.44 | $10,000 sign-on bonus to eligible hires
This role will support our newest center in Coppell, opening in January 2027

Summary/Objective:

Performs routine and diagnostic exams relating to breast anatomy and bone density to obtain images at a satisfactory level with minimal supervision.

Essential Functions

1. Interfaces with patient to ascertain medical history and provides instructions and explanation of the procedure and/or exam to obtain the best possible image. Also provides patient education on breast self-examination as needed.

2. Reviews patient charts for missed clinical information and/or consent. Screens patients for surgical and other implants, contrast allergies, etc.

3. Obtains prior imaging as needed and performs high quality scans to submit to the Radiologist for interpretation.

4. Performs Bone Density and Mammography exams while attending to patient’s care before, during and following exam and notifies the appropriate party if patient’s condition changes at any time.

5. Transfers images to other locations as needed.

6. Coordinates procedure protocols with Radiologist.

7. Maintains and regularly inspects equipment and immediately reports any quality concerns as well as equipment failures or deficiencies.

8. Interfaces with Lead Technologist & Center/Area Manager regarding any and all departmental concerns.

9. Other duties as assigned.

Competencies

1. Technical Capacity.

2. Ethical Conduct.

3. Thoroughness.

4. Time Management.

5. Personal Effectiveness/Credibility.

Supervisory Responsibilities

This position has no supervision responsibilities.

Work Environment

This job operates in an environmentally controlled outpatient clinical environment. Potential exposure to radiation, which is minimized by the use of Personal Protective Equipment. Possible exposure to bodily fluids, communicable diseases, toxic substances, ionizing radiation and other conditions common to a medical office environment. Often requires work in cool, dimly lighted rooms.

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by and employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee may exert up to 50 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 30 pounds of force frequently, and/or up to 10 pounds of force constantly to move objects. The employee is regularly required to use hands and fingers to handle, feel or operate objects, tools or controls and reach with hands and arms. The employee is frequently required to talk and hear. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and the ability to adjust focus.

Travel

No travel is expected for this position.

Job Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

  • Two plus years’ experience in Mammography – preferred

description:
JOB DESCRIPTION:

The VP level Single Stock Exotic Trader is responsible for overseeing and supporting a specialized exotic derivatives trading book and proactively managing complex, non-linear book risk, in coordination with the Trading, Structuring, and Quantitative Research teams. The overall objective of this role is to ensure book trades deliver on budgeted revenues, maintain rigorous quantitative risk control across volatility surfaces and correlation dynamics, and coordinate with key internal and external stakeholders to develop and scale Citi’s equity exotic derivatives and structured solutions franchise.

Responsibilities

Equity Exotic Book Trading, Structuring & Revenue Generation

  • Oversee and support a specialized Exotic Trading book, driving revenue generation, competitive market-making, and disciplined capital allocation within established risk limits.

  • Trade and structure non-linear and path-dependent products, including: Autocallables, Accumulators, Volatility Swaps, Correlation & Dispersion structures, Worst-Of/Best-Of baskets.

  • Coordinate across Markets and Securities Services: Partner seamlessly with Structuring, Institutional Sales, Retail Sales, and Platform team to originate marquee client transactions and expand client wallet share.

  • Anticipate client demand in the exotic market: Identify macro structural trends, shifts in volatility regimes, and client appetite across Institutional, Corporate, and Global Wealth Management segments for yield enhancement, downside protection, and tail-risk hedging.

  • Deliver secondary market liquidity: Provide active pricing, unwinds, roll-overs, and restructuring for existing exotic derivatives and structured note portfolios.

  • Establish and maintain key institutional relationships: Foster top-tier liquidity and trading relationships with interdealer brokers, institutional counterparties, and liquidity providers to optimize execution flow and funding.

Quantitative Risk & Dynamic Higher-Order Greeks Management

  • Manage multi-dimensional book risk: Actively hedge and dynamically balance complex Greek exposures across spot, volatility, and correlation dimensions:

    • First- & Second-Order Greeks: Delta, Gamma, Cross-Gamma, Vega, and Theta across multi-tenor implied volatility surfaces.

    • Higher-Order Greeks: Vanna, Volga, Charm, Color, Speed, and Volatility Skew/Smile dynamics.

    • Cross-Asset & Correlation Risks: Multi-asset correlation smiles, dispersion dynamics, dividend projections, repo curves, and borrow costs.

    • Discontinuous & Barrier Risks: Jump-to-default, gap risk, pin risk around knock-in/knock-out barriers, and autocall observation dates.

  • Quantitative Scenario Analysis & Stress Testing: Run extensive intraday scenario analyses, jump-to-default simulations, tail-risk stress tests, and extreme liquidity shock assessments.

Quantitative Analytics & Front-Office Infrastructure Development

  • Quantitative Model Calibration: Partner with Core Quantitative Research and Quant Developing teams to implement, test, and calibrate advanced exotic pricing models

  • Front-Office Tooling & Analytics: Build and maintain real-time risk dashboards, and automated quoting tools using Python, and VBA.

  • Coordinate with Desk Analysts & Quants: Mentor and guide desk analysts on daily runbooks, P&L attribution, and pricing parameter calibration.

Governance, Controls & Supervision

  • Lead strong governance and controls: Champion an uncompromising risk and control environment across all trading, structuring, and booking activities.

  • Control Function Partnership: Work in close partnership with control functions such as Legal, Compliance, Market Risk Management, Model Risk Governance (MRG), Credit Risk, Internal Audit, and Product Control / Finance to ensure appropriate governance and control infrastructure.

  • Build a culture of responsible finance: Promote good governance, diligent supervision, expense discipline, and high ethical standards across the desk.

  • Risk/Reward Assessment: Appropriately assess the risk/reward of transactions when making business decisions; demonstrate proper consideration for the firm’s reputation and balance commercial drive with risk prudence.

  • Supervision & Policy Adherence: Be familiar with and adhere to Citi’s Code of Conduct, the Plan of Supervision for Global Markets and Securities Services, and all relevant trading mandates, limit frameworks, and operational policies.

  • Regulatory Compliance: Drive compliance with global regulatory requirements (e.g., Dodd-Frank, EMIR, MiFID II / PRIIPs, FRTB, SIMM, initial margin rules) and model governance standards.

  • Registrations & Licensing: Obtain and maintain all required registrations and licenses applicable to the role and jurisdiction within the appropriate timeframe.

  • Control Issue Escalation: Safeguard Citigroup, its clients, and assets by adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior and business practices, and escalating, managing, and reporting control issues with transparency.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 4–6 years of professional experience in Exotic Derivatives Trading or a related area.

  • Product & Exotic Market Knowledge: Deep domain expertise in path-dependent exotic options, non-linear payoffs, volatility surfaces, correlation products, and structured notes.

  • Quantitative & Numerical Competency:

    • Advanced analytical, mathematical, and numerical competency with a strong understanding of stochastic calculus, and numerical methods (Monte Carlo, PDEs).

  • Technical & Programming Proficiency:

    • Strong coding skills in Python (NumPy, SciPy, Pandas) and/or C++ for financial modeling, analytics, and rapid risk tool development.

  • Licensing & Registrations: Required licensing and registrations as applicable by jurisdiction (FINRA Series 7, 63, 57, 3 in the US).

  • Communication & Stakeholder Management: Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication skills; ability to articulate complex quantitative ideas, payoff structures, and risk metrics to sales teams, clients, control functions, and senior management.

  • Commercial & Interpersonal Acumen: Effective interpersonal skills to develop and maintain strong collaborative relationships with internal and external stakeholders; ability to analyze and pitch situations and determine suitable counterparties.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree / master’s degree in a quantitative discipline (Quantitative Finance, Financial Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, Engineering, Econometrics) or equivalent experience.

title: Postdoctoral Researcher in Speech and Language Technology
description:
Aalto University is where science and art meet technology and business. We shape a sustainable future by making research breakthroughs in and across our disciplines, sparking the game changers of tomorrow and creating novel solutions to major global challenges. Our community is made up of 16 000 students and 5 200 employees, including 446 professors. Our campus is in Espoo, Greater Helsinki, Finland. Diversity is part of who we are, and we actively work to ensure our community’s diversity and inclusiveness. This is why we warmly encourage qualified candidates from all backgrounds to join our community.

The research will be carried out at the Department of Information and Communications Engineering, DICE, at Aalto University, Finland. The project environment offers excellent infrastructure for deep learning, speech, and audio research, including Aalto University’s large-scale scientific computing cluster with CPU and GPU nodes, access to CSC’s national computing infrastructure including LUMI, and the Aalto Acoustics Lab with anechoic chambers, listening rooms, and audio measurement equipment.

We are now looking for a Postdoctoral Researcher in Speech and Language Technology

Are you interested in transparency, content provenance, and traceability for AI-generated speech, music, and audio? We are looking for a Postdoctoral Researcher to join the funded project COWAMA: Content-based watermarking for AI-generated audio, led by Assistant Professor Lauri Juvela.

Generative AI can now create increasingly realistic speech and music, raising urgent questions about misinformation, copyright, ownership, attribution, and accountability. The EU AI Act requires generative AI systems to label generated content, but external metadata is easy to remove, so additional layers of technical disclosure and detection are necessary. This project develops watermarking methods and software for speech and audio generative models, focusing on robustness and suitability for open-source use.

Your role and goals

As a Postdoctoral Researcher, you will take primary responsibility for developing deep content-based watermarks for audio and work jointly with a doctoral researcher on robustness, evaluation, and generalization.

Your work will include:

  • Developing new content-based audio watermarking methods for generated speech, music, and audio.

  • Designing detection and perceptual quality measures for cases where generated audio may deviate from the reference content but should remain perceptually acceptable.

  • Exploring methods such as audio content detection, music information retrieval, audio fingerprinting, alignment search, feature matching in self-supervised audio representations, and reference-free audio quality prediction.

  • Integrating watermarking capabilities into deep audio generative models, including extensions of collaborative watermarking to diffusion models and audio language models based on neural audio codecs.

  • Studying whether watermark information can be embedded in long-term content, such as speech semantics, duration, prosody, or emphasis, rather than only in local signal-level features.

  • Developing robustness evaluation methods, differentiable augmentation tools, and realistic attack scenarios for audio watermarks.

  • Publishing research in leading journals and conferences in speech, audio, and machine learning, and contributing to open-source releases of software, trained models, and reproducible research outputs.

The research methods will include experiment design, software implementation, running deep learning experiments on high-performance computing infrastructure, and evaluation using objective metrics and subjective listening tests.

Your network and team

You will be supervised by Assistant Professor Lauri Juvela, who leads the Speech Synthesis research group at Aalto University. The group works on deep generative models for speech and audio, speech synthesis, differentiable signal processing, deepfake detection, and watermarking.

In addition to the Aalto speech groups and the Doctoral Researcher in the project, you will work with an international collaboration network including Prof. Junichi Yamagishi at the National Institute of Informatics in Japan, Prof. Xavier Serra at Universitat Pompeu Fabra in Spain, Prof. Gustav Eje Henter at KTH Royal Institute of Technology in Sweden.

The collaboration network has a strong background in speech and audio synthesis, deep generative models, and deepfake detection, positioning the project to make an impact in watermarking and source tracing for AI-generated audio.

Your experience and ambitions

We are looking for a motivated researcher with a strong interest in generative AI, speech, music, and audio technologies. To succeed in this role, you should have:

  • A doctoral degree, or close to completing a doctoral degree, in speech or audio processing, machine learning, signal processing, computer science, or a related field.

  • Strong experience with deep learning and generative models.

  • Programming skills suitable for modern machine learning research, preferably including Python and deep learning frameworks.

  • Interest in one or more of the following areas: speech synthesis, music generation, neural audio codecs, diffusion models, audio language models, watermarking, deepfake detection, audio quality assessment, or audio representation learning.

  • Ability to conduct independent research and publish in high-quality peer-reviewed venues.

  • Motivation to work in an open-science-oriented project with open-source software and reproducible research outputs.

  • Good collaboration and communication skills in an international research environment.

  • Fluency in English is required. Finnish language is not required.

Doctoral- and master’s-level supervision experience is considered an advantage.

What we offer

  • A meaningful and timely research topic at the intersection of generative AI, audio technology, transparency, and digital trust. The project addresses the need for best practices and standards for navigating AI-generated content, with a focus on transparent, open, and distributed academic solutions.

  • The chance to work on methods that improve transparency and security in AI-generated speech and audio through watermarking, source tracing, and deepfake detection.

  • Access to excellent computing and research infrastructure, including Aalto’s CPU/GPU clusters, CSC and LUMI, FIN-CLARIN language resources, and the Aalto Acoustics Lab.

  • An international collaboration network with leading researchers and organizations in speech synthesis, music technology, deepfake detection, and audio generation.

  • Strong support for open science, including open-access publishing and open-source release of software, models, and datasets.

  • Great possibilities for competence development and learning. Aalto offers a wide range of professional development opportunities, staff training, and development projects based on your interests and needs.

  • A culture guided by responsibility, courage, and collaboration, where equality and inclusion support curiosity, innovation, collaboration, and wellbeing.

Our vast array of professional development opportunities means you will grow and learn, having the chance to participate actively in staff training and development projects based on your interests and needs. The starting salary for Postdoctoral Researcher 4220 €/month. The salary will increase based on performance. The position is fixed-term and will be for 2 years. Project funding has been awarded for 4 years, and the contract may be extended for another 2 years. The position starts in January 2027 or as mutually agreed.

We value work-life balance and well-being in all aspects of life. We work in a hybrid model, with the primary workplace located at the Otaniemi Campus in Espoo, Finland. Life on the revitalized campus is vibrant, featuring stunning architecture, tranquil nature, and a variety of cafes, restaurants, and services, all complemented by excellent public transportation connections.

Join us!
To apply, please share your CV, motivation letter, and copies of degree certificates and academic transcripts with us through our recruitment site ("Apply now!” at the bottom of the page) at the latest on 31st October 2026 23.59pm (EET).

For more information about the role, please contact Professor Lauri Juvela (lauri.juvela@aalto.fi; +358 50 464 6653). For questions about the application process, please contact HR Advisor Johanna Haapalainen at hr-elec@aalto.fi.

description:

The Corrugator Downstacker on the 2nd shift plays a critical role in the efficient operation of our corrugator production line within the non-durable goods manufacturing sector. This position is responsible for safely and accurately removing and stacking finished corrugated board sheets as they exit the corrugator machine, ensuring continuous workflow and minimizing downtime. The role demands close attention to detail to maintain product quality and adherence to safety standards while working in a fast-paced environment. The successful candidate will collaborate with maintenance and production teams to promptly address any operational issues and support overall production goals. Ultimately, this position contributes directly to meeting production targets and maintaining the high standards expected by our customers and company.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Previous experience in a manufacturing environment, preferably with corrugator or packaging machinery.
  • Ability to work the 2nd shift schedule reliably.
  • Basic mechanical aptitude and ability to follow safety procedures.
  • Physical ability to stand for extended periods, lift up to 50 pounds, and perform repetitive tasks.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience specifically with corrugator downstacking or related packaging machinery.
  • Familiarity with lean manufacturing principles and continuous improvement practices.
  • Forklift certification or experience operating material handling equipment.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively in a team environment.
  • Basic computer skills for logging production data.

Responsibilities:

  • Monitor the corrugator machine output and efficiently downstack finished corrugated sheets according to production specifications.
  • Ensure proper stacking techniques to prevent damage to products and facilitate smooth handling for subsequent processes.
  • Perform routine inspections of the downstacking area and equipment to identify and report any mechanical issues or safety hazards.
  • Collaborate with maintenance personnel to assist in troubleshooting and resolving equipment malfunctions promptly.
  • Adhere strictly to all safety protocols and company policies to maintain a safe working environment during the 2nd shift.
  • Maintain accurate production records and communicate any discrepancies or concerns to shift supervisors.
  • Assist in housekeeping duties to keep the work area clean and organized.

Skills:

The required skills such as mechanical aptitude and adherence to safety protocols are essential for operating and monitoring the downstacking process effectively, ensuring product quality and workplace safety. Physical stamina and attention to detail enable the candidate to manage repetitive tasks and maintain consistent production flow without compromising standards. Preferred skills like forklift operation and familiarity with lean manufacturing enhance the candidate’s ability to contribute to overall operational efficiency and support continuous improvement initiatives. Communication skills facilitate clear reporting of issues and collaboration with maintenance and supervisory teams, which is vital during the 3rd shift when resources may be limited. Basic computer skills assist in accurate documentation and tracking of production metrics, supporting data-driven decision-making and process optimization.

You will work on virtual private networking that enables reliable connectivity across distributed datacenter environments.
The role combines high-level control-plane development in Go with low-level dataplane and systems engineering, primarily involving C and open-source technologies.
You will contribute to secure networking services including virtual networks, load balancers, firewalls, security groups, and connectivity features.
A key focus will be improving scalability, resilience, performance, and stability across critical cloud infrastructure.
You will investigate challenging networking, datapath, kernel, and performance issues while collaborating with experienced engineers across the platform.

title: Safety Coordinator
description:
Location: Pardeeville, WI

Compensation: $25.00 per hour

Shift: Multiple Shifts Available + overtime as needed

Position Summary

The Safety Coordinator position is ideal for a highly engaged, floor-oriented safety professional who is passionate about fostering a strong culture of safety and building positive relationships throughout the organization. The successful candidate will possess a solid understanding of workplace safety principles, OSHA regulations, and best practices, along with the ability to effectively partner with employees and leadership at all levels. The ideal candidate will have experience supporting and contributing to a robust safety program and will thrive in a hands-on environment where visibility, collaboration, and employee engagement are critical to success. They will demonstrate patience, strong communication skills, and a commitment to coaching and educating team members on safe work practices. Through active involvement on the production floor, this individual will help reinforce ThermoSafe's commitment to safety, ensuring employees understand, embrace, and consistently follow established safety policies and procedures while promoting continuous improvement across the facility.

Key Responsibilities

  • Promote continuous improvement of workplace health and safety programs to reduce incidents, prevent injuries and illnesses, ensure regulatory compliance, and strengthen a culture of safety throughout the facility.
  • Champion and support a safety-first culture by engaging, coaching, and motivating employees at all levels to prioritize safe work practices and behaviors.
  • Coordinate and manage day-to-day environmental, health, and safety activities to ensure compliance with applicable regulations, company policies, and established safety procedures.
  • Maintain awareness of and implement corporate safety initiatives, programs, and best practices to ensure facility alignment with organizational safety objectives.
  • Support compliance with all Federal, State, and local occupational health and safety regulations through routine assessments, monitoring, and documentation.
  • Partner with hourly and salaried employees on a daily basis to promote safety awareness, accident prevention, and proactive risk reduction efforts.
  • Conduct regular safety inspections, compliance audits, and hazard assessments to identify areas of risk and ensure adherence to safety standards.
  • Develop, recommend, and track corrective actions to address identified hazards, improve workplace safety, and prevent recurrence of safety incidents.
  • Assist in the investigation of workplace incidents, near misses, and safety concerns to determine root causes and support corrective and preventive actions.
  • Maintain safety records, reports, training documentation, and compliance-related communications in accordance with company and regulatory requirements.
  • Support employee safety training and ongoing education initiatives to reinforce safe work practices and regulatory compliance.
  • Collaborate with facility leadership to drive continuous improvement initiatives and achieve established safety performance goals.

Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • 2–4 years of safety experience in a manufacturing or industrial environment.
  • Working knowledge of Federal, State, and local safety regulations and industry standards.
  • Strong written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
  • Ability to conduct safety inspections, compliance audits, and hazard assessments.
  • Strong organizational skills with attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Effective problem-solving, analytical, and decision-making skills.
  • Ability to work independently and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to build positive working relationships with hourly and salaried employees.
  • Willingness to travel occasionally as needed.

Preferred

  • Bachelor's degree in Occupational Health & Safety, Environmental Health & Safety (EHS), Environmental Science, or a related field.
  • Bilingual in English and Spanish.
  • Experience leading safety programs and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Knowledge of OSHA compliance, incident investigations, and corrective action processes.
  • Experience delivering employee safety training and facilitating safety meetings.
  • Professional safety certifications such as OSHA 30, ASP, CSP, or CHST.
  • Demonstrated ability to promote a positive safety culture and influence organizational change.


Physical & Work Environment Requirements


This position requires regular standing and walking throughout the workday and involves repetitious duties in a manufacturing environment. Employees frequently use their hands and arms to perform job duties and may occasionally stoop, kneel, crouch, crawl, speak, and hear. The role requires the ability to lift, carry, and move materials weighing up to 50 pounds as needed.

Work is performed in a manufacturing environment that is not temperature-controlled. Employees may be exposed to varying indoor temperatures and seasonal conditions typical of an industrial production setting. The work environment may also involve exposure to moving mechanical equipment, chemicals, fumes, airborne particles, and elevated noise levels. The use of personal protective equipment (PPE), including respiratory and hearing protection, may be required based on job assignments and work area conditions.

We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

title: Criminal Justice Therapist
description:
This position is hybrid role, combining responsibilities for a part-time Forensic Clinician and part-time Jail Based Behavioral Services Clinician.

The Forensic and Jail-Based Behavioral Services Clinician provides specialized behavioral health assessment, treatment, case management, and criminal justice system coordination for individuals involved in forensic and correctional settings. This role serves as the primary clinician for individuals found 'Not Guilty by Reason of Insanity' (NGRI) who are transitioning from or residing in the community under Community Placement or Conditional Release status, while also acting as the primary point of contact for Jefferson County Jail Based Behavioral Services (JBBS). Responsibilities include conducting assessments, providing individual and group therapy, coordinating referrals and services with criminal justice and community partners, ensuring compliance with court-ordered and program requirements, preparing required reports and documentation, supporting interagency collaboration, and maintaining data for program evaluation and reporting. The position promotes continuity of care across the forensic and criminal justice systems to support client stability, recovery, and community safety.

Education, Knowledge, Skills & Experience Required:

  • Master’s Degree (from an accredited university/college) in Psychology, Counseling, Social Work or a related field, plus one to two years related experience and/or training
  • License (LCSW, LMFT, LPC) preferred
  • Candidate Status (SWC, LSW, MFTC, LPCC) required.
  • Bilingual (English/Spanish) preferred.

Essential Duties:

  • Provides clinical services to assigned consumers, including ongoing assessment of risk and compliance with terms of release.
  • Prepares and submits timely quarterly reports to Forensic and Community Based Service Team (FCBS) and the District Attorney (DA).
  • Facilitates communication and coordination between FCBS, the legal system, and Jefferson Center.
  • Incorporates conditions specified by FCBS and the court into Jefferson Center treatment planning process.
  • Facilitates communication and coordination between FCBS and the center.
  • Reports any unusual incidents, special circumstances, violation of conditions, or clinical decompensation to FCBS.
  • Attends quarterly meetings with FCBS team to identify issues and monitor progress.
  • Provide intake/assessment to appropriate referrals
  • Provide individual, group therapy and evidence-based practices as indicated to adults with co-occurring mental health and substance use diagnoses
  • Provide services to meet need: primarily jail based, with some remote and community office-based time
  • Conduct initial community-based therapy sessions upon consumer release, and coordinate the transfer of care to appropriate programs as indicated
  • Enter/maintain/update referral log and track program outcomes as assigned
  • Regular communication with partnering agencies to generate referrals and maintain contacts; provide follow up on all referrals in timely manner

Other Duties:

  • Timely completion of paperwork/documentation for clinical files
  • Attend regularly scheduled team meetings and supervision
  • Submit 90% of all Progress to Date notes within 3 working days
  • Presentations and public speaking engagements as scheduled
  • Work with Jefferson Center management and development departments to explore and identify future program development for adult offenders with serious mental health needs
  • Exhibit enthusiasm, courtesy, adaptability, flexibility and spirit of cooperation in the work environment
  • Maintain effective interpersonal relations with consumers, peers, supervisors, management, visitors and the general public
  • Effectively respond to consumer needs and problems, initiate and maintain positive interactions, timely responses to phone calls, pages, email and all other requests
  • Attend mandatory in-services, compliance with individualized training plan as required
  • Participate in supervision by coming prepared with an agenda. Report high risk/problem cases, and utilize a problem solving approach/utilize feedback
  • Use language and behavior to promote dignity/respect with consumers, Center staff and external customers
  • Meet required number of consumer service hours as determined by Network Director and/or Clinical Manager
  • Exhibit enthusiasm, courtesy, adaptability, flexibility, and spirit of cooperation in the work environment
  • Maintain effective interpersonal relations with consumers, peers, subordinates, upper management, visitors and the general public
  • Demonstrate cultural competency/awareness/skills in working with diverse caseload and utilizes Center resources/trainings as needed
  • Effectively respond to client/consumer needs and problems, initiate and maintain positive interactions, timely response to phone calls, pages, email, etc
  • Volunteer to work on Center committees
  • Educate Jefferson Center staff and other key agencies about the programs
  • Attend mandatory in-services, trainings, staffings and consultations as scheduled
  • Participate in supervision by coming prepared with an agenda. Report high risk and problem cases, utilize a problem-solving approach as well as feedback

Note: Employees are held accountable for all duties of this job. This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications associated with the job.

Salary Range Master's Level (LPCC, MFTC, LSW, SWC) - $57,000 - $64,000*

Salary Range Licensed Therapist (LCSW, LPC, LMFT) - $70,000 - $77,200*

Additional Salary Information*:

title: Senior System Engineer (Virtual Private Cloud Team)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior System Engineer (Virtual Private Cloud Team) based in Germany.

This is a senior systems engineering role focused on building and operating the core networking layer of a large-scale cloud platform.
You will work on virtual private networking that enables reliable connectivity across distributed datacenter environments.
The role combines high-level control-plane development in Go with low-level dataplane and systems engineering, primarily involving C and open-source technologies.
You will contribute to secure networking services including virtual networks, load balancers, firewalls, security groups, and connectivity features.
A key focus will be improving scalability, resilience, performance, and stability across critical cloud infrastructure.
You will investigate challenging networking, datapath, kernel, and performance issues while collaborating with experienced engineers across the platform.
This is an opportunity to work on foundational infrastructure where your engineering decisions directly influence the reliability of cloud services.

Accountabilities

  • Develop and operate the Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) networking layer that provides reliable connectivity for cloud workloads.
  • Design and implement scalable and resilient networking services for virtualized cloud environments.
  • Develop and maintain the control plane, primarily using Go.
  • Contribute to the development and integration of dataplane components, primarily written in C and based on open-source networking technologies.
  • Improve the scalability, reliability, and operational stability of core cloud networking services.
  • Develop networking functionality such as IPv6 support, service endpoints, VPC peering, and Layer 7 load balancing.
  • Contribute to the development and improvement of network services including load balancers, firewalls, and security groups.
  • Improve internal architecture and optimize interactions between VPC services and related cloud platform components.
  • Investigate and resolve complex datapath and Linux kernel networking issues.
  • Analyze and address networking performance bottlenecks at both system and application levels.
  • Design and execute load and performance testing for cloud networking services.
  • Debug complex issues involving routing, connectivity, concurrency, and distributed infrastructure.
  • Develop reliable, high-performance, concurrent systems code suitable for large-scale production environments.
  • Contribute to the resilience of cloud networking infrastructure so services remain operational during partial system or infrastructure failures.
  • Collaborate with engineers working across control-plane, dataplane, networking, and platform infrastructure components.
  • Participate in technical design discussions and contribute to improvements in the architecture of core networking services.
  • Research and evaluate networking technologies and approaches that can improve platform capabilities and performance.
  • Participate in coding interviews as part of the recruitment process.

    • Requirements:

    • Significant experience in systems engineering, network engineering, infrastructure engineering, or a closely related technical discipline.
    • Strong ability to write reliable, efficient, and high-performance concurrent code.
    • Proficiency in Go (Golang).
    • Ability to read and understand C and/or C++, or a strong willingness and ability to develop these skills.
    • Practical understanding of how network traffic is routed through modern networking systems.
    • Strong knowledge of software engineering principles for production-grade systems and infrastructure.
    • Experience troubleshooting complex systems, networking, or performance-related issues.
    • Ability to work effectively with both high-level control-plane software and low-level systems or dataplane components.
    • Strong analytical and debugging skills, with the ability to investigate issues across multiple layers of a networking stack.
    • Understanding of virtual networking and modern cloud networking architectures is highly valuable.
    • Experience with OVS, VPP, DPDK, Linux kernel networking subsystems, or comparable networking dataplanes is a strong advantage.
    • Familiarity with network overlays, Software-Defined Networking (SDN), Network Functions Virtualization (NFV), or Deep Packet Inspection (DPI) is beneficial.
    • Knowledge of network protocols, routing, tunneling, and related networking technologies.
    • Familiarity with BGP and MPLS is an advantage.
    • Ability to understand complex technical architectures and contribute constructively to design decisions.
    • Strong problem-solving skills and a methodical approach to diagnosing infrastructure and networking issues.
    • Comfortable working collaboratively in a highly technical engineering environment.
    • Willingness to learn new technologies and work across different layers of the cloud networking stack.

      • Benefits:

      • Competitive compensation.
      • Career growth and continuous learning opportunities.
      • Flexibility and significant ownership in your work.
      • Collaborative and innovative engineering culture.
      • Opportunity to work on high-impact cloud and AI infrastructure projects.
      • Exposure to large-scale networking, distributed systems, and cloud infrastructure.
      • Opportunity to work across both high-level software engineering and low-level systems research.
      • International environment with experienced and technically skilled teams.
      • Inclusive workplace committed to equal employment opportunities.
      • Workplace accommodations available during the application process where required.
      • Employment is subject to authorization to work in the country where the position is based.

title: Maintenance Plant Engineering Intern
description:

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Familiarity with Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS) or similar software.
  • Knowledge of root cause analysis and reliability-centered maintenance principles.
  • Experience with CAD software or engineering design tools.
  • Understanding of OSHA regulations and industrial safety standards.

Responsibilities:

  • Support troubleshooting and repair activities to minimize downtime and maintain operational efficiency.
  • Collaborate with engineering and maintenance teams to implement process improvements and safety protocols.

Skills:

Communication and teamwork skills are essential for coordinating with engineers, technicians, and other plant personnel to ensure smooth operations. Familiarity with maintenance management software helps in accurately documenting work and tracking maintenance schedules. Preferred skills like experience with CMMS and safety standards enhance the intern’s ability to contribute to process improvements and maintain a safe working environment.

title: SAP MM Business Systems Analyst (m/f/d) (80-100%) (fixed term  -1 year)

Building on a heritage of over 100 years as a trusted industry partner, the company serves customers in more than 100 locations in over 50 countries. Accelleron’s 3,000 employees are continuously innovating to deliver best-in-class products, services, and solutions that are mission-critical for the energy transition. You will join a team of experts in an exciting international environment, committed to excellence and innovation. Together, we support our customers in driving the transition toward sustainable industries with cutting-edge technology, deep expertise, and smart solutions. At Accelleron, we foster diversity and inclusion, welcoming and celebrating individual differences as a source of strength.

We are looking for a highly motivated and experienced SAP MM Business Systems Analyst (m/f/d) to strengthen our Value Chain team for a 12-month fixed-term assignment with a strong focus on Growth Support. In this role, you act as a central interface between business functions, Power Users, and IT, ensuring stable and scalable SAP MM operations as our business, volumes, and organizational requirements evolve.

The position combines hands-on application support with business analysis and continuous improvement. You will take ownership of SAP MM tickets and incidents raised by Power Users across divisions, independently diagnose and resolve issues within your functional scope, coordinate change requests with Business and IT, and ensure solution quality through structured testing and validation.

A key part of the role is enabling business growth through reliable processes, high-quality data, and pragmatic system improvements. You will support new and changing business requirements, help harmonize Source-to-Pay (S2P) processes across divisions, strengthen data governance, and contribute operational expertise to selected S/4HANA and SAP Ariba activities where relevant.

You will be based at our global headquarters in Baden, Switzerland and report to the Head of Value Chain Planning & Fulfillment.

title: NDE Technician
description:
Job Title: Nondestructive Tester

Department: Quality

Reports To: Supervisor


Summary: Conducts radiographic, penetrant, ultrasonic, and magnetic particle tests on metal parts to determine if parts meet

nondestructive specifications by performing the following duties.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

Reviews test orders to determine type of test requested, test procedures to follow, and part acceptability criteria.

Applies agents such as cleaners, penetrants, and developers, and couplant (light oil which acts as medium) to parts, or heats parts in oven, to prepare parts for testing.

Determines test equipment settings according to type of metal, thickness, distance from test equipment, and related variables. Calibrates test equipment such as magnetic particles, x-ray, and ultrasonic contact machines, to standard settings.

Sets up equipment to perform tests, and conducts tests on parts, following procedures established for specified tests performed.

Examines surface treated materials during penetrant and magnetic particle tests to locate and identify cracks or other defects.

Moves transducer probe across part when conduction ultrasonic tests and observes CRT (cathode ray tube) screen to detect and locate discontinuities in metal structure.

Examines film when conducting radiographic tests to locate structural or welding flaws.

Marks tested parts to indicate defective areas.

Evaluates test results against designated standards.

Prepares reports outlining findings and conclusions.

Performs similar tests on nonmetallic parts or structures.+

Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Education and/or Experience

Bachelor’s degree (B. A.) from four-year college or university; or one to two years related experience and/or training; or

equivalent combination of education and experience.

Language Skills

Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals. Ability to write routine reports and correspondence. Ability to speak effectively before groups of customers or employees of an organization.

Mathematical Skills

Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals.

Ability to compute rate, ratio, and percent and to draw and interpret bar graphs.

Reasoning Ability

Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or diagram form. Ability to

deal with problems involving several concrete variables in standardized situations.

Computer Skills

To perform this job successfully, an individual should have knowledge of Manufacturing software, Spreadsheet software and

Word Processing software.

Physical demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand, walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms and talk or hear. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus.

Work Environment

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently exposed to moving mechanical parts. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

Responsibilities:

SANCORP is seeking a Personnel Security Analyst to support the United States Coast Guard (USCG) Office of Security Policy and Management (CG-SPM) security program activities. The following are examples of responsibilities:

  • Process personnel vetting (PV) documents for background investigations, adjudications, continuous vetting (CV) alerts, and suitability/fitness decisions.
  • Conduct specialized adjudicative reviews by weighing an individual's whole character and history to evaluate risk to Federal service and national security.

description:
Working Arrangements & Further Information

The MoJ offers Hybrid Working arrangements where business need allows. This is an informal, non-contractual form of flexible working that blends working from your base location, different MoJ sites and / or from home (please be aware that this role can only be worked in the UK and not overseas). Some roles will not be suitable for Hybrid Working. Similarly, Hybrid Working will not suit everyone’s circumstances. Arrangements will be discussed and agreed with the successful candidate(s) and subject to regular review.

For nationally advertised roles, the successful candidate(s) will be appointed to a MoJ office location, which may include their nearest Justice Collaboration Centre or Justice Satellite Office. This will be discussed and agreed on the completion of pre-employment checks.

Some of MoJ’s terms and conditions of service are changing as part of Civil Service reform. The changes will apply to staff joining MoJ who are new to the Civil Service. Staff joining MoJ from other civil service employers will transfer onto the new MoJ terms if they are already on 'modernised' terms in their current post or onto 'unmodernised' MoJ terms if they are on 'unmodernised' terms at their current post. Details will be available if an offer is made.

Standard full time working hours are 37 hours per week excluding breaks which are unpaid. HMPPS welcomes part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns, where they meet the demands of the role and business needs. All applications for part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns will be considered in accordance with the HMPPS’ Flexible Working policy.

If you are a current NPS employee, this vacancy may be available on a Loan basis for up to 2 years. Applications are invited from suitable qualified staff.

The Loan/Secondment is subject to the approval of the selected candidate's Business Unit, which should be obtained before confirmation of appointment.

Benefits

Annual Leave

-The holiday year runs from 1 March. If you work a non standard work pattern your leave entitlement may be expressed in either hours or days as appropriate. Leave entitlement is calculated on a pro-rata basis and you will be advised of your actual entitlement on appointment. If you were appointed internally and your leave was previously calculated in days, this will continue to be the case.

Bank, Public and Privilege Holidays

-You are entitled to 9 days (66 hours 36 minutes) in recognition of bank, public and privilege holidays. These hours are added to your annual leave allowance. There is a requirement to work some public and bank holidays subject to your shift pattern and the operational needs of the establishment

Pension

-The Civil Service offers a choice of two pension schemes, giving you the flexibility to choose the pension that suits you best.

Work Life Balance

HM Prison & Probation Service (HMPPS) is keen to encourage alternative working arrangements. Work life balance provides greater opportunities for staff to work more flexibly wherever managers and establishments can accommodate requests to do so. HMPPS offers flexible working subject to completion of a satisfactory probationary period and NVQ

Season Ticket Advance

-After two months’ service, you’ll be eligible to apply for a season ticket advance to purchase a quarterly or longer-period season ticket for travel between home and your place of work

Childcare Vouchers

For any moves across the Civil Service may have implications on your ability to carry on claiming childcare vouchers

-There are opportunities to access promotion programmes and HMPPS provides a variety of training appropriate to individual posts

-All staff receive security and diversity training and an individual induction programme into their new roles

Eligibility

-All candidates are subject to security and identity checks prior to taking up post

-All external candidates are subject to 6 months probation. Internal candidates are subject to probation if they have not already served a probationary period within HMPPS

-All staff are required to declare whether they are a member of a group or organisation which the HMPPS considers to be racist

Working for the Civil Service

The Civil Service Code sets out the standards of behaviour expected of civil servants.

We recruit by merit on the basis of fair and open competition, as outlined in the Civil Service Commission's recruitment principles. Should you feel that the recruitment process has breached the recruitment principles you are able to raise a formal complaint in the following order

  • To Transformative Business Services (0345 241 5358 (Monday to Friday 8am - 6pm) or e mail moj-recruitment-vetting-enquiries@resourcing.soprasteria.co.uk);
  • To Ministry of Justice Resourcing team (resourcing-management-office@justice.gov.uk);
  • To the Civil Service Commission (details available here)

As a Disability Confident employer, MoJ are committed to providing everyone with the opportunity to demonstrate their skills, talent and abilities, by making adjustments throughout all elements of the recruitment process and in the workplace. MoJ are able to offer an interview to disabled candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns.

Diversity & Inclusion

A Great Place to Work for Veterans

The "Making the Civil Service a Great Place to work for veterans" initiative includes a guaranteed interview scheme to those who meet the minimum criteria to provide eligible former members of the Armed Forces with opportunities to secure rewarding jobs. Allowing veterans to continue to serve their country, and to bring highly skilled individuals with a broad range of experience into the Civil Service in an environment, which recognises and values your previous service in the Armed Forces.
For further details about the initiative and eligibility requirements visit:

Redeployment Interview Scheme

Civil Service departments are expected to explore redeployment opportunities before making an individual redundant. The MoJ is committed, as part of the Redeployment Interview Scheme, to providing opportunities to those who are 'at risk of redundancy'.

MoJ is able to offer an interview to eligible candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns. Candidates will not be eligible for the Redeployment Interview Scheme if they are applying on promotion.

Civil Service Nationality Rules

This job is broadly open to the following groups:

  • UK nationals
  • nationals of the Republic of Ireland
  • nationals of Commonwealth countries who have the right to work in the UK
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities with settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS) (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/settled-status-eu-citizens-families

  • individuals with limited leave to remain or indefinite leave to remain who were eligible to apply for EUSS on or before 31 December 2020
  • Turkish nationals, and certain family members of Turkish nationals, who have accrued the right to work in the Civil Service

Further information on nationality requirements (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/nationality-rules

A reserve list may be held for up to 12 months from which further appointments may be made for the same or similar roles.

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer — Token Factory (Inference Platform)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer — Token Factory (Inference Platform) based in Switzerland.

This is a senior engineering role focused on the reliability, performance, and observability of a large-scale AI inference platform.
You will help operate infrastructure serving foundation models across text, vision, audio, and emerging multimodal workloads.
The role combines Kubernetes, infrastructure-as-code, observability, automation, and production incident management at significant scale.
You will optimize GPU-heavy workloads, strengthen resilience, and ensure high-throughput APIs meet demanding reliability and cost targets.
You will work closely with software engineers and infrastructure teams to build self-healing systems and robust operational processes.
The environment is fast-moving, highly technical, international, and focused on solving complex infrastructure challenges for the AI ecosystem.
This is an opportunity to have a direct impact on the infrastructure powering next-generation AI applications.

Accountabilities

  • Own the reliability, performance, and observability of the inference platform and its supporting infrastructure.
  • Design, implement, and continuously improve telemetry pipelines covering metrics, logs, and traces.
  • Build monitoring and observability solutions capable of processing large volumes of production signals and converting them into actionable insights.
  • Configure and optimize Kubernetes infrastructure for high availability, scalability, and efficient resource utilization.
  • Tune Kubernetes autoscaling mechanisms to improve the efficiency and utilization of GPU resources.
  • Develop and maintain Terraform modules and infrastructure-as-code patterns that embed resilience and reliability into new clusters and services.
  • Design and improve request-routing, retry, and failure-handling mechanisms to minimize the impact of transient infrastructure or service failures.
  • Develop automation and operational tooling to detect, isolate, and remediate incidents quickly.
  • Create, maintain, and improve runbooks for incident response and operational procedures.
  • Participate in production incident management, troubleshooting issues and restoring services within demanding reliability objectives.
  • Lead or contribute to post-mortem processes and implement corrective actions to prevent recurring incidents.
  • Define and improve reliability practices for high-throughput APIs, including alerting strategies and Service Level Objectives (SLOs).
  • Investigate distributed-system failures and performance issues across infrastructure and application layers.
  • Optimize systems from the kernel and infrastructure layer through to the application layer.
  • Support and improve the operation of GPU-intensive inference workloads and accelerator-based infrastructure.
  • Contribute to scaling the inference platform while balancing performance, reliability, and infrastructure costs.
  • Collaborate closely with software engineers to incorporate reliability and operational excellence into product and platform development.
  • Promote automation, self-healing capabilities, and engineering practices that reduce operational overhead and improve system resilience.

    • Requirements:

    • Significant experience in Site Reliability Engineering, Production Engineering, DevOps, or a closely related infrastructure discipline.
    • Deep practical knowledge of Kubernetes in production environments.
    • Strong experience with Prometheus and Grafana for monitoring, metrics, dashboards, and observability.
    • Advanced experience with Terraform and infrastructure-as-code practices.
    • Strong scripting and automation skills using Python and/or Bash.
    • Solid understanding of distributed systems and the ways production backends can fail under real-world conditions.
    • Experience designing effective alerts, monitoring strategies, and SLOs for high-throughput services or APIs.
    • Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills across infrastructure, networking, operating systems, and application layers.
    • Experience designing systems for high availability, resilience, scalability, and graceful failure recovery.
    • Hands-on experience with GPU-heavy workloads or accelerator-based infrastructure is highly valuable.
    • Familiarity with GPU inference technologies such as vLLM, Triton, Ray, or comparable accelerator and model-serving stacks.
    • Experience with MLOps, model hosting, AI infrastructure, or machine-learning platforms is advantageous.
    • Strong understanding of infrastructure automation, deployment, configuration management, and operational tooling.
    • Ability to analyze complex performance and reliability problems and translate findings into practical engineering improvements.
    • Strong incident-management and root-cause-analysis capabilities.
    • Ability to collaborate effectively with software engineers and other technical teams to integrate reliability into platform development.
    • Proactive mindset with a strong focus on automation, self-healing systems, and continuous improvement.
    • Comfortable working independently, taking ownership of critical infrastructure, and operating effectively in a fast-paced technical environment.

      • Benefits:

      • Competitive compensation.
      • Career growth and continuous learning opportunities.
      • Flexibility and significant ownership in your work.
      • Collaborative and innovative international working environment.
      • Opportunity to work on high-impact AI infrastructure and inference technologies.
      • Exposure to large-scale GPU infrastructure and complex distributed systems.
      • Opportunity to contribute to infrastructure supporting next-generation multimodal AI applications.
      • Diverse and highly technical international teams.
      • Inclusive workplace committed to equal employment opportunities.
      • Workplace accommodations available throughout the application process where required.
      • Employment is subject to authorization to work in the country where the position is based.
