title: Senior Intelligence Team Lead
description:
Job Description Summary

Organization's Summary Statement:
The Applied Research Laboratory for Intelligence & Security (ARLIS) at the University of Maryland is a University-Affiliated Research Center (UARC) dedicated to advancing research, innovation, and technology transition to improve decision making for U.S. national security. ARLIS combines deep scientific expertise with operational insight to address challenges in intelligence analysis, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence / machine learning, quantum science, and human-machine teaming. Researchers, scientists, engineers, and analysts at ARLIS collaborate with government agencies, industry partners, and academic institutions to deliver actionable insights and transformative solutions through research and development. Employees at ARLIS work on projects of critical importance, contribute directly to the nation’s security, and are supported by a culture that values integrity, collaboration, and professional growth.
UMD-ARLIS is seeking qualified candidates for the Analytic Team Lead role, with expertise in leading all-source analytic teams and research programs. Candidates must have prior experience serving as an intelligence analyst for a U.S. Government all-source agency. Preferred candidates will have experience working as a Branch Chief, Senior Intelligence Analyst (SIA), or in the Senior Analytic Service (SAS) for an all-source U.S. Government Agency.

Ideal candidates will have a background in assessing critical and emerging technologies and their implications for national and economic security. Candidates should also be able to demonstrate the ability to conduct interdisciplinary research at the intersection of people, policy, and technology.

Successful candidates will contribute to a portfolio of government-sponsored projects addressing emerging challenges in areas such as technology assessment, technology transition and adoption, risk and resilience, governance and policy, and human and organizational factors shaping technology use. Work may include research development, rapid analytic sprints, stakeholder engagement, and the production of actionable insights that inform decision-making across technology strategy, acquisition, and operational planning.

Positions may include a focus on applied research, systems-level analysis, policy-relevant technical assessment, and/or field-informed studies of how technologies are used in real-world contexts. Final appointment title and responsibilities will be based on qualifications and matched to programmatic needs.

Roles and Responsibilities:
Roles and Responsibilities will vary by project and candidate expertise and may include:
• Managing teams conducting interdisciplinary research on critical and emerging technologies at the intersection of people, policy, and technology, with an emphasis on national and economic security relevance
• Guiding assessments of technology capabilities, limitations, and trajectories across a family of technologies, including second- and third-order impacts on missions, markets, and society
• Analyzing socio-technical adoption and use, including how individuals, organizations, and institutions interact with technologies and how policy and governance shape their evolution
• Running an analytic program that evaluates technology ecosystems, supply chains, and economics (e.g., production scaling, chokepoints, dependencies, investments, and market structure) that influence technology development and strategic risk
• Contributing to research proposals and technical work plans, including scoping key intelligence questions, defining methods, and supporting sponsor engagement as needed
• Collaborating with interdisciplinary teams including engineers, data scientists, domain experts, behavioral and social scientists, and policy analysts to integrate methods and findings
• Editing and Preparing finished intelligence products and briefings for government stakeholders, translating complex analyses into clear, decision-relevant products (e.g., reports, slide briefings, memos, and research summaries)
• Developing and mentoring junior researchers or researchers with minimal previous experience applying IC analytic tradecraft to become self-sufficient, full-performance all-source analysts

Must be able to obtain a U.S. security clearance. If selected, you must meet the requirements for access to classified information and will be subject to a government security clearance investigation that includes criminal and credit history checks, as well as verification of U.S. citizenship, birth, education, employment, and military history.

Minimum Qualifications:
ARLIS is hiring at the Principal Faculty level for the Research Specialist track.
In addition to a proven record of excellence in managing and directing an academic or research program, the appointee shall hold a Ph.D. or have at least 5 years of full-time experience as a Senior Faculty Specialist, or its equivalent.

• Experience conceptualizing and editing finished intelligence products for senior U.S. Government policymakers or DoW officials.
• Superior ability to deliver excellence in the execution, administration, and/or management of research or analytic programs
• Proven knowledge of IC writing tradecraft and experience teaching others about this discipline
• Lead engagements with U.S. government sponsors, customers, and stakeholders
• Ability to work as part of a multi-disciplinary opportunity capture team in a matrixed organization with a collaborative and team-centric culture
• Strong oral and written communication skills

Ability to:
• Initiate new projects with long-term research goals and lead work on multiple, concurrent projects while managing cross-functional teams
• Serve as Principal Investigator or having primary responsibility for a significant part of a project
• Interact and lead engagement with U.S. government sponsors, customers, and stakeholders
• Identify funding opportunities and serve as Principal Investigator on large proposals
• Mentor junior staff and Professional Track Faculty Specialists and participating in their promotion sub-committees

Physical Demands:
Sedentary work performed in a normal office environment; exerts up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects, including the human body. Ability to attend meetings both on and off campus. Spending long hours in front of a computer screen.

Preferences:
•Active TS/SCI security clearance
• Ph.D. or Master’s degree in a relevant field such international affairs, economics, political science, basic science, engineering, public policy, or related discipline and 8+ years of experience as an all-source analyst for a U.S. Government Agency or similar; or Bachelor's degree and 10+ years of relevant experience.
• Experience working as a Branch Chief, Senior Intelligence Analyst (SIA), or in the Senior Analytic Service (SAS) for an all-source U.S. Government Agency. Prior experience as a GS/GG-14 or equivalent all-source analyst will also be considered.

Licenses/ Certifications: N/A

Minimum Qualifications

In addition to a proven record of excellence in managing and directing an academic or research program, the appointee shall hold a Ph.D. or have at least 5 years of full-time experience as a Senior Faculty Specialist, or its equivalent. Appointments are typically made as five-year contracts.

Additional Job Details

Required Application Materials: Cover Letter, Resume, List of References

Best Consideration Date: N/A

Posting Close Date: 11/30/26

title: Director Talent Management
description:
The Director, Talent Management partners with the CHRO and HR leadership to develop Brookhaven National Laboratory's Human Capital Strategy and lead the execution of lab wide talent and organizational effectiveness priorities.

Reporting directly to the Chief Human Resources Officer, the Director provides strategic leadership for enterprise workforce planning, talent acquisition, leadership and organizational development, training, performance management, succession planning, learning, workforce analytics, and related human capital initiatives that enable the Laboratory to attract, develop, engage, and retain a world-class workforce.

The Director partners with senior leadership and the HR Directorate to drive cross-functional collaboration, operational excellence, organizational effectiveness, and workforce transformation. The position provides strategic leadership for enterprise-wide initiatives that strengthen Brookhaven National Laboratory's ability to attract, develop, engage, and retain a world-class workforce to meet the Laboratory's growing scientific mission.

Responsibilities

Human Capital Strategy

  • Partner with CHRO, HR leadership, and Laboratory leadership to develop and execute the Laboratory's enterprise Human Capital Strategy aligned with Brookhaven's mission, strategic objectives, and future workforce requirements.
  • Lead enterprise initiatives that strengthen organizational effectiveness, workforce capability, leadership readiness, and employee experience.
  • Identify emerging workforce trends, labor market risks, and organizational capability needs to ensure long-term workforce readiness.
  • Translate Human Capital Strategy into measurable talent priorities, programs, and outcomes, ensuring effective execution across the Laboratory.

Talent and Organizational Effectiveness

  • Serves as a trusted advisor to senior leaders on workforce strategy, leadership effectiveness, organizational design, succession planning, and change management.
  • Leads organizational development initiatives that improve effectiveness, strengthen leadership capability, and support organizational change and workplace culture.
  • Champions continuous improvement across Human Resources processes, services, and technology.
  • Foster collaborative partnerships with DOE, peer national laboratories, universities, professional organizations, and external stakeholders to advance Brookhaven's workforce objectives.

Operational Excellence & Analytics

  • Establish enterprise metrics and dashboards that measure workforce capability, leadership pipeline strength, employee engagement, organizational health, recruitment effectiveness, and operational performance.
  • Develops action plans to enhance workplace culture and operational excellence
  • Partners with HR Business Partners and Laboratory leadership to improve organizational effectiveness, workforce agility, leadership capability, and employee experience.
  • Leverages workforce analytics and predictive data to inform strategic decision-making.
  • Demonstrated commitment to working safely, acting ethically, and taking personal accountability for operational excellence.

Leads the Talent Management Team

  • Builds, develops and leads a multi-functional team comprised of HR and Training professionals

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Development, Psychology, or a related field.
  • Minimum twelve (12) years of progressively responsible Human Resources leadership experience.
  • Demonstrated experience developing enterprise talent strategies encompassing areas such as workforce planning, talent acquisition, leadership development, succession planning, organizational effectiveness and performance management.
  • Demonstrated experience leading and developing professional HR teams and managing multiple talent-related functions
  • Demonstrated experience advising executive leadership on organizational strategy, workforce planning, and change management.
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex, organization-wide strategic initiatives and translating them into results.
  • Demonstrated ability to use workforce data and analytics to inform strategy and decision-making

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree preferred
  • SPHR, SHRM-SCP, or equivalent executive HR certification.
  • Experience in a DOE laboratory, research institution, federal agency, or other complex mission-driven organization.
  • Experience leading organizational redesign or enterprise transformation.

Brookhaven National Laboratory is committed to providing fair, equitable and competitive compensation. The full salary range for this position is $184400- $306100 / year. Salary offers will be commensurate with the final candidate’s qualification, education and experience and considered with the internal peer group.


Brookhaven National Laboratory is committed to employee success and we believe that a comprehensive employee benefits program is an important and meaningful part of the compensation employees receive. Review more information at BNL | Benefits Program


Brookhaven National Laboratory requires all non-badged personnel including visitors to produce a REAL-ID or REAL-ID compliant documentation to access Brookhaven National Laboratory – view more information at . This is due to nationwide identification requirements for federal site access as required by the federal REAL ID Act. Those not in possession of a REAL ID-compliant document will not be permitted to access the site which includes access to the Laboratory for interviews.


As a U.S. Department of Energy laboratory, Brookhaven National Laboratory requires employees to obtain and maintain a DOE Uncleared Personal Identity Verification (UPIV) credential in accordance with Homeland Security Presidential Directive 12 (HSPD-12) requirements. The credentialing process is completed as part of onboarding and enables access to DOE facilities and information systems. As a condition of employment, the selected candidate must be able to obtain and maintain a UPIV credential. These requirements are established under DOE Order 206.2 Chg. 2, Identity, Credential, and Access Management (ICAM- Identity, Credential, and Access Management (ICAM)), and DOE Order 473.1A- Physical Protection Program- Physical Protection Program.


About Us

Brookhaven National Laboratory (www.bnl.gov) delivers discovery science and transformative technology to power and secure the nation’s future. Brookhaven Lab is a multidisciplinary laboratory with seven Nobel Prize-winning discoveries, 37 R&D 100 Awards, and more than 70 years of pioneering research. The Lab is primarily supported by the U.S. Department of Energy’s (DOE) Office of Science. Brookhaven Science Associates (BSA) operates and manages the Laboratory for DOE. BSA is a partnership between Battelle and The Research Foundation for the State University of New York on behalf of Stony Brook University. BSA salutes our veterans and active military members with careers that leverage the skills and unique experience they gained while serving our country, learn more at BNL | Opportunities for Veterans at Brookhaven National Laboratory.

title: Full Time Experienced Optician
description:
Job Overview

An experienced optician is a licensed, highly experienced eyewear professional responsible for delivering exceptional patient care and ensuring the highest standards in optical services. This role combines advanced technical expertise with strong patient-facing skills, supporting both clinical operations and the overall patient experience.


The ideal candidate brings deep knowledge of optical dispensing, prescription interpretation, precision measurements, and premium eyewear products. They serve as a key resource for patients, junior staff, and clinical teams, contributing to smooth practice operations and coordinated care.

Key Responsibilities

Patient Care & Optical Expertise

  • Guide patients through eyewear selection based on prescription requirements, facial features, lifestyle, and personal style.
  • Interpret ophthalmic prescriptions and recommend appropriate lens designs, thicknesses, coatings, and specialty products.
  • Perform precise optical measurements including pupillary distance, segment height, bridge width, and other fitting parameters.
  • Ensure accurate frame fittings and adjustments to deliver optimal comfort, vision, and alignment.
  • Educate patients on lens technologies, frame materials, coatings, and premium optical products.

Technical Skills & Repairs

  • Adjust, repair, and troubleshoot eyeglasses using advanced optical tools and techniques.
  • Perform minor repairs such as tightening screws, replacing nose pads, and realigning frames.
  • Ensure accurate fabrication, verification, and quality control of all eyewear orders.
  • Maintain high standards for optical product quality and service accuracy.

Order Management & Dispensing

  • Submit, track, and manage eyewear orders with optical labs.
  • Conduct thorough quality checks before dispensing glasses or contact lenses.
  • Maintain accurate patient records, documentation, and order histories.

Patient Education

  • Provide clear instructions on proper care, cleaning, storage, and handling of eyeglasses and contact lenses.
  • Support patients in understanding product benefits, warranties, and long‑term care recommendations.

Inventory & Display Management

  • Organize, restock, and maintain frame inventory and product displays.
  • Oversee stock rotation, ordering, and product selection to ensure variety and availability.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and visually appealing optical environment.

Insurance & Billing Support

  • Verify vision and medical insurance benefits.
  • Provide cost estimates and assist patients with eyewear billing.
  • Ensure accurate documentation for claims processing and reimbursement.

Clinical & Administrative Collaboration

  • Work closely with clinical teams to support coordinated, patient‑centered care.
  • Communicate effectively with technicians, providers, vendors, labs, and administrative staff.
  • Assist with insurance verification and billing workflows to ensure accurate claims submission.

Leadership & Operations

  • Mentor, train, and support junior opticians and optical staff.
  • Contribute to workflow optimization and uphold practice policies, compliance standards, and operational efficiency.
  • Support daily optical operations to ensure a smooth, high‑quality patient experience.

Professional Development

  • Stay current on eyewear trends, lens technologies, and new product offerings.
  • Maintain and expand technical knowledge to support evolving patient needs and industry standards.



Qualifications & Skills

Experience

  • 3–5 years of optical dispensing and sales experience.
  • Experience working in an ophthalmology practice strongly preferred.

Technical & Administrative Skills

  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy in patient data entry and order coordination.
  • Proficiency with EHR systems, practice management software, and optical ordering tools.
  • Knowledge of HIPAA regulations and industry standards for patient privacy and compliance.

Operational & Interpersonal Skills

  • Excellent organizational and time management abilities.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, especially in adjusting schedules or resolving patient concerns.
  • Clear, compassionate, and professional communication with patients and staff.

Insurance Knowledge

  • Understanding of vision and medical insurance plans, including eligibility, authorizations, and material requirements.
  • Ability to explain benefits and ensure proper documentation for billing and claims

Benefits

  • Health insurance
  • Dental Insurance
  • Life Insurance
  • Accidental Death & Dismemberment Insurance
  • 401(K)
  • PTO and holidays off
  • Career growth and development

title: Dynatrace Architect
description:
Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.


The Role

Your role
As an AI Data Engineer at Kyndryl, you’ll be the architect behind the high-performance data infrastructure that powers our autonomous systems. We aren't just moving tables; we’re building the real-time pipelines that allow agentic AI to reason over the world’s most complex enterprise environments.

Join Kyndryl and gain the trust, autonomy and teamwork to help define what comes next.

What you will do
Orchestrate Intelligence
•Architect for RAG: You’ll design and scale the pipelines for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), transforming massive volumes of unstructured IT logs and documentation into optimized Vector Embeddings.
•Scale vector infrastructure: You will be responsible for the health and performance of our vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Milvus, or Weaviate), ensuring sub-second retrieval speeds for agentic reasoning loops.

Master Data Transformation
•Engineer semantic layers: Move beyond simple ETL to build knowledge graphs and semantic layers that provide agents with the necessary context to navigate complex infrastructure puzzles.
•Automate data excellence: Using a keen eye for detail, you’ll build automated data guardrails to detect noise, bias, or PII (Personally Identifiable Information) before it reaches the model, ensuring our AI remains safe and impactful.

Own the Backbone
•Solve meaningful challenges: Serve as the bridge between raw, messy data sources and deep technical AI work, identifying and resolving quality issues at the source.
•Progress to production: With a well-defined methodology and software engineering prowess, you will build, deploy, and maintain the CI/CD pipelines for our data infrastructure, ensuring that our context window remains fresh and reliable.

Your Future at Kyndryl
Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.


Who You Are

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

Required skills and experience

•Expertise in data mining, data storage and Extract-Transform-Load (ETL) processes
•Experience in data pipelines development and tooling, e.g., Glue, Databricks, Synapse, or Dataproc
•Experience with both relational and NoSQL databases, PostgreSQL, DB2, MongoDB
•Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and critical thinking skills
•Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, while maintaining a high level of attention to detail
•Ability to communicate with both technical and non-technical colleagues, to derive and translate technical requirements from business needs

Preferred skills and experience

•Experience working as a Data Engineer and/or in cloud modernization
•Experience in Data Modelling, to create conceptual model of how data is connected and how it will be used in business processes
•Professional certification, e.g. Open Certified Technical Specialist with Data Engineering Specialization
•Cloud platform certification, e.g. AWS Certified Data Analytics – Specialty, Elastic Certified Engineer, Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer, or Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate
•Understanding of social coding and Integrated Development Environments, e.g. GitHub and Visual Studio
•Degree in a scientific discipline, such as Computer Science, Software Engineering, or Information Technology


Being You

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.


What You Can Expect

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

Get Referred!

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

About the Role:

We are seeking an experienced Salesforce Data Migration Engineer to support the migration, transformation, validation, and integration of data into Salesforce. The ideal candidate will have strong experience with Salesforce data migration, ETL processes, data quality, and large-scale data environments.

Location: Remote.

  • The selected candidate must be currently located in, or willing to relocate to, one of the states supported by Tripoint Solutions corporate offices: AL, CO, DC, DE, FL, GA, IL, IN, KS, LA, MD, MN, MS, NC, NJ, OH, PA, SC, TN, TX, or VA. No relocation assistance provided.

Clearance Requirements:

  • Applicants selected may be subject to a government security investigation.
  • U.S. Citizenship is required.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and execute data migration strategies into Salesforce.
  • Extract, transform, cleanse, map, and load data from legacy and external systems.
  • Develop and maintain ETL processes and data migration workflows.
  • Create data mapping specifications and transformation rules.
  • Perform data validation, reconciliation, and quality checks.
  • Support migration testing, troubleshooting, and deployment activities.
  • Develop and optimize integrations using Salesforce APIs and related technologies.
  • Work with Salesforce Architects, Developers, and business stakeholders to resolve data issues.
  • Support migration of large datasets while maintaining data integrity and system performance.
  • Document migration processes, data mappings, procedures, and results.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 3+ years of experience with Salesforce data migration or data engineering.
  • Strong experience with Salesforce data models, APIs, Data Loader, and SOQL.
  • Experience with ETL tools and data transformation processes.
  • Experience with data cleansing, validation, reconciliation, and quality management.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with relational databases.
  • Experience with large datasets and complex data migrations.

title: EOR Specialist
description:
Entity:

Technology


Job Family Group:

Subsurface Group


Job Description:

About the role:

The role of ‘EOR Specialist’ is an experienced individual contributor responsible for developing, evaluating and supporting deployment of EOR technologies to optimize hydrocarbon recovery, increase reserves and bring value across bp's upstream portfolio.

Working within Upstream R&D, the role is expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy on defined projects, applying practical EOR experience and sound technical judgement to progress technologies from concept through laboratory evaluation, pilot design, field trial planning and potential deployment.

The successful candidate will work closely with a multidisciplinary team of scientists, reservoir engineers, production engineers, operating asset teams and external partners. They will be expected to build trusted relationships, handle partners effectively, translate asset challenges into fit-for-purpose technology options and supply actively to the generation of new ideas and opportunities in reservoir recovery.

Please note that roles based out of SJS or Sunbury will move to Timber Square, Southwark, from Q4 2027.

EOR Technology Development and Studies

  • Develop, screen and mature EOR concepts, workflows and technologies aligned with asset recovery challenges and business priorities.
  • Lead or chip in to studies across chemical, gas, water-based and conformance improvement processes.
  • Design, supervise and interpret laboratory, modelling and data evaluation programmes to quantify performance, uncertainty, risks and value drivers.
  • Integrate technical evidence into practical, benchmarked recommendations that support scale-up, field trial planning and deployment readiness.
  • Track emerging technologies, industry trials, academic developments and intellectual property opportunities.
  • Build internal capability through mentoring, technical networks, lessons learned, guidance notes and training materials.
  • Representing bp in a professional capacity at conferences, with industrial partners, in professional societies, in relevant external bodies.

Asset Support and Project Delivery

  • Work with operating regions to define recovery challenges and translate them into practical EOR options.
  • Support screening, feasibility, pilot design and deployment support across bp assets.
  • Build trusted relationships with asset teams, R&D colleagues, external partners, service providers and academic collaborators in progressing projects.
  • Manage assigned project scopes, interfaces, timelines, risks and deliverables.
  • Frame and communicate recommendations around reservoir performance, operational practicality, HSSE, cost, value and execution risk.
  • Track emerging technologies, industry trials, academic developments and intellectual property opportunities.

HSSE and Ways of Working

  • Demonstrate strong commitment to safety, compliance and bp values in all activities.
  • Ensure laboratory, pilot and field trial work follows bp safety requirements, applicable standards and management of change expectations.

Technical

  • Degree in Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, Reservoir Engineering, Earth Sciences or related field; advanced degree or equivalent experience advantageous.
  • Experience in EOR, reservoir recovery technology, reservoir engineering, chemical / gas EOR, waterflood optimisation or related subsurface technologies.
  • Strong understanding of porous-media flow, recovery mechanisms and practical EOR performance / deployment drivers.
  • Able to design, interpret or assure experiments, core floods, compatibility tests and formulation studies for technology evaluations.
  • Analyses complex data, integrates multidisciplinary inputs and gives clear, practical recommendations with sound judgement.

Project, Delivery and Partner Skills

  • Handles technical scopes, interfaces, timelines and work independently.
  • Establishes relationships and influences across asset, technology and functional teams.
  • Works effectively in multidisciplinary teams and translates asset needs into technology plans.
  • Communicates clearly through technical reports, management summaries and presentation materials.
  • Frames recommendations around value, risk, uncertainty and deployment practicality.

Behaviours

  • Self-starting, delivery-focused and comfortable with technical ambiguity.
  • Curious and innovative, able to generate, shape and test new ideas.
  • Collaborative and inclusive, building trust across subject areas, cultures and geographies.
  • Open to challenge and committed to evidence-based decisions, technical excellence and continuous improvement.
  • Demonstrates bp values and behaviours.

Desirable experience

  • Experience with uncertainty management, field trial planning, surveillance design or deployment readiness is beneficial.
  • Experience handling external research, service company or university collaborations.
  • Awareness of technology readiness, stage-gate delivery, agile principles, intellectual property and commercialization.

The Subsurface & Wells team is a central technology group within bp's Upstream Research & Development (URD) organisation, bringing together a multidisciplinary team including reservoir engineers, chemical engineers, geoscientists, production specialists and applied scientists to develop, test and deploy technologies that maximise hydrocarbon recovery and improve asset performance. The team works closely with bp's global operating assets, production and reservoir management teams, wells and facilities engineers, digital specialists, and external partners including universities, research institutes and technology suppliers.

A key strength of the team is its combination of world-class subsurface expertise and a culture that encourages innovation, scientific rigour and cross-disciplinary collaboration. Team members have influence from early-stage research through to field deployment, helping deliver real business value and supporting bp's ambition to safely maximise recovery from existing resources.

Why join us?

At bp, we support our people to grow in a diverse and exciting environment. We believe that our team is strengthened by diversity.

There are many aspects of our employees’ lives that are meaningful, so we offer benefits to enable your work to fit with your life. These benefits can include flexible working options, a generous paid parental leave policy, excellent retirement benefits, among others!

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

Reinvent your career as you help our business meet the challenges of the future. Apply now!

Up to 10% travel should be expected with this role

This role is not eligible for relocation

This position is a hybrid of office/remote working


Skills:

Data acquisition strategy, Data Analysis, Data Management, Depletion and Storage Development Planning, Fluid Properties, Fluid sampling and analysis, Geological Reservoir and Storage Unit Modelling, Integrated Resource Progression, Measuring and Verification for Carbon Storage, Monitoring, Operations Geology, Petrophysical Dynamic Reservoir Description, Petrophysical Static Reservoir Description, Reservoir Forecasting and Business Planning, Reservoir quality, Rock Properties Framework, Subsurface integration, Subsurface uncertainty and risk management, Subsurface verification and assurance, Well and Area Performance Management

title: EVP, Finance & Operations
description:
Macmillan Learning is seeking an Executive Vice President, Finance & Corporate Operations to join our Executive Leadership Team and help shape the company’s next chapter.

Reporting directly to the CEO, this leader will oversee Finance and several enterprise operations while serving as a strategic advisor across the business. The scope includes financial planning and performance, pricing and commercial strategy, manufacturing and international operations, strategic partnerships, vendor and contract management, enterprise project governance, and risk coordination.

A central priority will be creating greater transparency into business performance. This leader will bring together financial, operational, and commercial information, turn it into clear insights, and help the company make informed decisions about priorities, investments, resources, and risk.

Macmillan Learning is a business in transformation. We are looking for someone who can build on the processes, systems, and data already in place while identifying where new structures and capabilities are needed. This includes advancing the thoughtful use of AI and automation to improve insight, simplify work, and create capacity for higher-value activities.

This position is based in Austin, Texas.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Strategy and Performance

  • Lead enterprise financial planning and analysis, including budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, long-range planning, and key performance indicator reporting.
  • Oversee the monthly close process, financial reporting, management reporting, and shareholder reporting.
  • Establish clear and rigorous approaches to evaluating company performance, resource allocation, business priorities, and investment returns.
  • Provide financial oversight for significant investments across product, technology, editorial, marketing, and other strategic areas.
  • Partner with business unit and functional leaders to improve financial performance, strengthen accountability, and support informed decision-making.
  • Oversee royalty and rights administration and coordinate effectively with shared-service functions, including Accounting, Accounts Payable, Treasury, and Tax.
  • Identify opportunities to apply artificial intelligence and other technologies to enhance financial insight, efficiency, accuracy, and organizational capacity.

Executive and Strategic Advisory

  • Serve as a trusted strategic advisor to the CEO and Executive Leadership Team on company performance, long-term planning, investments, commercial opportunities, and other significant business matters.
  • Translate complex financial, commercial, and operational information into clear alternatives, recommendations, and decisions.
  • Provide effective support to the Board, shareholders, Holtzbrinck representatives, and other senior stakeholders.
  • Lead or support financial analysis, due diligence, valuation, and decision-making related to mergers, acquisitions, strategic investments, and other growth opportunities.
  • Bring an enterprise-wide perspective and an independent, well-informed point of view to executive discussions.

Corporate Operations

  • Provide strategic leadership and executive oversight for manufacturing, operations, international operations, and distribution.
  • Ensure that operational priorities, investments, capabilities, and service levels are aligned with the company’s strategy and evolving business requirements.
  • Strengthen operational performance through appropriate governance, performance measures, risk management, and continuous improvement.
  • Promote effective coordination across Finance, Operations, business units, and corporate functions.

Pricing and Commercial Strategy

  • Lead the company’s central pricing function and establish a disciplined, enterprise-wide approach to pricing strategy and governance.
  • Apply financial and commercial insight to decisions involving customer value, revenue growth, profitability, market position, and long-term opportunity.
  • Evaluate the financial and commercial implications of significant product, technology, editorial, and marketing investments.
  • Support business leaders in developing sound business cases and making evidence-based investment decisions.

Business Development and Strategic Partnerships

  • Lead selected business development initiatives that support the company’s strategic and financial objectives.
  • Develop and maintain productive relationships with strategic channel partners and other external business partners.
  • Evaluate partnership opportunities based on strategic alignment, financial value, operational requirements, and risk.
  • Represent the company effectively in significant external negotiations and business discussions.

Vendor and Contract Management

  • Lead significant enterprise negotiations and oversee strategic vendor relationships across technology, facilities, professional services, and other material areas of expenditure.
  • Establish an enterprise approach to vendor selection, contracting, performance management, and risk mitigation.
  • Balance cost, service, quality, flexibility, business continuity, and long-term value in vendor and contracting decisions.
  • Provide executive oversight for institutional bids, major customer contracts, and related governance processes.
  • Ensure that contractual commitments are appropriately reviewed, understood, approved, and monitored.

Enterprise Execution and Risk Management

  • Lead the Enterprise Project Management Office and establish effective standards for project and portfolio governance.
  • Create transparency regarding enterprise priorities, resource requirements, interdependencies, risks, milestones, and results.
  • Strengthen accountability for the execution of complex, cross-functional initiatives.
  • Coordinate enterprise risk management and compliance activities in partnership with relevant business and functional leaders.
  • Ensure that significant business, financial, operational, contractual, and compliance risks are identified, evaluated, and appropriately managed.

Transformation and Artificial Intelligence

  • Champion the thoughtful and responsible use of artificial intelligence across Finance and Corporate Operations.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify work, improve decision support, strengthen processes, and create capacity for higher-value activities.
  • Lead technology-enabled transformation and the adoption of new operating practices.
  • Ensure that technology and AI initiatives incorporate appropriate governance, accountability, risk management, and human judgment.

Organizational Leadership

  • Build, lead, and develop high-performing, multidisciplinary teams.
  • Attract and retain strong talent while strengthening leadership depth and succession pipelines.
  • Establish clear priorities, roles, expectations, and standards of accountability.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, continuous learning, sound judgment, and enterprise-wide responsibility.
  • Model Macmillan Learning’s values and contribute actively to the overall leadership and direction of the company.

The candidate should demonstrate:

  • Deep expertise in financial planning, forecasting, reporting, accounting, controls, and business performance management.
  • Strong knowledge of applicable accounting standards, governance requirements, compliance practices, and enterprise risk management.
  • Experience leading broad operational functions within a complex organization.
  • Demonstrated leadership experience involving manufacturing, supply chain, distribution, or international operations.
  • Experience developing pricing strategy and evaluating significant business investments.
  • A record of success in business development and the management of strategic channel partnerships.
  • Experience leading major enterprise negotiations and managing complex vendor and contractual relationships.
  • Strong financial modeling, analytical, strategic, and commercial capabilities.
  • Experience advising CEOs, executive leadership teams, Boards, shareholders, and other senior stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated success leading technology-enabled transformation, process improvement, and organizational change.
  • The ability to build, lead, and develop high-performing, multidisciplinary teams.
  • Exceptional executive communication skills and the ability to influence effectively within a complex, matrixed organization.
  • Sound judgment, intellectual rigor, personal integrity, and an enterprise-wide orientation.

Preferred Experience

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be advantageous:

  • Publishing, education, media, digital products, or another knowledge-based industry.

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE, Compute Node Team)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE, Compute Node Team) based in United Kingdom.

This is a senior Site Reliability Engineering role focused on the infrastructure that runs and manages virtual machines across a large-scale cloud platform.
You will work close to the Linux operating system, hypervisor, and node-level services that form the foundation of the compute environment.
The role combines deep Linux systems engineering, virtualization, containerization, observability, and production reliability.
You will investigate complex issues involving CPU, memory, NUMA, cgroups, scheduling, and system performance across user and kernel space.
You will also help shape reliability practices through strong monitoring, incident response, root-cause analysis, and postmortem processes.
Collaboration with platform, kernel, hypervisor, GPU, and infrastructure teams will be central to improving system design and operability.
This is an opportunity to influence critical compute infrastructure supporting demanding AI and cloud workloads at significant scale.

Accountabilities

  • Ensure the reliability, availability, and performance of compute nodes responsible for running virtual machines.
  • Analyze and debug complex Linux systems across both user space and kernel space.
  • Investigate system capabilities, limitations, dependencies, and trade-offs across different layers of the operating system and infrastructure stack.
  • Troubleshoot complex production issues involving CPU, memory, NUMA, cgroups, and scheduling.
  • Work hands-on with virtualization technologies, primarily QEMU/KVM and Linux-native technologies.
  • Analyze VM lifecycle behavior, performance characteristics, resource utilization, and failure modes.
  • Support and improve containerized workloads using Linux-native mechanisms such as namespaces and cgroups.
  • Design and evolve observability for the compute node layer, including metrics, logs, traces, alerts, SLIs, and SLOs.
  • Build reliability signals that provide clear and actionable insight into system behavior.
  • Lead or contribute to incident response, ensuring production issues are diagnosed and resolved efficiently.

title: Sr. Director of Supply Chain and Production
description:
Who we are

About The Black Tux

We’re here to help people look their best and feel confident—for big days and everyday. We design and manufacture modern formal wear with an incredible fit by sourcing natural fabrics like merino wool, breathable linen and cotton, plush velvet, and luxurious silk from the finest textile mills. With expert stylists in our physical showrooms across the US, our online predictive fit process, and an industry-leading customer service team, we guarantee a perfect fit every time.


About the Team

In this role, you'd be joining the Operations team. This team is integral to supporting a fast-moving e-commerce & omni-channel environment. As The Black Tux builds on its event based foundation to become a leading men’s formalwear platform across both rent and purchase, the Operations Team is critical to providing our customers an elevated experience. We form the value chain from product development to final delivery to our retail store and direct to our customers. We work closely with teams across the company to ensure we deliver high quality products.


What You’ll Do

To further this important mission, we are looking for a Sr. Director of Supply Chain and Production. The purpose of this role is to support The Black Tux’s end-to-end supply chain from supplier sourcing and vendor management to inbound logistics and inventory management. The Sr. The Director of Supply Chain and Production makes sure the right products with the right quality reach customers on time and at the right cost.

  • Manage the supply chain of inventory, garments, packaging material and supplies made available for direct sale to consumers and through wholesalers

  • Oversee inbound and outbound freight and logistics for products, packaging and supplies as well as supplier management for customer rental and retail orders

  • Support intercompany freight between our distribution centers and 40+ retail locations

  • Maintain, develop and grow a list of existing and potential suppliers that align with the company’s strategic and financial plans

  • Research, interview, visit potential suppliers and when appropriate run competitive RFQ/RFP processes for available portions of the company’s business when needed

  • Partner with Merchandising on new product development and introduction

  • Own KPI metrics that track supply chain and production performance

  • Align inventory supply with demand forecasts to optimize stock and service levels

  • Ensure compliance standards are upheld across the supply chain, including labor, safety and sourcing practices

  • Build and maintain the systems, process infrastructure and decision making that support supply chain operations

Who You Are

  • 8–12+ years of experience in international supply chain management, sourcing, logistics, or procurement, including 3–5+ years in a leadership/director-level role

  • Deep understanding of apparel manufacturing & men’s suiting / tailored clothing and demonstrated success matching supply with demand in a seasonal driven business

  • Proficiency with ERP/Supply Chain systems (MS Dynamics, NetSuite, SAP, Oracle) and strong command of KPIs

  • Direct experience managing end-to-end supply chains with international/offshore manufacturing (Asia, Latin America, or similar sourcing regions common to apparel)

  • Proven track record managing vendor relationships across multiple countries, including factory audits, negotiations, and performance management

  • Experience with import/export logistics, customs compliance, and international freight (ocean, air) management, including working knowledge of Incoterms, tariffs/duties and trade regulations.

  • Demonstrated success matching supply with demand seasonal or trend-driven business

  • Sound financial background including budget ownership and cost modeling

  • Fluency in Spanish preferred

  • Willingness to to travel between our work sites in Los Angeles and Pennsylvania, other company sites and to our internal supplier and manufacturing plants

  • Option to participate in a 401(k) plan through Betterment

  • Open paid time off

  • Paid holidays + annual winter break

  • Monthly cell phone reimbursement

  • One Medical and Wellhub (Gympass) membership

  • Employee engagement, cultural events, and trainings

  • Discounts on garment rental and purchases for you, your partner, and friends & family

title: Fermentation Technician
description:
Who we are
Envera LIC, LLC is part of the Lesaffre family who is a key global player in the fermentation of microorganisms (yeasts and bacteria) for baking, taste, healthcare, and industrial biotechnology. This story began more than 170 years ago in northern France, and, thanks to our entrepreneur spirit and our innovative approach, we are constantly developing.

Lesaffre's global presence includes 11,000 employees from 96 nationalities and a 3-billion-euro turnover. We work with customers, partners, and researchers to develop essential nutrients and bio actives that strengthen human health, optimize animal well-being, and improve plant nutrition.

We believe in the incredible potential of microorganisms as the greatest means to better nourish and protect the planet. Fermentation is one of the most promising answers to the challenge of nourishing 9 billion people in a healthy way by 2050.

Envera is a legal entity of Lesaffre located in West Chester, Pennsylvania. Envera manufactures bacteria solutions for Lesaffre BUs and different market segments such as wastewater treatment, bioremediation, cleaning solutions and many other areas where bacteria can play a key role.

What you bring to the table
Proficiency in medium-to-large scale fermentation operations, utilizing equipment such as fermenters, centrifuges, spray dryers, and CIP skids. Possess fundamental troubleshooting skills and a strong mechanical aptitude, enabling training on various equipment. The successful candidate will have a strong background in industrial fermentation processes, experience in a lab setting, and basic computer skills to comprehend process controls and automation.

Experience with steam systems and an understanding of liquid process flow are highly desirable, as these skills will be essential to this role. The ideal candidate will also possess excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, a strong mechanical aptitude, and should be comfortable working in a team environment having interpersonal skills to effectively communicate with other departments within the organization.

This is an excellent opportunity for a skilled brewer to take the next step in their career and contribute to the growth and success of a bio-manufacturing operation.

Ability to work 2nd shift (Monday - Thursday, 2:00pm - 12:30am) and some weekends

A few responsibilities you will have as the Industrial Fermentation Technician

  • Prepare, batch, sterilize, monitor, and process industrial fermenters. This includes media preparation, probe calibration, pH adjustment, batch sterilization/autoclaving, down-stream processing, CIP’s (Clean-in-place) of fermenters and down-stream-processing equipment, and SIP’s (Sterilize-in-place) of fermenters.
  • Utilize both manual and automated control systems to execute batches, CIP’s, and SIP’s according to job aids and SOP’s.
  • Fermentation monitoring, aseptic sampling, and benchtop measurements throughout the process.
  • Safely work in manufacturing areas, following forklift, confined space, work-from-height, chemical handling, and LOTO safety procedures without deviation.
  • Ability to handle basic repairs and simple troubleshooting as necessary.
  • Assist with efforts in other departments when needed.
  • Maintain clean and organized 5S work areas.
  • Embraces a growth mindset, consistently seeking to enhance skills and knowledge to contribute to the development and optimization of processes and procedures.

To succeed you must have

  • Vocational or Technical school degree or mechanical experience is preferred.
  • Experience with steam sterilization and liquid processing is preferred.
  • Forklift certification or the ability to receive one.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft office.
  • Mechanical aptitude and attention to detail is necessary.
  • Ability to juggle multiple tasks and prioritize workload.
  • Ability to work well as part of a team.

Our Core Values: Passion, respect, trust, entrepreneurship, and humility

What we offer

  • The opportunity to represent a passionate organization focused on innovation and sustainability
  • A great 401K plan, affordable benefits, and 10 paid holidays
  • The ability to utilize your experience and knowledge to make a real impact

title: Machine Builder
description:
Xylem is a Fortune 500 global water solutions company dedicated to advancing sustainable impact and empowering the people who make water work every day. As a leading water technology company with 23,000 employees operating in over 150 countries, Xylem is at the forefront of addressing the world's most critical water challenges. We invite passionate individuals to join our team, dedicated to exceeding customer expectations through innovative and sustainable solutions.

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Machine Assembler to join our second shift team. This role is responsible for the assembly, plumbing, and mechanical integration of complex machinery and custom equipment. As a key contributor to our manufacturing operations, the Senior Machine Builder plays a vital role in ensuring that machines are assembled to exacting standards, meeting both customer specifications and internal quality expectations. This position requires advanced technical expertise, the ability to work independently, and a willingness to lead or mentor others on the floor.

Who We’re Looking For
We’re looking for mechanically minded individuals with hands-on trade experience—mechanics, plumbers, electricians, carpenters or anyone skilled in reading technical diagrams like P&IDs. This role involves assembling equipment. Experience with car repair, plumbing, carpentry, or industrial systems is a strong plus.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assemble, plumb, and test a wide range of mechanical and electromechanical systems—including both custom and standard machinery—using blueprints, schematics, and detailed work instructions.

  • Perform high-precision mechanical, electrical, and fluid system integration.

  • Interpret complex engineering drawings and technical documentation to ensure correct component fitment and functionality.

  • Identify and troubleshoot assembly issues; suggest and implement design or process improvements when appropriate.

  • Utilize hand tools, power tools, and precision instruments to complete assemblies to spec.

  • Ensure all equipment meets or exceeds performance, quality, and safety standards by adhering to established procedures.

  • Redline engineering drawings and update documentation based on real-time assembly changes and findings.

  • Conduct both in-process and final inspections to verify machine function and reliability.

  • Lead or mentor junior builders and collaborate effectively with engineering, quality, and production teams.

  • Maintain a clean and organized work environment in accordance with 5S principles and workplace safety regulations.

  • Accurately record work time, materials used, and other data in ERP systems such as SAP.

  • Participate in continuous improvement initiatives including root cause analysis, lean manufacturing efforts, and process optimization.

  • Assist with facility plumbing or mechanical tasks as needed.

  • Maintain dependable attendance and support second shift operations consistently.

Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED required; technical training or certification in mechanical/electrical assembly strongly preferred.

  • Minimum of 3 years’ experience in machine building, mechanical assembly, or a related field—preferably in a manufacturing setting.

  • Strong mechanical aptitude with working knowledge of plumbing techniques (e.g., PVC solvent welding, thread taping).

  • Proven ability to read and interpret complex blueprints, schematics, and documentation.

  • Familiarity with ERP systems (SAP experience is a plus).

  • Excellent attention to detail and strong problem-solving skills.

  • Capable of working independently and as part of a collaborative team.

  • Effective verbal and written communication skills.

  • Willingness to work second shift on a regular basis.

Why Join Us?

  • Work on innovative, custom-engineered machinery in a supportive team environment.

  • Take on a leadership role in a high-impact, second shift position.

  • Opportunities for growth, training, and continuous improvement in a clean and safety-focused facility.

  • Competitive compensation, including potential second shift premiums and benefits.

Compensation

The estimated salary range for this position is $20 to $22. Starting pay is based on several factors, including relevant experience, skills, and work location. At Xylem, we provide a competitive compensation package along with a comprehensive benefits program as outlined above.

Join the global Xylem team to be a part of innovative technology solutions transforming water usage, conservation, and re-use. title: Director of Product Management
description:
Graco manufactures and markets premium equipment to move, measure, control, dispense and spray a wide variety of fluid and powder materials. What does that mean? Well, we pump peanut butter into your jar, and the oil in your car. We glue the soles of your shoes, the glass in your windows and the screen on your phone. We spray the finish on your vehicle, coatings on your pills, the paint on your house and texture on your walls. Graco is part of your daily life.

Where You’ll Work – White Knight Fluid Handling Inc., a subsidiary of Graco, Inc.

White Knight was established in 1995 and has consistently developed and manufactured high-quality products. We are a leading supplier of pumps and fluid transfer technology to the semiconductor, Solar Cells, LEDs, flat-panel displays, electronic and industrial markets.

Ready to join us?

The Director of Marketing Product Management for White Knight is a key strategic role, responsible for executing product development and strategy to align with global marketing objectives. This role involves leading a team to plan, develop and maintain a 5-year product roadmap and manage the product lifecycle. This role will also oversee SKU rationalization, portfolio management, technology optimization and collaborate cross-functionally to ensure product success and market competitiveness. This leader must have the ability to see the bigger picture for the organization and correlate the tactical and executional KPI’s to an ROI to reach desired business outcomes.

​

What You Will Do at Graco

Strategic Product Planning and Roadmap Development

  • Develop, implement and lead 5-year product roadmaps that are in alignment with the White Knight's global marketing strategy, and lead a team of product managers to execute upon the strategy.

  • Define strategic goals, prioritize initiatives, and ensure the roadmap supports overall business objectives.

  • Lead team efforts in executing Customer Requirements Documentation (CRD) and effectively partner with operations and engineering for product development execution

  • Manage the product portfolio to ensure it meets market needs and supports the division’s strategic goals.

Product and Technology Optimization

  • Strategically optimize technology across different verticals and applications to enhance product functionality and customer value.

  • Oversee SKU rationalization to streamline the product portfolio and maximize profitability.

Market Research and Insight Utilization

  • Lead the efforts to conduct comprehensive technical market research to understand customer needs, industry trends, and competitive dynamics.

  • Use research insights to inform product strategies, optimize marketing efforts, and maintain a competitive edge.

  • Continuously optimize products based on performance metrics, customer feedback, and market trends.

Performance Reporting

  • Prepare and present detailed reports on product performance to senior leaders.

  • Provide actionable recommendations based on performance data to guide strategic decisions.

  • Monitor and report overall product and portfolio performance and KPIs in accordance with strategic product roadmaps.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Engage with key stakeholders, including marketing, sales, engineering, and customer support, to gather insights, address challenges, and drive cross-functional collaboration in the development and execution of the product roadmap.

  • Facilitate coordination between teams to support product development and execution.

Team Leadership and Financial Management

  • Lead, mentor, manage, and staff a team, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and promoting a culture of excellence.

  • Drive team performance by setting clear goals, providing ongoing feedback, and facilitating professional growth opportunities.

  • Establish, manage, and be accountable for the annual product management budget, ensuring effective allocation of resources and alignment with organizational strategic objectives.

What You Will Bring to Graco

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, or a related field; an MBA or equivalent advanced degree is preferred.

  • 10+ years of experience in product portfolio management, with a strong track record in strategic planning, product lifecycle management, and marketing execution.

  • Excellent leadership skills; 5+ years of team leadership experience preferred.

  • Strong technical background with the ability to understand and communicate complex technical concepts to a non-technical stakeholder

  • Strong understanding of product financial metrics and the ability to develop business cases and ROI analysis for new product initiatives.

  • Proven experience in optimizing technology across verticals.

  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams and manage complex projects.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with experience reporting to senior leadership.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven approach to decision-making.

  • Ability to travel approximately 20% of the time, domestic or international

Accelerators

  • Global semi-conductor experience and knowledge.

  • Fluid and material management equipment product development knowledge.

title: Head of Market Structure & Platform Development
description:
Position Overview

Apollo Capital Solutions (ACS) is building the foundational infrastructure for the private credit market. Public and private markets are converging and private credit is scaling rapidly, yet the data, settlement and workflow infrastructure underpinning the asset classes remain manual and fragmented. Apollo, through Alternative Asset Trading (AAT), has already facilitated more than $30 billion in secondary private credit volume and is advancing data, index, pricing and settlement workstreams to close that gap. The firms that help define this infrastructure will lead the market.

We are seeking a senior leader, based in Austin, TX, to own the next phase of this buildout: a market structure and platform role covering the institutional trading infrastructure around both traditional and digitally native private assets, spanning liquidity access, execution, custody, collateral, counterparty risk and settlement. Working across business leadership, product, engineering and operations, the individual will commercialize the platform across the private credit ecosystem and assess developments in tokenization and prime-brokerage models. This is a business-building role, reporting to senior ACS leadership.

Primary Responsibilities

Efficient transfer and settlement

  • Develop transfer and settlement solutions that move private credit from today's manual, consent-driven assignment process toward automated, near-real-time transfer, with authoritative digital records for each asset
  • Own the end-to-end lifecycle (origination through secondary transfer and servicing) and remove friction at each node: assignment agreements, agent processes and settlement workflows
  • Extend custody and collateral mechanics to private assets in both traditional and tokenized form, so positions can be held, financed and mobilized with public-market reliability
  • Advance settlement models, including delivery versus payment, that reduce counterparty and operational risk

Marketplace development

  • Lead Apollo's market structure strategy across the infrastructure required for private credit to scale: data standardization, index development, secondary trading infrastructure, and digital transfer and settlement
  • Ensure seamless data integration throughout the asset lifecycle, integrating with ICE Private Credit Intelligence and Apollo's internal systems so deal data stays consistent and operationally useful
  • Develop the pricing transparency, liquidity access, execution and venue connectivity that let participants transact private assets efficiently, in both traditional and tokenized form
  • Assess and shape Apollo's approach to tokenization and prime-brokerage models, positioning the platform for the convergence of traditional and digitally native private assets
  • Interface with market participants and counterparties across the private credit ecosystem, including originators, asset managers, market makers, custodians and prime brokers, to drive adoption of new technologies and platforms
  • Own the commercial model and P&L across market structure and platform initiatives

Qualifications & Experience

  • 15+ years in private credit, leveraged finance or structured credit, spanning both investment/trading and/or operational/infrastructure roles
  • Track record of building something from zero to one, whether a new business line, platform or operational capability; this is a buildout role, not a maintenance role
  • Strong commercial instinct across business models, incentive structures and go-to-market strategies, with comfort owning a P&L and moving from investment phase to revenue
  • Deep understanding of private credit operational mechanics: assignment agreements, settlement workflows, agent processes and the full lifecycle from origination through secondary transfer and servicing
  • Experience with institutional electronic trading and its counterparties (market makers, exchanges, custodians and prime brokers) and how they connect for execution, clearing and settlement
  • Experience with market structure or infrastructure buildouts in adjacent asset classes (syndicated loans, CLOs, ABS); familiarity with LSTA protocols, ClearPar or LXID/CUSIP infrastructure strongly preferred
  • Familiarity with digital asset market structure (custody, tokenization, on-chain settlement, prime brokerage) and with data-licensing business models; a strong plus as these models mature
  • Entrepreneurial, collaborative and solutions-oriented, with strong communication skills, high execution discipline and comfort operating with significant ambiguity

About Apollo

Apollo is a high-growth, global alternative asset manager. In our asset management business, we seek to provide our clients excess return at every point along the risk-reward spectrum from investment grade credit to private equity. For more than three decades, our investing expertise across our fully integrated platform has served the financial return needs of our clients and provided businesses with innovative capital solutions for growth. Through Athene, our retirement services business, we specialize in helping clients achieve financial security by providing a suite of retirement savings products and acting as a solutions provider to institutions. Our patient, creative, and knowledgeable approach to investing aligns our clients, businesses we invest in, our employees, and the communities we impact, to expand opportunity and achieve positive outcomes. As of August 2025, Apollo had approximately $908billion of assets under management. To learn more, please visit .

Our Purpose & Core Values

Our clients rely on our investment acumen to help secure their future. We must never lose our focus and determination to be the best investors and most trusted partners on their behalf. We strive to be:

  • The leading provider of retirement income solutions to institutions, companies, and individuals.

  • The leading provider of capital solutions to companies. Our breadth and scale enable us to deliver capital for even the largest projects – and our small firm mindset ensures we will be a thoughtful and dedicated partner to these organizations. We are committed to helping them build stronger businesses.

  • A leading contributor to addressing some of the biggest issues facing the world today – such as energy transition, accelerating the adoption of new technologies, and social impact – where innovative approaches to investing can make a positive difference.

We are building a unique firm of extraordinary colleagues who:

  • Outperform expectations

  • Challenge Convention

  • Champion Opportunity

  • Lead responsibly

  • Drive collaboration

As One Apollo team, we believe that doing great work and having fun go hand in hand, and we are proud of what we can achieve together.

Our Benefits

Apollo relies on its people to keep it a leader in alternative investment management, and the firm’s benefit programs are crafted to offer meaningful coverage for both you and your family.

Pay Range

$500,000

Apollo Global Management, Inc. (together with its subsidiaries and affiliates) is committed to championing opportunity.

description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer — Token Factory (Inference Platform) based in Spain.

This is a senior engineering role focused on the reliability, performance, and observability of a large-scale AI inference platform.
You will help operate infrastructure serving foundation models across text, vision, audio, and emerging multimodal workloads.
The role combines Kubernetes, infrastructure-as-code, observability, automation, and production incident management at significant scale.
You will optimize GPU-heavy workloads, strengthen resilience, and ensure high-throughput APIs meet demanding reliability and cost targets.
You will work closely with software engineers and infrastructure teams to build self-healing systems and robust operational processes.
The environment is fast-moving, highly technical, international, and focused on solving complex infrastructure challenges for the AI ecosystem.
This is an opportunity to have a direct impact on the infrastructure powering next-generation AI applications.

Accountabilities

  • Own the reliability, performance, and observability of the inference platform and its supporting infrastructure.
  • Design, implement, and continuously improve telemetry pipelines covering metrics, logs, and traces.
  • Build monitoring and observability solutions capable of processing large volumes of production signals and converting them into actionable insights.
  • Configure and optimize Kubernetes infrastructure for high availability, scalability, and efficient resource utilization.

  • Define and improve reliability practices for high-throughput APIs, including alerting strategies and Service Level Objectives (SLOs).
  • Investigate distributed-system failures and performance issues across infrastructure and application layers.
  • Optimize systems from the kernel and infrastructure layer through to the application layer.
  • Support and improve the operation of GPU-intensive inference workloads and accelerator-based infrastructure.
  • Contribute to scaling the inference platform while balancing performance, reliability, and infrastructure costs.
  • Collaborate closely with software engineers to incorporate reliability and operational excellence into product and platform development.
  • Promote automation, self-healing capabilities, and engineering practices that reduce operational overhead and improve system resilience.

    • Requirements:

    • Significant experience in Site Reliability Engineering, Production Engineering, DevOps, or a closely related infrastructure discipline.

    • Advanced experience with Terraform and infrastructure-as-code practices.
    • Strong scripting and automation skills using Python and/or Bash.
    • Solid understanding of distributed systems and the ways production backends can fail under real-world conditions.
    • Experience designing effective alerts, monitoring strategies, and SLOs for high-throughput services or APIs.
    • Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills across infrastructure, networking, operating systems, and application layers.
    • Experience designing systems for high availability, resilience, scalability, and graceful failure recovery.

    • Strong understanding of infrastructure automation, deployment, configuration management, and operational tooling.
    • Ability to analyze complex performance and reliability problems and translate findings into practical engineering improvements.
    • Strong incident-management and root-cause-analysis capabilities.
    • Ability to collaborate effectively with software engineers and other technical teams to integrate reliability into platform development.
    • Proactive mindset with a strong focus on automation, self-healing systems, and continuous improvement.
    • Comfortable working independently, taking ownership of critical infrastructure, and operating effectively in a fast-paced technical environment.
